 Tired of social media and news apps deciding what you see? Meet Twine, a modern, open-source RSS reader designed to put you back in the driver’s seat. Twine combines a beautiful, distraction-free interface with powerful tools to help you stay informed on your own terms.
 Why Twine?

 🚀 Smart & Simple Feed Discovery:

 Power Features for Feed Pros:
 Universal Support: Works with RSS, Atom, RDF, and JSON feeds.
 Stay Organised: Group, pin, and manage your feeds with ease. Use the customizable bottom bar for quick access to your favorite categories.
 Filter the Noise: Use the "Blocked Words" feature to automatically hide posts containing specific keywords you want to avoid.
 Seamless Syncing: Keep your feeds in sync with support for FreshRSS (GReader), Miniflux, and Dropbox (Alpha).
 Import & Export: Moving from another reader? Import your existing feeds via OPML in seconds.
 Search & Bookmark: Find specific posts across all your feeds or save them to your bookmarks to read later.
 Home Screen Widgets: Stay updated at a glance with beautiful widgets that show your latest unread posts (Available via Twine Premium).
 Open Source & Community Driven:
 Twine is built with love using Kotlin and Compose Multiplatform. It is an open-source project, meaning the community helps keep it transparent, secure, and constantly improving.
 Stop scrolling and start reading. Download Twine today.

fdroid:arrowloop.halleluja.design.name: ArrowLoop
fdroid:arrowloop.halleluja.design.summary: Two-way sync between your phone and your own storage. No account, no ads.
fdroid:arrowloop.halleluja.design.description:
ArrowLoop keeps a folder on your phone and a folder somewhere else in step, in both directions. Change a file on either side and the next run carries it over. Delete one and it goes on the other side too, into a trash rather than for good.
The other side is storage you already have: your own server over SFTP, SMB or WebDAV, a Nextcloud or OpenCloud, an S3 bucket, or one of the many cloud services rclone supports. ArrowLoop runs its sync engine on the phone itself, so there is no server of ours in between and no account to create.
What it does
• Syncs in both directions, or one way if you prefer
• Runs on a schedule, as soon as files change, or when you tap a job
• Waits for Wi-Fi, charging or enough battery if you ask it to
• Shows what a run would copy and delete before anything moves
• Keeps a history of every run: what was copied, deleted or left for next time, and why
• Keeps both versions when a file was changed on both sides
So that no file gets lost
• Nothing is deleted outright: a deletion moves the file into a trash on that side
• A run that would delete more than half of your files stops and tells you. Ten deletions or fewer always go through, so a small folder is not held up by its own arithmetic; both numbers are settings
• A side that suddenly looks empty, say a drive that did not mount, is never taken as "everything was deleted"
• A file that fails to copy is tried again on the next run
No account, no ads, no analytics. The source code is open, and the same engine runs as a desktop app for Windows, macOS and Linux and as a container on a home server.
ArrowLoop asks for access to all files so that a job can sync any folder you pick, such as DCIM or Documents. It only reads and writes the folders your jobs name.
Android/data, where apps keep their own files, is closed to that access. If you want to sync it, ArrowLoop can reach it through root or Shizuku: root reads and writes, Shizuku only reads. Both are optional and only asked for when you switch Android/data on.

fdroid:com.m57.hermescontrol.description:
Hermes Mobile is a native Android app for Hermes Agent, the open source AI agent by Nous Research. It connects to the Hermes dashboard on your computer or server, so you can talk to your agent and check on it from your phone.
What you can do:
• Chat with your agent, send photos, files, and voice notes, and answer approval prompts
• Reply straight from notifications
• Switch models and providers, and manage profiles, skills, plugins, and toolsets
• Create and edit cron jobs
• Stream and filter live logs, check usage analytics, and edit environment keys
• See the status of the gateway, MCP servers, and messaging channels
• Track tasks on Kanban boards and browse past sessions
• Lock the app with your fingerprint or screen lock, or keep a shared phone on one profile
• Pick one of seven themes, or use Material You colors on Android 12+
It works on your home network, and over the internet when the dashboard is behind HTTPS. The app also supports client certificates (mTLS), private certificate authorities, Cloudflare Access, and a built-in SSH tunnel. Chat history and saved credentials are encrypted on the phone.
You need Hermes Agent with its dashboard running (hermes dashboard). Setup guide: https://github.com/Hy4ri/hermes-mobile/wiki/Connecting-to-Hermes
If the app is useful to you, you can support it on Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/m_5_7

fdroid:com.sasas991.wolpanel.name: Wol Panel
fdroid:com.sasas991.wolpanel.summary: Wake your machines over the LAN with a magic packet
fdroid:com.sasas991.wolpanel.description:
Wol Panel is a small, no-frills Wake-on-LAN client. Keep a list of the machines
on your network and wake any of them with one tap.
Features:
* Device list saved across restarts, no account and no cloud
* Wake button sends a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to the device's broadcast address
* Live online/offline status per device, refreshed every 15 seconds or on demand
* Inline feedback for every wake: packet sent, waking, awake, or failed
* Optional SSH shortcut that hands the connection to Termux
Everything happens on your local network. The app talks to nothing but the
devices you enter yourself: no analytics, no tracking, no ads, no remote server.
To add a device you need its MAC address, its host or IP for the status check,
the broadcast address of your subnet, the Wake-on-LAN port (usually 9), and a
TCP port that is open when the machine is up (22, 80 and 3389 all work well).
Wake-on-LAN must be enabled in the target machine's BIOS/UEFI and network
adapter settings, and the phone must be on the same subnet.

fdroid:com.signalsense.app.name: SignalSense – Network Switch Alerts
fdroid:com.signalsense.app.summary: Know the instant your network switches between 5G, 4G, 3G, or 2G
fdroid:com.signalsense.app.description:
Frustrated by silent drops from 5G to 4G? SignalSense alerts you the instant your network changes – giving you the power to pause downloads, save your data, and avoid unexpected charges.
SignalSense continuously monitors your mobile network and notifies you whenever your connection switches between 5G, 4G, 3G, or 2G – helping you identify network issues before they affect calls, streaming, gaming, or downloads.
FEATURES
- Instant Alerts 
 Get notified the moment your network drops from 5G to 4G, or 4G to 3G. Stop wondering why your video buffered – know exactly why.
- 5G SA and NSA Detection 
 Accurately distinguishes between 5G Standalone (SA) and Non-Standalone (NSA) connections – not just "5G".
- Custom Ringtones & Vibration Control 
 Choose your own custom ringtone and control vibration settings for network alerts.
- Live Speed and Ping 
 See real-time download and upload speeds in the persistent notification, and live ping on the home screen.
- Call-Aware Alerts 
 Alerts are automatically held during active phone calls and fired after the call ends. No interruptions at the wrong moment.
- Anti-Spam Debouncing 
 Rapid signal fluctuations are detected and grouped into a single "unstable signal" alert instead of spamming your notification shade.
- Switch History Log 
 Every network change is logged with a timestamp and network speed. Review your full connection history at any time.
- Fully Customizable Alerts 
 Choose exactly which transitions alert you:
 - Network Upgrade
 - Network Downgrade
 - Mobile Data Lost / Restored
 - Any Network Change
- Smart Auto-Start / Auto-Stop 
 Monitoring can automatically start when mobile data turns on and stop when it turns off – completely hands-free.
- Boot Auto-Start 
 Optionally start monitoring automatically every time your phone boots.
- Dual SIM Support 
 Choose which SIM slot to monitor or use Auto mode to always follow your active data SIM. 
 Switches instantly when you change your default data SIM.
- Battery-Friendly 
 Uses a lightweight foreground service with minimal battery impact. Built for all-day use.
No ads. No tracking. No data collected. 100% private and open source.

fdroid:com.verdettoqr.scanner.name: Verdetto: QR & Barcode Scanner
fdroid:com.verdettoqr.scanner.summary: QR & barcode scanner. See the link before it opens.
fdroid:com.verdettoqr.scanner.description:
Verdetto is a free QR code and barcode scanner for Android with no ads and no fake buttons. It shows the link before it opens, is built to read damaged codes, and checks scanned content for warning signs on the phone. It never says anything is safe: "No warnings found" means none of its checks matched.
• See the link before it opens. The address, the network name or the contact is shown before anything opens. The result is one line: Danger, Caution, or No warnings found. A link never opens by itself unless you turn that on, and then only after a three-second cancel.
• Reads torn, faded and creased codes. Faded, torn, tilted or inverted: keep aiming and it keeps trying across frames instead of asking you to hold still. Tap to focus, pinch to zoom, or scan a photo or a shared image. It reads QR, Micro QR and rMQR codes, Data Matrix, Aztec, PDF417, MaxiCode, the retail and industrial barcodes, GS1 packs, boarding passes, driver's licenses and vehicle identification numbers (VINs).
• Online lookups you can turn off. With them on, a product, book, record, journal or device is looked up in a small file your phone fetches and reads itself, so the number goes to no database. A medicine number of one national register, a device number the file does not know and a vehicle number go to their public registers. The privacy policy names every request the app makes and who receives it.
Sources: fdc.nal.usda.gov, fda.gov, nlm.nih.gov, cpsc.gov, nhtsa.gov, fueleconomy.gov, cima.aemps.es, aifa.gov.it, medicaments.gouv.fr, ec.europa.eu. Verdetto is not a government or political app.
• Make your own codes. A code from text, a website, Wi-Fi, a contact, a calendar event, an email, a phone number, an SMS, a location or your own card, as a QR code or a barcode, with a check that it scans on this phone before you print or share it.
• History that is yours. Search, filters, favorites that always stay, a keep-for setting, and a private session that saves nothing to history. Export it all as CSV, never with a password or a sign-in secret in it, and import a CSV back.
• Made for the hand. A Quick Settings tile and two home-screen widgets, list mode with a CSV export, a left-handed layout, results read aloud, light, dark and pure black themes, 34 languages. Android 8 and later.
• Free, no ads, no tracking by Verdetto. No accounts, no analytics in the app. Camera frames are read on the phone and dropped. Every check and every decode is free for everyone, kept that way by the people who use it: an optional contribution, once or monthly, earns a thank-you badge and the small extras; nothing you need is behind it. It never nags: no rating prompts.
The safety list, the app's code and its scanner engine are open source; the addresses are at verdettoqr.com/source. The checks are limited by design and no check catches every scam; the full wording is under Terms of use in the app.
On Mastodon: @VerdettoQR@mastodon.social. On Bluesky: @verdettoqr.com.

fdroid:io.coinos.fdroid.name: Coinos
fdroid:io.coinos.fdroid.summary: Self-custodial bitcoin wallet: Ark spending, on-chain savings, nostr chat
fdroid:io.coinos.fdroid.description:
Bitcoin you actually hold: your wallet is twelve words, nobody else ever has them, and they work in any wallet, anywhere.
* Spending over Ark: instant, low-fee off-chain payments with a unilateral exit — your keys, your coins
* Savings on-chain: a full BIP84 bitcoin wallet
* Lightning sends and receives via the coinos Ark server, plus a name@coinos.io payment address (BIP-353, LNURL, BOLT 12)
* Nostr built in: encrypted DMs, community chat, posts, zaps
* Handles lightning:, bitcoin:, nostr: and lnurl: links and NFC taps
This build carries the whole app inside the APK. The coinos servers are only reached for their APIs (the Ark server, Electrum, the name registrar).
Other servers it talks to: Nostr relays (yours, configurable); Cloudflare's or Google's DNS-over-HTTPS, to look up and DNSSEC-verify name@domain payment addresses; and, while you read posts, whatever hosts the posts' pictures and link previews live on (YouTube thumbnails from i.ytimg.com among them).

fdroid:io.github.zk_haunt.twistcubee.summary: Offline 3D cube puzzle from 2×2 to 20×20 with timer, solver and hints
fdroid:io.github.zk_haunt.twistcubee.description:
Twist Cubee is a fast, beautiful 3D cube puzzle that works completely offline.
 Every size 
Play cubes from 2×2×2 all the way up to 20×20×20. Every size keeps its own saved game, so you can come back to a half-solved 9×9 whenever you like.
 Natural controls 
• Drag across the cube to turn a layer. The sticker under your finger follows it, and a quick flick finishes the turn.
• Drag the background, or use two fingers anywhere, to spin the whole cube freely.
• Pinch to zoom and twist to roll. Double-tap to reset the view.
• A lock button stops accidental rotation.
• Haptic feedback like a real cube: a tick when you grab a layer, a click at each quarter turn and when the turn lands.
 Speedcubing tools 
• Animated scramble, then a timer that starts with your first move.
• Optional 15-second WCA-style inspection, with haptic warnings at 8 and 12 seconds.
• Statistics for every size: best time, average, Ao5, fewest moves and recent solves.
 Help when you are stuck 
• Hints on 2×2 and 3×3 say what to do in plain words ("Turn the green face clockwise") and wiggle the layer to turn.
• Auto-solve uses an optimal 2×2 solver and Kociemba's two-phase algorithm for the 3×3 (about 20 moves). Bigger cubes rewind your moves.
 Make it yours 
Stickerless or classic stickers, four color schemes (including a color-blind-friendly one), three body colors, four backgrounds, and animation speed. Available in English and Polish.
 Private by design 
No internet permission, no ads, no tracking, no analytics. Your progress never leaves your device.
 Light and fast 
A tiny app (under 300 KB) with a native OpenGL ES 3.0 renderer. It draws even a 20×20 cube with a handful of GPU calls, and uses no battery when the cube is still.

fdroid:site.warpnet.warpdroid.name: Warpnet
fdroid:site.warpnet.warpdroid.summary: Decentralized P2P social client that pairs with your own Warpnet node
fdroid:site.warpnet.warpdroid.description:
Warpnet is the Android client for Warpnet, a peer-to-peer social network in which every user runs their own node. There are no accounts and no instance servers: your posts, follows and timeline are stored on your node.
Instead of signing in to a cloud account, the app pairs with your own Warpnet node — the desktop/server application you run yourself — by scanning a QR code. From then on the app works through that node over an end-to-end encrypted libp2p connection.
• Pairs with your self-hosted Warpnet node via a QR code
• End-to-end encrypted connection to your node (libp2p, Noise protocol), authenticated against the node identity in the QR code
• Push notifications without any cloud gateway — no Firebase, no Google Cloud Messaging; a lightweight always-on connection to your node delivers them
• No Google Play Services, no proprietary dependencies — 100% free and open-source software
• Dark and light themes
• Material Design
What the app connects to:
• Your node. The app tries the node's local network address first, then its public address (a static IP, port forwarding, or a UPnP/NAT-PMP mapping the node sets up on your router).
• Bootstrap/relay nodes. At start the app connects to the bootstrap nodes your node hands it during pairing — by default three nodes run by the Warpnet project on one host, 207.154.221.44. They are the entry points to Warpnet's peer discovery network (a libp2p DHT). The app exchanges only libp2p control traffic with them: its peer ID and public key, the "warpdroid" user agent and DHT routing queries. They see your IP address, but none of your posts or messages. While refreshing its routing table the app may also query other publicly reachable Warpnet nodes.
• Relaying. If your node cannot be reached directly (it is behind NAT without port forwarding and you are not on its network), the connection to it is relayed through one of these nodes (libp2p circuit relay v2). The relay passes on traffic it cannot read: the Noise encryption runs end to end between the phone and your node. The relay does see both IP addresses and peer IDs, and when and how much data flows.
• To keep the project's hosts out of the path, run your own relay node (the same AGPL code) and start your node with --node.bootstrap; the app uses whatever list your node hands it.
Traffic camouflage:
To get through networks that block unknown protocols, every connection the app opens — to your node and to bootstrap/relay nodes — is wrapped in a TLS session that imitates Google Chrome connecting to www.googleapis.com (that name is sent as the TLS SNI), and the TLS greeting is split across two TCP packets to get past deep packet inspection. Nothing is sent to Google: the connection goes to the IP address of your node or of the relay, so a traffic monitor such as PCAPdroid shows "www.googleapis.com" next to those addresses. The outer TLS is only a disguise and its certificate is not checked; security comes from the Noise layer inside it.
Full details: https://github.com/Warp-net/warpnet/blob/main/docs/NETWORK.md
Warpnet is free software released under the GNU Affero General Public License v3 (AGPL-3.0-or-later). The Android client is derived from Tusky.
Source code and more information: https://github.com/Warp-net/warpnet

apple-macos:6772823247.description:
Travel Logbook helps you organize every trip, document, reservation, and travel memory in one place.
Whether you’re planning a weekend getaway, a family vacation, a cruise, or a round-the-world adventure, Travel Logbook keeps your travel information structured, searchable, and available whenever you need it—even without an internet connection.
Build Complete Travel Itineraries
Create detailed trips with flights, hotels, cruises, trains, rental cars, activities, and more. Travel Logbook automatically organizes everything into a chronological timeline so you always know what’s next.
• Flights, hotels, cruises, trains, rental cars, and activities

• Boarding times, terminals, gates, and addresses

Import Travel Documents
Save time by importing travel confirmations, receipts, and booking documents.
Use your preferred AI provider to extract information from PDFs and images and automatically create itinerary items. Travel Logbook supports OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, Grok, Ollama, and compatible custom models.
You control which provider is used and how your documents are processed.
Visualize Your Journey
See your travels on interactive maps.
View flight routes, hotel locations, cruise ports, train stations, and activities in a geographic context to better understand your itinerary and travel history.
Track Your Travel History
Build a permanent record of your travels and explore detailed statistics over time.
• Countries and regions visited
• Distance traveled
• Nights away from home
• Travel spending and expenses
• Airlines, airports, hotels, and cruise lines used
Keep Important Information Secure
Store travel-related information such as passport details, Known Traveler Numbers, loyalty program memberships, and other important records in a secure encrypted vault protected by a PIN.
Designed for Travel
Travel Logbook is built to work offline.
Your itineraries, documents, and receipts remain available when you’re on a plane, at sea, or in locations with limited connectivity.
Private iCloud Sync
Sync trips, traveler profiles, and attached documents between your iPhone, iPad, and Mac using the same Apple Account. Your library uses your private iCloud storage.
Travel Logbook also works locally without enabling sync.
Attach and Export Documents
Attach PDFs, tickets, confirmations, and receipts directly to your itinerary items.
Export trip summaries, expense reports, and itinerary information when you need to share your plans with family, friends, or travel companions.
Manage Travelers
Create traveler profiles for family members and companions.
Store loyalty program information, seat preferences, dietary requirements, and other travel details so they’re always available when booking your next trip.
Travel Logbook is your personal travel archive—built to help you plan future adventures while preserving the details of the journeys you’ve already taken.

SK-51 is Fingerlab's all-in-one emulation of the Casio SK-1 and SK-5 — an 8-bit lo-fi keyboard from the 80s with sampling features and onboard drum machine, available for iPhone, iPad & Mac.
Called the "poor man's sampler" in its time, this iconic Casio keyboard was used by Fatboy Slim, Portishead, Autechre and Nine Inch Nails — and now it fits in your pocket.
At Fingerlab, some of us composed our first songs with it as kids in the eighties. We wanted to bring back that unique feeling, so we built SK-51: a faithful recreation of the Casio SK-1 and VL-Tone, recorded note by note at professional audio quality (16bit / 44.1kHz).
SK-51 is a universal purchase — one buy covers iPhone, iPad & Mac.
Sample your voice, fire up the drum machine, play a chord — and you've got a track.
Free version includes:
• 3 instruments (Flute, Piano, Trumpet)

• 4 sampling slots

• Full Mixer
• AUv3 Audio Unit
• Full MIDI & MIDI Mapping support
• AudioBus & Inter-App Audio (iOS)

Full Version (IAP) includes:
• 19 instruments (Brass Ensemble, Vibraphone, Chorus and more)
• 21 demo drum patterns
• 5 FX: Tube Amp, Phaser, Delay, Reverb & Compressor

Stay tuned!
The Fingerlab Team

apple-macos:298883838.name: Fromage
apple-macos:298883838.description:
Use Fromage as your guide to worldwide cheeses, the #1 app preferred by cheese lovers. Fromage provides a convenient pocket resource of fantastic cheeses made throughout the world for your culinary exploration. The cheese library contains well beyond 1,600 world cheeses from over 35 countries and is continuously expanded thanks to suggestions from our established base of Fromage users worldwide.
Each cheese entry features artistically presented cheese photos, historically narrated flavor descriptions, website links to the producer’s dairy or fromager, and suggested best choices for complementary wines. You can add your own favorite cheeses to the standard library and include personal notes about any of the cheeses.
Searching within the library for that special cheese can be by name, country, milk-type, texture, or by your own custom tags (such as #atmystore).
So, if you’re a classically trained chef, professional party planner, cheese buyer, or just plain cheese lover, grab Fromage, your favorite wine, and experience the wonderful and historic flavors of cheese.
_________________________________
Fromage comes with the ability to create personal cheese notes, rate cheeses from 1 to 5 stars (included an “Avoid” rating), add cheeses to your favorite lists (Try, Buy, or Favorites categories), record tasting impressions with up to 70 tasting keywords, and search the cheese library.
You can also enter your own cheeses (including photos captured from your device camera) and list those cheeses automatically in the “My Additions” category. There is also a “Share” feature so cheese information can be sent (via e-mail) to friends or to the developer for inclusion in future versions of Fromage. 
_________________________________
Internet or Wi-Fi connection is not required for program use, which is great for remote locations when no data plan is available.
When internet is available, Fromage uses iCloud to synchronize your cheese entries and notes between all of your Apple devices which can include iPhone, iPad, and Macintosh.
The application provides English, French, Spanish, and German languages when the iOS device settings are set to that language.
_________________________________
From the Developer – 
Hello my name is Steve Welch and I want to thank you for your interest in Fromage. I have enjoyed developing Fromage and bringing great cheeses into your kitchen. 
It is hard to believe this app began nearly 15 years ago with only a handful of French cheeses a short time after the “new” iPhone was introduced to the world. Fromage quickly became a favorite and best seller in the “Food and Drink” category and the first “Cheese” app available in the app store. 
I also wanted to share that I was once a cheese maker myself, although it was some time ago. During the late ‘70’s, I worked summers at being a cheese maker at Rogue Valley Creamery in Oregon USA. Tom Vella was the owner and I made all sorts of cheeses including their vintage artisan Cheddar and Blue cheese’s. It was through this experience and the iPhone platform opportunities that led me to developing Fromage. 
Bon Appétit

firefox-addons:3013986.name: SwiftIn — AI translator
firefox-addons:3013986.summary: Bilingual AI translator for pages, subtitles & PDFs. Write & edit in any input field. 100+ languages, 6+ AI engines.
firefox-addons:3013986.description:
Swiftin is an AI translator and writing assistant for your browser in one extension: bilingual web page translation, dual subtitles for video, PDF and document translation, instant word lookup, and writing help in any text field. One click, and you read, watch and write in any of 100+ languages as if they were your own, and more...
🧭 Bilingual web page translation
• Original and translation side by side, paragraph by paragraph, for easy bilingual reading
• Or fully replace the original with the translation
• Works great where you read every day: news, social media, forums (Reddit, GitHub and more), blogs, documentation, research papers and webmail
• Pick the translation model for the task
💬 Talk and write in any language
• Translate right inside the input field: type in your own language, send in theirs
• Works in chats and messengers, as well as social media, email and any input field
• Improve the wording, fix spelling and grammar, change the tone from formal to friendly
• Rephrase, simplify, shorten or expand the text
📺 Dual subtitles for video
• Two subtitle tracks at once: original and translation over the player
• Support for YouTube, Coursera and Netflix
• Choose the source track and subtitle language
• Download subtitles as an SRT or plain-text file
• Neural translation, natural and context-aware
✨ One-click word lookup · new
A feature ordinary translators don't have. Click a word in the subtitles or select it on the page, and Swiftin builds a mini lesson right there:
• Meaning in context, not a dry dictionary entry
• Usage examples, synonyms and antonyms
• Part of speech and difficulty level
• Pronunciation read aloud
Any video and any article turn into language practice, with no separate flashcard app.
📄 Free document and book translation
• PDF, EPUB, Word, TXT, presentations, spreadsheets and subtitle files
• Document translation on the free engines is available at no cost, no subscription
• Original formatting and layout are preserved
• Articles, manuals, contracts, e-books and study materials
📚 Save words to your dictionary
Every word you look up can become part of your own dictionary.
• Tap a word in the subtitles or selected text, open its card, and save it with the star
• Browse all your saved words and phrases in one place
• Filter by language, part of speech and difficulty level
• Optional cloud sync keeps your dictionary together across your devices
Build your vocabulary as you read and watch.
🖱 Translate selected text
• Select a word or phrase for instant translation
• An explanation in the context of the sentence, not just a dry definition
• Read the original and the translation aloud
🔊 Native-sounding voice
• Natural neural speech: it sounds like a real native speaker, not a robot
• Hear the correct pronunciation of words, phrases and whole paragraphs
• Voice works in the word card and on selected text, for both original and translation
• 70+ languages supported
🪩 More than 6 translation services and models
Claude, GPT, Gemini and more. Switch between them in one click and choose between speed and maximum accuracy.
🧩 Also inside
• 100+ languages, switch in one click
• Optional translation history, enabled in settings
• Privacy by default: your texts are not used to train models
🔵 Why Swiftin 🔵
1⃣ AI translation is available right after sign-up, not only on paid tiers
2⃣ Translation never hits a wall: when the AI limit runs out, free translation keeps working without limits
3⃣ Bilingual mode everywhere: pages, subtitles and documents show original and translation side by side
4⃣ Translate and write right in the input field on any site
5⃣ You control privacy: history and storage are off by default
❓ FAQ
Is Swiftin free? Yes. Translating pages, documents and everything else on the free engines works without limits, plus AI translation on the free plan. For larger volume and more accurate models there are paid plans.
Do I need an API key? No, the built-in engines work right away. If you want, you can connect your own key.
🔒 Privacy
We respect your privacy. The texts you translate are not used to train models, and history and storage are off by default. Details in the privacy policy.
Install Swiftin and understand the internet in any language: pages, video, documents, conversations and every unfamiliar word.

Firefox extension to automatically open websites in a container. Map multiple domains and subdomain to a container with simple csv based config. Once mapped, this extension will always open the site in a container. This behaviour is disabled in private mode.
Usage
Basic mapping:
 amazon.co.uk , Shopping will open all amazon.co.uk (not subdomains) links in Shopping container.
Glob:
!*.amazon.co.uk, Shopping will be treated as *.amazon.co.uk glob pattern. (suitable to subdomains)
Regex:
@.+\.amazon\.co\.uk$, Shopping will be treat as .+\.amazon\.co\.uk$ regex. (suitable to subdomains and complex paths)

bluejetty:00177099:ios.name: Army Merge: Tank Master
bluejetty:00177099:ios.summary: Greetings Commander! You have to unite your troops, merge units and rush into the battlefield on your tank. Will you be able to assemble the most powerful army and defeat everyone? Don't waste your time, download the game and check it out!
bluejetty:00177099:ios.description:
Greetings Commander! You have to unite your troops, merge units and rush into the battlefield on your tank. Will you be able to assemble the most powerful army and defeat everyone? Don't waste your time, download the game and check it out!
Build an Army
In Army Merge: Tank Master, you'll have to merge units, upgrade your tanks and fight across the world. Merging units together raises their level and upgrades their stats. You can also unlock more cells and recruit more units. As you progress through, new types of soldiers, tanks, and other military equipment are revealed to you. Use all your logic, figure out the best strategy and combine your troops like a true commander! Participate in battles around the world and win the war. Prove that your army is the strongest!
Manage your tank.
As a true commander you have to be in the center of the battlefield. Get in the tank and fight together with your soldiers. You can both support your allies from afar, and rush into a crowd of enemies and crash them by yourself! Be careful, if the tank is destroyed, you will lose. But don’t worry, you can always pump up and try again!
Earn currency and spend it on upgrades
After each level you are rewarded with purple crystals. Use them to improve your tank. Upgrade the attack and defense to go as far as possible. In addition, the model of your tank is also changes and it becomes bigger, stronger and more stylish. Make it the most dangerous unit on the battlefield!
Defeat Bosses
From time to time you'll get dangerous opponents - huge monster bosses. Each one of them can cause problems even for the strongest army in the world, so it's best to be careful and not prolong the battle. Fight monsters around the world and protect the planet!
Game Features:
- Unique units, including modern powerful vehicles!
- Lots of upgrades to make your army the most powerful!
- Epic boss battles that won't let you get bored!
- Earn currency and spend it on upgrades
- Nice 3D graphics
- Easy control
- User friendly interfaces
- BUILD AN INVINCIBLE ARMY
Be a real commander, unite your troops, drive the tank and fight together with your allies. Use all your logic to come up with the best strategy and don't forget the upgrades. Take part in battles around the world, defeat huge boss monsters and win the war. Last, but not least - the game is ABSOLUTELY FREE! Download Army Merge: Tank Master right now and join the battlefield!

Welcome to ARCHER, the gay dating app where every profile shows a face. Whether you’re looking for a date, something casual, a friend, or all of the above, you’ll find guys ready to connect.
Aim high, shoot higher with ARCHER, the community for gay dating & social networking! By gay men, for gay men, ARCHER helps you discover just what you’re looking for—from friends to finding your husband. Our app celebrates the diversity of the gay community, providing a welcoming space for everyone, including gay couples. ARCHER offers unique chat and discovery experiences, like profile tags for finding people with common interests. Chat and go on fun dates with cute guys in your area!
ARCHER is an inclusive gay dating app where you can enjoy chatting with other gay men and meeting everyone from bears to twinks, couples to singles, and everything in between. Discover a vibrant gay community on our gay app where gay chatting is not just a feature, but a celebration of connections, friendships, and maybe something more – join the conversation and make meaningful connections today! Whether it’s your last first date, a flirty new fave, or your next brunch bestie, he’s just a tap away.
Informed by a community of gay men, from employees to LGBTQ+ orgs, from our community advocates to speaking with thousands of gay and queer men, ARCHER sets a new gay dating standard.
Whether you’re looking for new friends, a long-term relationship, or anything in between, ARCHER is the only gay dating app you’ll ever need!
What sets ARCHER apart:
*Looking For Modes to help you find a date, a friend, or something casual, when and how you want
*Real-time GPS-enabled maps that turn digital cruising into instant connection by showing who’s nearby, what they’re into, and letting you shoot your shot straight from the map
*Selfie-verified profiles so you know who you’re talking to
*Profile tags that help you find guys into what you’re into, from fitness to food, travel to position
*Messaging to make your move, your way
*Private albums for sharing a little more, when you’re ready
*Communities so you can join conversations that go beyond dating, from gaming to movies
*Add your status and see who’s ready to chat & connect right now
Search Without Secrecy

bluejetty:00042337:ios.description:
Turn big dreams into daily wins.
GoalKit turns every resolution - from finishing a degree to doing 20 push-ups - into a clear, trackable plan you’ll actually stick with.
Why GoalKit?
- Four goal types built for real life:
 1. Checklist Goal – one-and-done tasks (e.g. “Book flight”).
 2. Milestone Goal – break big visions into bite-sized steps (e.g. “Land a job at Apple” → study → internship → portfolio).
 3. Progress Goal – chase a number with a live progress bar (e.g. “Save €2 000 for a MacBook”).
 4. Recurring Goal / Habit – log daily actions and watch your streak grow (e.g. “30 min exercise”).
- AI Assistent – helps creating goals and gives smart tips to reach each goal faster.
- Fresh inspiration – hand-picked quotes delivered every day (you can add custom onces too!).
- Fully customizable UI & icons – make it your goal space.
And most importantly GoalKit is built by a student dev (Apple Swift Student Challenge winner ’23) who uses GoalKit every day—so your feature requests actually get implemented when doable.
Give GoalKit a try—your future self will thank you!

bluejetty:00177926:ios.name: Hydra › Pro Camera (RAW + AI)
bluejetty:00177926:ios.summary: Hydra is a camera app for iPhone & iPad with innovative capture technology that lets you take gorgeous and unique pictures even in challenging lighting conditions. Making use of the latest advances in artificial intelligence & image process
bluejetty:00177926:ios.description:
Hydra is a camera app for iPhone & iPad with innovative capture technology that lets you take gorgeous and unique pictures even in challenging lighting conditions. Making use of the latest advances in artificial intelligence & image processing, Hydra’s independent computational core offers to overcome the physical limits of small sensors, with features such as over 20-stop extreme HDR, detail-enhancing denoising, macro shooting, crisp 6/8x zooming, and a whopping 110-megapixel resolution.
But there's more. Hydra now features a new highly capable manual mode for photo enthusiasts, an improved faster shooting for reduced artifacts, and the addition of a new normal capture mode for everyday photos. It also comes with a number of presets to define your own style as well as a completely new high-fidelity photo editor.
Last but not least, Hydra’s constantly evolving photo capabilities are your best asset to continue enjoying picture quality improvements after device purchase and to obtain state-of-the-art camera innovations all through its lifetime.
“The Hydra app […] is one of the more interesting iOS camera apps we have seen in the recent past.”
— Lars Rehm (DPReview)
“Hydra is for people who enjoy iPhone photography at a higher and more rewarding level.”
— David Robinson (iPhonographer)
“The user interface is particularly well made […] If Apple were to purchase this app, they wouldn't have to change anything in its design.”
— Florian Innocente (Mac Génération)
“Hydra […] is a well thought out and terrific performing photo app with solid features that will improve your images in challenging lighting conditions.”
— Mel Martin (Engadget)
KEY FEATURES
• Refined camera experience for iPhone & iPad.
• Computational photography with artificial intelligence (AI). Neural processing & fusion of RAW sensor data.
• Unique capabilities: extreme HDR (> 20-stop range) to accommodate lighting conditions, superior detail-enhancement and denoising for low-light & macro, up-to-6/8x zooming, and a whopping 110-megapixel resolution. New normal camera mode.
• Versatile viewfinder: approachable ergonomics, tactile input & sensory feedback (1-stop vibrations). “Zebra” exposure previewing.
• Manual mode for precise camera control: focus, ISO, shutter speed, white balance.
• Rich capture options: Apple Watch remote, timer, flash & selfie, geotagging, grid overlay…
• Photo style presets (tonal intent, color rendition…).
• Powerful photo editor for 32-bit non-degrading edits, including tone mapping, detail boosting, precise colorimetry, and Apple ProRAW editing.
• Side-by-side pixel-level comparison with unprocessed RAW input.
• Exhaustive output options with varied file formats, including pro options (JPEG, HEIC, TIFF, TIFF-32, OpenEXR, Radiance, DNG, Apple ProRAW, and next-gen JPEG XL) & color spaces (sRGB, Display P3, ROMM ProPhoto).
• Aftershot: saving to HyperRAW for deferred photo development, including Bracket and Fusion containers.
• Improved saving to Files (iCloud & 3rd-party apps) including shared folders for professional use cases, and folder management.
• Redesigned photo gallery.
• Lock screen and home screen widgets.
• Optimized for latest iOS, Metal, CoreML, and Apple Neural Engine (ANE) for high-speed AI computations on Apple Silicon.
• Privacy first: full on-device processing, privacy filter for social sharing.
PRICING
The free app offers unrestricted shooting in normal mode (auto & manual), including RAW, HyperRAW & Apple ProRAW (compatible devices only). Other capture modes & restrictions can be unlocked either with the Pro Pack 3 one-time purchase, or with the Pro Plan subscription. Upgrade pricing is available within the app for previous version owners.
MORE INFO
Website: https://creaceed.com/ihydra
Privacy Policy: https://creaceed.com/privacy
Terms of Use: https://creaceed.com/terms
Feedback: hydra@creaceed.com

bluejetty:00121107:ios.description:
Crazy Eights is the popular card game that practically everyone has played in some form – a real classic! 
Play it on your smartphone or tablet now, no additional registration necessary – you can play offline and online and your progress is saved via your store account! 
Play offline against the computer or create an online room for up to 6 players to play with your friends and family. You can also challenge players from all over the world and use the emoji chat to communicate. If you are looking for a challenge, try to claim a spot in the global leaderboard and unlock amazing achievements. The game is highly customizable, you can adjust rules, color theme, card design and the look of the game scene to your liking.
The basic rules of Crazy Eights are simple and quick to learn, and you’ll find instructions and explanations for all standard rulesets we offer in the app: 101, 8 américain, Crazy Eights, Mau Mau, Switch, Pesten & Macau 
As there are so many variations, our version also offers custom rules that can be completely customized! Play by the rules you know and create your own ruleset!
Features:
- Play offline and online for free
- Supports both portrait and landscape mode
- Use portrait or landscape mode 
- Choose from 7 rulesets or create your own
- Enjoy games for up to 6 players
- Express yourself through emojis
- Customize the look of the game 
- Unlock amazing achievements
With its numerous variants, Crazy Eights is without question the most successful card game in the world. In order to win, you need the right strategy and a good hand – every round is different, so the game guarantees unlimited fun! 
The app is offered with high-quality localization in the following languages: English, Dutch, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish and Turkish
Crazy Eights is just the right game for all friends of card and family games - play for free now!
If you need help, visit: https://www.lite.games/support/
Crazy Eights is an advertiser funded app, i.e. ads are presented within the app. If you prefer to use the app without ads we do offer a "no ads" setting as auto-renewable subscription. You have the choice between the following options:
- 1 month for $0.99 or equivalent (subscription renews after 1 month)
- 3 months for $1.99 or equivalent (subscription renews after 3 months)
- 1 year for $4.49 or equivalent (subscription renews after 1 year)
Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. The subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period. 
The account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period with the amount the selected option costs. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
General terms and conditions: http://tc.lite.games
Privacy Policy: http://privacy.lite.games
Visit us for more free games:
https://www.lite.games
https://www.facebook.com/LiteGames

The New York Times

I have less bad days...and when I have bad days, they disperse more quickly, and they're not as severe as they were before Happify." - Jessica G., West Park, FL
YOU KNOW YOUR GOALS. WE KNOW HOW YOU CAN ACHIEVE THEM.
Choose one track. Choose them all.
* Conquering negative thoughts
* Coping better with stress
* Building self-confidence
* Fueling your career success
* Achieving mindfulness through meditation
* …and 65+ more!

bluejetty:00074009:ios.description:
Explore key ideas from books with Wiser. Read and listen to book summaries covering productivity, business, negotiation, money, investing, health, relationships, and personal development.
Discover different perspectives through short summaries that fit into your daily routine. Wiser offers written and audio summaries to help you explore topics and revisit ideas that interest you.
READ AND LISTEN TO BOOK SUMMARIES
Browse summaries by title or author and explore topics related to your interests. Choose a written summary or listen to an audio version when it suits your routine.
Wiser focuses on key ideas from books through summaries rather than full-length ebooks or audiobooks.
PERSONALIZE YOUR READING EXPERIENCE
Adjust font sizes and color themes to suit your reading preferences. Highlight passages, bookmark titles, and return to ideas you want to review.
Explore recommendations based on your goals and set reading or listening goals to help organize your learning routine.
REVISIT KEY IDEAS
Use the Spaced Repetition feature to review insights over time. Return to selected ideas from summaries and make review part of your reading routine.
EXPLORE DAILY READ
Discover a featured book summary through Daily Read. Explore a topic that interests you or consider a perspective you might not have encountered before.
ACCESS SUMMARIES ONLINE AND OFFLINE
Read or listen online, or download available summaries for offline access. Keep selected summaries on your device to revisit later.
MAKE ROOM FOR PERSONAL DEVELOPMENT
Explore summaries about habits, mindfulness, motivation, business, and other areas of personal development. Whether you want to discover a new topic or revisit a familiar idea, Wiser helps you bring reading and listening into your day.
Subscriptions are offered as auto-renewable plans on a weekly, monthly, or yearly basis (pricing may vary by country). Payment will be charged to your Apple ID account at confirmation of purchase. Your subscription will automatically renew unless it is canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the current billing period, and your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel your subscription at any time through your Apple Account Settings after purchase. If a free trial is offered, any unused portion of the trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.

bluejetty:00122902:ios.description:
Los Angeles Federal Credit Union puts everyday banking at your fingertips safely & securely 24/7 with our LAFCU Mobile App. Whether you want to check your account balance, view your account info, or make and edit payments – you can do it all from your mobile device. 
Features included are:
Dashboard - Manage all of your LAFCU accounts with one dashboard. View your available funds, your upcoming payments, how much you’ve deposited, progress towards your savings goals, and personalized recommendations just for you all in a single easy-to-read screen.
Accounts - View and manage all of your cash accounts. Review recent transactions, see current balances, make transfers, pay loans, and search for specific payments or deposits.
Mobile Deposits – Deposit checks into your LAFCU account anytime and anywhere.
Bill Pay - Schedule or manually make payments on your bills through our easy-to-use bill pay system.
Fund Transfers - Send funds to and from your connected accounts at other financial institutions through our funds transfer capability. 
Alerts – Set up and manage account alerts, including LAFCU VISA® credit cards.
Card Controls – Control when, where, and how your debit card and credit cards are used. Lock and unlock your card, report a lost card, set travel plans, initiate a dispute, and more.
Statements – View and download statements and tax forms
Since 1936, Los Angeles Federal Credit Union has remained a strong and secure financial institution that is committed to providing the best financial services to its members and residents of Southern California. That’s why we developed the LAFCU Mobile app to manage your everyday banking needs.
To enjoy the convenience of our app, you must be a Los Angeles Federal Credit Union member and be enrolled in our online banking service. If you are already a member, simply download this mobile app. To join the credit union, visit www.LAFCU.org, then after joining, download the app.

bluejetty:00066383:ios.name: Infinite Galaxy
bluejetty:00066383:ios.developer: Hong Kong Ke Mo software Co., Limited
bluejetty:00066383:ios.summary:
Infinite Galaxy. Infinite possibilities. This is a next generation immersive, space game. With top 3D graphics and deep strategic choices to choose from, the secrets of the entire Galaxy are waiting for you to discover.
Galaxy Year 4649.
bluejetty:00066383:ios.description:
Infinite Galaxy. Infinite possibilities. This is a next generation immersive, space game. With top 3D graphics and deep strategic choices to choose from, the secrets of the entire Galaxy are waiting for you to discover.
Galaxy Year 4649. After the long war, the Old Federation was unfortunately defeated, but the Empire’s cruel reign is also on the verge of collapse. The borders of the burning Galaxy have already been broken. Private merchants and space pirates shuttle back and forth in the universe. Countless rebel groups have risen to fight from the Empire’s outer rim without any time to spare. Rumor has it that someone discovered the mysterious warships of an ancient space race...
In this Galaxy full of fantasy and conflict, you can start by repairing your Spaceport. Then you will build your flagship, defeat space pirates, explore the Galaxy, form an alliance with like-minded Commanders, and come across one moving story after another. 
An enormous fleet is waiting for you to lead.
A marvelous Spaceport is waiting for you to develop.
An Infinite Galaxy is waiting for you to explore.
But the Empire is preparing its counterattack in the shadows of the Galaxy. The next time the Empire flashes its teeth, an endless war will once again be ignited in the Infinite Galaxy.
Spaceport & Crew
- Tons of facilities and tech are waiting for you to build and research.
- Upgrade every type of building to transform your Spaceport into a powerful base.
- Recruit mighty crew members in your Spaceport. Make them become your deputies and staff or go on fleet expeditions.
- Every crew member has their own life experiences and stories. Their tales will make you aware of how completely different life in space is.
Fleets & Flagships
- Build up 30 different types of Spaceships and form fleets.
- Every one of your fleets will be led by an extremely powerful flagship. Every flagship has its own unique appearance and skills.
- These flagships are carefully built based on the blueprints handed down from the heyday of the Federation and Empire.
- Collect flagship blueprints from ancient space relics, campaign missions, and the Empire’s fortress stages.
Battle & Glory
- In the Galaxy, compete or work together with millions of Commanders in real-time. An excellent way to survive is to create or join a formidable alliance.
- Call upon your allies to deploy your attack and defense strategies, protect yourself, and battle malicious enemies in the universe.
- Fully display your talents for strategy, leadership, and battle. Join this magnificent space epic.
- Perhaps you will become the leader of the Galaxy and achieve supreme glory in the end.
Space & Secrets
- Space is incredibly imposing and makes you aware of how small we really are. This is especially true in the presence of a gigantic star.
- But as tiny as we may seem, we will go on to conquer that enormous star and explore deep in the universe.
- On your exploration of the universe, you will slowly uncover tons of ancient secrets and learn the unknown past of Federation and Empire.

bluejetty:00169798:ios.description:
Clip is a video diary made of one second a day. Add a short moment from each day, and Clip turns your days into a recap video you keep and share: a month, a year, a trip, or your whole life so far.
HOW IT WORKS
1. Add today's moment. Record it in the app or pick a video from your photo library, then trim the one to five seconds you want to keep.
2. Keep going. Your Journal project fills up day by day, and your streak shows how many days in a row you've captured.
3. Make a recap. Pick all your moments, one month or hand-picked days, and Clip plays them back in order as one video.
WHY PEOPLE KEEP A CLIP DIARY
• One second every day takes a few taps, so the habit sticks.
• Relive a whole year in a couple of minutes: birthdays, trips, a pregnancy, a baby's first year, or ordinary Tuesdays.
• Journal project for everyday life, Freestyle projects for a trip, a wedding or any event, with moments in the order you choose.
• Auto-Fill picks moments from videos already in your photo library for days you missed. Keep or discard each suggested moment.
• Notes let you write down the story behind any day.
• Daily reminders nudge you to add today's moment.
• Auto Backup to your own iCloud keeps projects and moments in sync across your devices.
• No ads, ever.
CLIP PREMIUM
• Longer moments: up to 5 seconds each.
• Add music: from our library, iTunes or the cloud, to any recap.
• High resolution: export recaps in 1080p or 4K.
• No end card: your recap is entirely yours.
• Unlimited Freestyle projects.
• Collaboration: add moments to a shared project with friends and family.
• Extra filters for every moment.
Try Premium free before you subscribe. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when the free trial ends, and the subscription renews automatically unless you cancel at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Manage or cancel it in your App Store account settings.
One moment a day. Start today, and in a year you'll have a video of it.
Privacy Policy: https://get-clip.app/privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://get-clip.app/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00031850:ios.description:
Manage your blood sugar and lose weight without stress,
by detecting and tracking unhealthy ultra-processed food.
Created by Registered Dietitians and Diabetes Care Specialists.
Track your meals, get instant feedback, and find healthy options with the GoCoCo App!
Type 2 diabetes and prediabetes-friendly, allergy-safe, and gluten-free diets made easy.
Enjoy the benefits regular GoCoCo users see:
- 85% consume fewer ultraprocessed foods
- 84% manage better their diabetes
- 89% consider the app helps them lose weight
- 86% feel better after using GoCoCo for some time
Eat Healthier, Live Happier: Using the GoCoCo App, making smart choices about what you eat has never been easier! Start your journey today and see positive changes in your blood sugar levels and your weight. Some users already improve their blood sugar management after one week!
• Track What Matters: Snap pictures of your meals and instantly analyze them with our Meal Tracker. Find out calories, carbohydrates, and get personalized nutrition improvement insights in just seconds. Reduce your intake of ultra-processed foods and increase fruits and vegetables in your diet to improve your health. 
•Scan & Score: Instantly evaluate products in your purchase on a healthy food scale from 1 to 10 based on WHO guidelines, ideal for managing type 2 diabetes, prediabetes, weight loss, and maintaining balanced nutrition in the long run.
•Lose Weight Without Stress: With GoCoCo, you can lose weight without exhausting calorie counting. Just cutting back on ultra-processed foods may help you naturally eat 500 fewer calories per day - without strict dieting or complicated math!
•Identify Additives & Food Dyes: Ensure your food is free from potentially harmful additives and dyes that are banned in certain states, such as Red No. 3 or Red No. 40.
•Food Ingredient Tracker & Warning system: Scan to detect high levels of hidden added sugars (fructose, dextrose, juices...), salts, saturated fats, and ultra-processed additives.
•Blood Sugar Alert: Check if the product is suitable for a type 2 diabetes and prediabetes diet.
•Curated lists of healthy products: Lists of food categories with the best products from your supermarket.
•Alternatives for products with a low score: After scanning a product, you can instantly get a list of alternatives with a better nutritional score.
•Community Approved: Join over 800,000 users who trust our app, as featured on MasterChef.
•Comprehensive Database: Compatible with 600,000+ grocery items and food labels.
Specific benefits you will get if you have type 2 diabetes or prediabetes:
•Get instant insights about the quality of your diet.
•Learn how to reduce your intake of ultra-processed foods, which is associated with better blood sugar control and weight management!
•A Blood Sugar Alert that will help you make the best decisions when shopping, to avoid blood sugar spikes with ease.
•All this validated by our team of Registered Dietitians and Diabetes Care Specialists.

bluejetty:00153026:ios.description:
GrowMe is a versatile app designed for those who are passionate about learning and self-growth through reading. Whether you're short on time, looking to build better reading habits, or seeking personalized book guidance, GrowMe helps transform every book into a valuable source of growth and inspiration.
What GrowMe offers:
- Quick book summaries to help you grasp key insights in just minutes.
- Audio learning so you can listen to curated book ideas anywhere, anytime.
- A smart highlight saver to capture and organize your favorite quotes or lessons for easy access.
- Personalized book recommendations crafted to match your unique goals and interests.
- Progress tracking tools to help you create consistent reading habits and celebrate your milestones.
- Daily bits of inspiration to keep you motivated and curious every single day.
- 28-Day Plans tailored to different themes, helping you stay focused and achieve specific goals.
Who can benefit from GrowMe:
- Professionals seeking impactful learning that fits into their busy lives.
- Students aiming to understand complex ideas more efficiently.
- Book lovers who want to revisit and retain the best takeaways from their readings.
- Self-improvement enthusiasts ready to turn new ideas into actions.
Great books can open doors to life-changing ideas—but only if the knowledge is absorbed and applied. GrowMe makes that process simple, engaging, and fulfilling. It’s not just a reading tool—it’s your partner in transforming books into a journey of learning and growth.
Start your growth journey with GrowMe today and turn every book into a meaningful step forward.
Subscription Information:
Our subscription plans include $12.99/month with no trial, $29.99 for 3 months with no trial, and $79.99/year with a 7-day free trial, granting unlimited access to VIP features during the subscription period. During the trial period, you can manage your subscription and cancel by going to your 'Account Settings.' After being charged, you may turn off auto-renewal by visiting the same section. Your subscription will automatically renew unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the end of the current period. When canceling a subscription, it will remain active until the end of the period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but no refunds will be issued for the current subscription. Any unused portion of a free trial period will be forfeited upon purchasing a subscription.
Contact Information:
Privacy Policy: https://enerjoy.life/privacy-policy
Term of Use: https://enerjoy.life/terms-of-use
iOS App Support: https://enerjoy.life/contact-us/

REBEL is the holistic wellbeing app for employees and individuals—bringing mental health, fitness, and nutrition together in one place.
Whether you’re managing stress, improving sleep, boosting energy, or building a consistent routine, REBEL gives you the support to feel better—anytime, anywhere.

A complete wellbeing program in your pocket

REBEL combines guided mental health support, effective workouts, and practical nutrition so you can make progress without needing a gym, a retreat, or a specialist restaurant.

CARE – Mental wellbeing & resilience

Build a daily habit to reduce stress and feel more in control with science-backed practices and expert support.

Mental wellbeing assessments

Guided meditations for stress, focus, anxiety & calm

Sleep audio and wind-down routines

Stretch & recovery sessions

Self-care and motivational talks

1:1 support with coaches and wellbeing experts (availability may vary by region and plan)

SWEAT – Fitness anywhere

From beginner-friendly sessions to structured programs, train at home, outdoors, or in the gym—often with minimal or no equipment.

HIIT, fat loss & cardio

Strength & muscle-building

Pilates, yoga, mobility & stretching

Calisthenics & bodyweight training

Abs, glutes, full-body programs

7, 15 & 30-day programs for progressive improvement

Options for dumbbells, kettlebells, bands, jump rope (optional)

1:1 training with coaches (availability may vary)

EAT – Nutrition made simple

Eat better without overthinking it. Learn the fundamentals and cook delicious meals with easy recipes.

Practical guidance from nutrition experts

Healthy recipes for breakfast, lunch, dinner & snacks

Quick 15-minute meals

Everyday nutrition tips to build better habits

Built for everyday life (and workplace wellbeing)

REBEL is ideal for busy schedules—supporting employees and individuals with tools that fit real routines. Whether you’re using REBEL as part of an employee wellbeing program or for personal goals, you’ll find content to match your day and your energy.

Steps & Tracking

REBEL integrates with Apple Health / HealthKit to track steps and help you compare daily and weekly movement against your goals.

Subscriptions

We offer two auto-renewing subscriptions:

REBEL Plus Monthly: $4.99/month

REBEL Plus Yearly: $28.49/year (introductory offer)

Payment will be charged to your Apple ID at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or cancel in Apple Account Settings after purchase.

Terms: https://www.rebelwithus.com/terms

Privacy Policy: https://www.rebelwithus.com/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00060830:ios.name: ActiveCampaign
bluejetty:00060830:ios.summary: The ActiveCampaign app keeps you connected to your customers, not your computer. In a mobile society, if you're not able to run your business in the way your customers live their lives, you’re missing the mark. The ActiveCampaign mobile app
bluejetty:00060830:ios.description:
The ActiveCampaign app keeps you connected to your customers, not your computer. In a mobile society, if you're not able to run your business in the way your customers live their lives, you’re missing the mark. The ActiveCampaign mobile app keeps your most important data (and your business’s pulse) at your fingertips.
A streamlined, intuitive interface lets you easily review important campaign and automation performance metrics whenever you want, and the built-in CRM lets users manage their entire sales team and pipeline from the field.
Whether you’re a solopreneur or enterprise, the ActiveCampaign mobile app lets businesses of all sizes manage their business how (and where and when) they want.
What you can do with the ActiveCampaign app:
MARKETING REPORTS AND ANALYTICS
Easily track your most important marketing campaigns and automations with detailed performance metrics like opens, click throughs, link performance, generated revenue, and A/B tests.
CRM & SALES AUTOMATION
The ActiveCampaign app has everything you need for the salesperson on-the-go. Review detailed lead and B2B activity, create and manage deals, make calls, and get push notifications while you’re in the field.
CONTACTS & LEAD MANAGEMENT
Dive into individual contact records to view the personal details and account activity of your leads and contacts, including those imported from popular integrations like Gmail and Outlook. Manage deals, lists, tags, and add notes in-app. Call or email contacts directly from their contact page — or connect to your existing app to send SMS messages.
About ActiveCampaign:
ActiveCampaign's category-defining Customer Experience Automation Platform (CXA) helps over 180,000 businesses in 170 countries meaningfully engage with their customers. The platform gives businesses of all sizes access to 750+ pre-built automations that combine transactional email and email marketing, marketing automation and CRM for powerful segmentation and personalization across social, email, messaging, chat and text. Over 70% of ActiveCampaign's customers use its 870+ integrations including Microsoft, Shopify, Square, Facebook and Salesforce. ActiveCampaign scores higher in customer satisfaction than any other solution in Marketing Automation, CRM and E-Commerce Personalization on G2.com and is the Top Rated Email Marketing Software on TrustRadius. Pricing starts at just $9/month. Start a free trial at ActiveCampaign.com.
If you enjoy using ActiveCampaign, we’d appreciate a review. If something’s not working right, or you have a great idea you’d like to share, we’d love to hear from you at app-feedback@activecampaign.com.
Note: The ActiveCampaign app requires a paid ActiveCampaign account.

PUZZLE GLOW comprised of shapes, lines, colors, numbers and symbols. 
It’s easy to learn and fun to master. You can grow your problem-solving skills!
Enjoy thought-provoking fun with the addictive puzzle games.
You can not stop playing such games that will increase your brain! 
Are you ready? Free download and play the all in one classic puzzle games now!
FEATURES
• Simple but innovative puzzles!
• Suit for all ages!
• Clean and simple graphics !
• Support mobile phones & tablets as an universal app.
• No WI-FI, Offline game! Enjoy the game everywhere!
• No time limit! Play with enough time!
• Top rated games! Many people like the PUZZLE GLOW!
PUZZLE GLOW includes puzzle games as below:
NUMBER LINK
• Draw the glow line to connect same color bulbs.
• Connect all dots on the board. In other words, fill the all cells.
• Challenge 900 stages!
FILL LINE
• Draw the line by given figures (shapes).
• Fill up the entire board by just one line.
• Challenge 900 stages!
HEXA BLOCK
• Drag hexagonal blocks & place them on the board.
• Fill the all cells.
• Challenge 900 stages!
SLIDING PUZZLE
• Move the blocks and connect the wires between the bulbs.
• When all wires are connected, bulbs light up.
• Challenge 900 stages!
SQUARE BLOCK
• It’s another fun game with hexa block.
• Drag square blocks & place them on the board.
• Fill the all cells.
• Challenge 900 stages!
ONE TOUCH PUZZLE
• Draw the line by given figures (shapes).
• Connect all dots by just one touch (line/stroke).
• Challenge 450 stages!
MORE PUZZLES
• In addition to the puzzle games listed above, there are more games available.
• We will add new puzzle games continuously.
NOTE
• PUZZLE GLOW contains the ads include banner, interstitial and video ads.
• PUZZLE GLOW sells in-app products like hints, gems or AD-FREE.
• PUZZLE GLOW requires some permissions to optimize the game and integrate some services.
- Network access and view connections, Receive data from internet, Storage, Photos/Media/Files, Prevent sleeping, Vibration control, Etc.

[아이 스스로 듣는 경험, 코코지]
코코지 키즈는 하루 평균 90분 동안 화면 없는 오디오 콘텐츠를 들어요.
‘코코지 플레이어’에 
아이가 좋아하는 캐릭터 ‘아띠’를 올리면
아이 스스로 원하는 이야기를 선택하고 
오디오 타임을 즐길 수 있어요.
코코지 플레이어가 없을 땐,
앱에서 바로 콘텐츠를 들을 수도 있어요. 
[아이 연령에 딱 맞는 오디오 콘텐츠]
동요부터 동화, 영어, 과학, 인문 교양, 인성 교육 콘텐츠까지! 
아이 나이와 관심사에 딱 맞는 콘텐츠를 장르별로 마음껏 들을 수 있어요.
[생각하는 힘이 자라는, 건강한 콘텐츠]
자극적인 요소는 배제하고, 
안전하고 유익한 콘텐츠만 엄선했어요.
광고 없이 무해한 오디오 타임을 즐겨보세요.
[아이를 위해 엄선한 프리미엄 콘텐츠]
- 코코지 키즈 콘텐츠 전문팀이 제작한 kokozi original, 오직 코코지에서만 들을 수 있어요!
- 핑크퐁, 베베핀, 뽀로로, 엄마까투리, 로보카폴리 등 인기 캐릭터 콘텐츠 총집합
- 마법천자문, 벌거벗은 한국사 등 인기 콘텐츠 독점 제공
- 대교, 아람출판사, 북이십일, 애플비북스 등 인기 출판사 오디오북, 야물야물, 베이비올 등 베스트 전집까지 모두 코코지에서 들을 수 있어요
[쉽고 편리한 앱 기능]
■ 홈 & 검색
- 코코지가 엄선한 추천 콘텐츠를 한눈에 
- 동요, 동화 장르별/인기별 둘러보기
- 검색을 통해 아이가 원하는 콘텐츠 빠르게 찾기
■ 플레이어 연동 
- 코코지 플레이어 등록 및 재생
- 음량 조절, LED 밝기 조절
- 아띠에 새로운 콘텐츠 담기(교체) 기능 
- 내가 갖고 있는 아띠 컬렉션 확인 
■ 보관함
- 코코지 앱의 다양한 콘텐츠로, 우리 아이만을 위한 플레이리스트 만들기
- 사랑하는 가족 목소리 녹음하여 아띠에 담기
- 내가 갖고 있는 모든 콘텐츠 한눈에 모아보기
[문의사항]
∙ 고객 지원 : https://help.kokozi.house
∙ FAQ : 코코지 앱 > 마이페이지 > 도움말

bluejetty:00131522:ios.description:
Plan Your Dream Day with The Knot: The #1 Rated Free Wedding Planner App
NEW! Introducing The Knot's Peace of Mind Program
Plan your wedding with total confidence thanks to The Knot’s Peace of Mind Program. As the wedding industry's first safety net program for last-minute vendor cancellations, we’re here to protect your big day. If an eligible vendor cancels close to your wedding date, our dedicated support team steps in to help you rebook a replacement vendor and cover up to $500 of any price difference. Say goodbye to last-minute panic and hello to stress-free planning!
From the moment you say "yes" to walking down the aisle, The Knot Wedding Planner App makes planning your big day seamless, organized, and fun. Whether you need a customizable wedding countdown, a top-rated wedding registry, or an easy guest list manager, our all-in-one planning tools are here to bring your vision to life.
EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO PLAN YOUR WEDDING
Wedding Countdown: Track the days, hours, and minutes until you say "I do" with a personalized, shareable countdown screen.
Wedding Registry: Easily create and manage your registry. Combine physical gifts, cash funds, honeymoon funds, and experiences in one place. NEW! Link a Venmo account to your cash funds so guests can give seamlessly.
Guest List & RSVPs: Track responses, manage meal preferences, organize contact details, and update your guest list in real-time.
Wedding Venues & Vendors: Discover, compare, and message local wedding venues, photographers, florists, caterers, and bridal vendors.
Save the Dates & Invitations: Browse matching stationery, digital invitations, and save-the-date cards that pair seamlessly with your wedding aesthetic.
Seating Chart & Budget Tools: Keep your wedding budget on track and build interactive seating arrangements with ease.
Custom Wedding Website: Share event details, schedule updates, travel info, and registry links directly with your guests.
Wedding Style Quiz & Inspiration: Take our Style Quiz to discover your unique wedding vision. Create a wedding inspiration board full of wedding dresses, decor, and color palettes to share with your vendors and bridal party.
WHY COUPLES LOVE THE KNOT
Join millions of couples who trust The Knot to streamline their wedding planning journey. From finding the perfect wedding venue to sending digital invitations and managing guest list details, everything you need is right at your fingertips—100% free.
Download The Knot: Wedding Planner App today and start planning your dream wedding!

bluejetty:00092878:android.description:
EnGen is the world’s first personalized language learning app that adapts to students’ and employees’ unique learning needs in real-time. Join over 4 million learners and discover how our efficient methodology and powerful technology will change the way you learn English.
EnGen works on your computer, tablet, and smartphone. Your course will be synched and up to date across all of these devices.
How it Works
Rather than teaching phrases that are not relevant to our learner’s needs like “Janie kicks the ball”, we deliver real English content that is updated daily. EnGen's learners study in context with videos of people accomplishing daily tasks, audio recordings of real-life situations, karaoke-style music lessons, and up-to-date news stories from leading media companies like the Associated Press.
Premium Features
- Multiplatform: Learn everywhere on any device: mobile, tablet or computer
- Lessons updated daily: Learn from fluent speakers accomplishing real-world tasks
- Private tutoring: Schedule a session & receive feedback.
- Unlimited Access & Real-time progress tracking

bluejetty:00017035:ios.description:
"The boxing game we deserve." 8/10 – Gamezebo
"A big, brash boxing game that's surprising tactical at heart." 8/10 – Pocket Gamer
"Stunning graphics powered by Unreal Engine 4." — App Advice
"Not just a button masher." – Slide to Play
FIGHT FOR GLORY
Enter the ring and get into epic punch-out matches in the ultimate free fighting game for mobile. Face dangerous opponents in the ring and score a knockout! Explore the world of pro boxing and make your way to the top – You can become the boxing champion, the best of all time! Welcome to the best of fun fighting games and get ready to punch hard, boxer.
JOIN AN ENDLESS MMO FIGHTING EXPERIENCE
Challenge an elite of boxing games champions and players from around the world of punching games: fight night or day in single and multiplayer gameplay modes across hundreds of exciting events, story mode, and smackdown tournaments.
ENGAGE IN FAST PACED ON-THE-RING ACTION
Become the ultimate boxer. Master jabs, hooks, uppercuts & combine them with devastating Special Punches and Focus abilities. As in the top free fighting games, you can create the ultimate combos to KO your opponent in a fierce smackdown. Nothing is more satisfying in a boxing game or a mma game than an early knockout!
BATTLE AGAINST UNIQUE BOSSES
Here’s a new spin on punching games: take on a unique type of challenging opponent, each one available to challenge for a limited time. Clown? Check. Santa? Yeah he’s there. Golem of the rocky variety? You bet. Defeat them all to claim their epic gear!
CHOOSE YOUR STYLE OF BOXING GAME
Before the true punch-out begins, develop your boxer’s stats and unlock new abilities to level up your fighting game. Equip powerful boosts to create your own unique fighting playstyle. It’s a bit like wrestling or mma : it’s best to enter the punch-out and serve a smackdown in style. The true punching games are about to begin and a knockout is in the air!
UNLOCK HUNDREDS OF POWERFUL ITEMS
On the rocky path to becoming a boxing champion you gain access to a huge number of unique, upgradable and customizable gear, enhancing fighting stats and abilities of your boxer one step, one punch, one round at a time.
CREATE THE ULTIMATE BOXING FIGHTER
Use a robust set of options to create your own boxer – from body mass and muscle sculpture, to details as small as nose shape, fun fighting games like this let you create your own fighter.
CONNECT WITH FRIENDS
Feeling like becoming a champion and playing fight games with friends? Invite them over and punch out them in real-time PVP action to find out who’s the best boxer right here and now. Fight for the quickest knockout and best scores across a variety of leaderboards.
PLAY EXCITING MINI-GAMES
Fun fighting games included: train your fighter in exciting mini-games and try your luck in the Daily Lottery for a chance to win awesome rewards.
FEEL THE POWER OF UNREAL ENGINE 4
It’s the fight night time: witness jaw-dropping graphics fully utilizing the power of Unreal Engine 4 technology to create the most dynamic knockout experience and the best of visually stunning MMO free fighting games.
Real Boxing 2 is free to download and play, however, some game items can also be purchased for real money. If you don't want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device's settings. A network connection is also required.
By downloading the game you accept our End User License Agreement, Terms of Service and Privacy Policy: http://support.vividgames.com/policies
Contact us anytime at support@vividgames.com
Follow Real Boxing 2 on Facebook: www.facebook.com/realboxing.
So do you like punching games: boxing, wrestling, mma, ufc game? Join the club, create your boxer and start playing Real Boxing 2 – the ultimate experience among free fighting games!

bluejetty:00087358:ios.description:
This digital hymnal/hymnbook features:
- Thousands of Christian hymns, spanning the best of Christian sentiment from the third century to the present day.
- Database of hymns including classics, new tunes, new songs, scripture songs, and children's songs.
- Multiple language support, including Cebuano, Dutch, French, Spanish, Tagalog, and Chinese traditional and simplified, with pinyin transliteration.
- Chords and sheet music for guitar and piano (requires network connection).
- Hymn information, including key, time signature, meter, and scripture reference.
Special features:
- Access hymn lyrics both online and offline.
- Look up hymns quickly using the standardized hymn numbers 1-1348 as published in Hymns, by Living Stream Ministry.
- Search full hymn lyrics with keyword search feature.
- Swipe to browse between consecutive hymns.
- Easily share lyrics to external apps including SMS, GroupMe, Facebook, WhatsApp, WeChat, and more. 
- Adjust font size.
- Play hymn instrumentals with pop-up music player controls (requires network connection).
- Tag hymns with custom categories for future access.
Coming soon:
- Advanced search options (search by first line only, exact phrase, etc.).
- Quick hymn lookup in other language versions.
- Dark mode

bluejetty:00147427:ios.summary:
