bluejetty:00147427:ios.description:
We have thousands of people on Mesh Local that want to meet you. You just haven’t met them yet. Sign up, and we'll introduce you : )
We built Mesh Local to make it easier: no swiping, no awkward one-on-ones, just small group meetups at local venues like coffee shops, breweries, cafes, and third places around your city.
Mesh Local helps you build your social life one week at a time.
HOW MESH LOCAL WORKS
1. Get a weekly invite
 We send you a text with a time and a local venue. You decide if you want to go that week. No pressure.
2. Tap “yep” or “nope”
 Open the link, say yes or no, and we’ll take it from there.
3. Meet your group
 We curate a small group of around 4 people using your profile and personality quiz. You get your group’s photos before the meetup and a group chat to help you organize any last-minute details, then show up with a smile and have fun.
Try your first Mesh Local for free.
WHAT YOU CAN JOIN
Coffee Saturday
Meet a small group at a local coffee shop or cafe.
Mesh Local Night
Meet people at local breweries, bars, and night venues.
Mesh Local Events
Host or join casual events around your city. Want to start a run club, game night, coffee meetup, dinner, Bible study, book club, brewery night, or something completely your own? You can host your own event for free, and Mesh Local helps curate the people so it feels easier, safer, and more natural.
Every Mesh Local is designed to feel simple, public, and low-pressure. We usually send multiple groups to the same location, so the energy feels social without being overwhelming.
WHY PEOPLE USE MESH LOCAL
• Make friends in real life
• Meet new people in your city
• Explore local coffee shops, cafes, breweries, and third places
• Host your own events for free
• Join small group meetups curated by Mesh Local
• You Just moved to a new city!
• Try something better than swiping
• Meet in a group instead of one-on-one
• Build a real social life, one week at a time
Mesh Local is not a dating app, but it is a great way to put yourself out there and meet real people naturally. If you are tired of dating apps, endless DMs, or trying to make friends from scratch, Mesh Local gives you a reason to get out of the house and meet people in person.
And if you already have an idea for bringing people together, Mesh Local gives you the tools to do it. You choose the event. Mesh Local helps with the curation.
Connections are always in public, in a group setting. We never sell your data.
We are currently sending invites in Madison, Milwaukee, Nashville, Charlotte, Raleigh, Saint Louis, and Minneapolis.
Don’t see your city yet? Sign up anyway. We’ll text you when Mesh Local launches near you.
Once a city hits enough signups, we start sending invites so people have a better chance of meeting others around their age and stage of life. If you want Mesh Local in your city faster, share it with your friends or host an event to help bring people together.
We’re kind of like TimeLeft, but for coffee, third places, hosted events, and small group meetups around your city.
Try your first Mesh Local for free.
Make friends over coffee.
Host your own events for free.
Build your social life one week at a time.
Terms of Service:
https://www.mesh-local.com/terms

bluejetty:00181318:ios.description:
Aqui na ADBENS, somos estimulados a encontrar soluções inovadoras e sustentáveis para as demandas particulares de cada cliente, zelando pela qualidade de nossas entregas.
Tanto pelo site da ADBENS quanto pelo aplicativo, os moradores, síndicos, conselheiros, funcionários e prestadores de serviço do condomínio podem realizar suas tarefas e organizar suas rotinas de forma simples, rápida, eficiente e acima de tudo de qualquer lugar e a qualquer hora.
Com a ADBENS, a vida em condomínio é muito mais inteligente. Funcionalidades (variam conforme o plano habilitado):
- cadastro completo de condôminos, seus veículos, animais de estimação e outros moradores da unidade
- comunicação entre síndico e moradores com controle de pendências, grupos de discussão, achados e perdidos, avisos, manutenção, etc (com moderação).
- reservas no salão de festas, mudanças e outras agendas,
- acesso ao regimento e demais documentos do condomínio,
- boletos das taxas mensais - prestação de contas interativa mês a mês com anexos dos comprovantes e aprovação online da pasta
- visão da evolução dos gastos por conta e grupo de conta (Gastos com água, energia, contratos, manutenções, etc)
- comparativo de orçado versus realizado (gráficos e detalhamento)
- visão da inadimplência (relatórios e gráficos)
- gestão de contratos com terceiros
- gestão de manutenções preventivas e periódicas
- gestão e comunicação de multas e advertências com direito a defesa,
- visão da relação de funcionários e corpo diretivo do condomínio,
- cadastro de fornecedores e prestadores de serviço,
- acesso aos dados de departamento pessoal (folha, escala de férias, projeções)
- controle da entrada e saída de visitantes,
- autorização da entrada de visitantes,
- acesso às câmeras de segurança,
- avisos de chegada e retirada de encomendas,
- registro e publicação da leitura de água e gás,
- integração com sistemas de portaria remota, controle de acesso, automação e muito mais.
Qualquer dúvida ou questionamento, nos envie uma mensagem para adbens@winker.com.br

bluejetty:00177095:ios.name: Learn to read ABC 3+ T School
bluejetty:00177095:ios.summary:
Give your child a confident start in learning with a complete early-education app designed especially for children ages 3 to 5.
Through playful, structured activities, your child explores letters, sounds, numbers, early math, handwriting,
bluejetty:00177095:ios.description:
Give your child a confident start in learning with a complete early-education app designed especially for children ages 3 to 5.
Through playful, structured activities, your child explores letters, sounds, numbers, early math, handwriting, reading readiness, colors, shapes, time, seasons, puzzles, memory games, drawing, coloring and music — all in one safe and engaging space.
Every activity is carefully crafted to support Preschool, Pre-K and Kindergarten readiness, with short lessons that keep young learners focused, motivated and curious.
Learning Letters, Sounds and Reading Foundations
Children discover the alphabet from A to Z by tracing both uppercase and lowercase letters, listening to phonics sounds and connecting letters to simple words. These activities gently build early reading confidence and prepare children for their first reading experiences.
Numbers and Early Math Skills
Counting, number tracing and writing help children become comfortable with numbers from 1 to 10 and beyond. Early math concepts such as comparing, ordering, sorting and recognizing patterns are introduced through guided games that develop logic and problem-solving skills.
Handwriting and Fine-Motor Development
Step-by-step tracing paths guide children as they practice writing letters, numbers, shapes and basic strokes. These activities strengthen fine-motor skills, hand-eye coordination and writing control, laying the foundation for confident handwriting.
Creativity Through Drawing and Coloring
Free drawing tools and simple coloring activities encourage imagination and self-expression. Children explore colors and shapes while developing creativity, coordination and artistic confidence.
Puzzles, Memory and Thinking Skills
Matching games, memory challenges, jigsaw puzzles and visual reasoning activities help children improve focus, attention and cognitive skills in a playful and rewarding way.
Everyday Learning Concepts
Children learn to tell time, understand seasons and weather, and explore everyday concepts such as colors, shapes, opposites and categories, helping them make sense of the world around them.
Music and Sound Exploration
Simple musical activities introduce rhythm, melody and sound awareness, supporting auditory development and creative expression.
Safe, Ad-Free and Designed for Young Children
The app provides a positive and secure learning environment with no ads, no external links and no distractions. Child-friendly navigation and simple controls make it easy for young learners to use independently, even before they can read.
Short, purposeful learning sessions help balance screen time while encouraging independence, confidence and early problem-solving. Activities are designed to strengthen essential developmental skills, including memory, attention, reasoning, motor control, creativity and early literacy, while supporting healthy emotional and cognitive growth.
Built for Preschool and Kindergarten Success
Clear instructions, motivating progress and gentle challenges help children build confidence at their own pace. The app is ideal for both home learning and classroom support, reinforcing the foundational skills needed for reading, writing and math.
Continually Growing With Your Child
New content is added every month, including fresh alphabet lessons, writing exercises, math games, puzzles, drawing pages and early learning themes. The app evolves alongside your child to support continuous learning and development.

Com nosso aplicativo Católico, você terá acesso fácil às leituras da missa, permitindo que você as acompanhe a qualquer hora, em qualquer lugar. Além disso, o aplicativo oferece reflexões diárias que complementam as leituras, proporcionando uma conexão mais profunda com a mensagem divina.

Além desses recursos essenciais, o aplicativo Católico de Liturgia Diária também disponibiliza a Bíblia completa em suas mãos. Navegue facilmente pelos livros sagrados, salve versículos específicos e mergulhe nas palavras divinas sempre que desejar.
Baixe agora o aplicativo Católico da Liturgia Diária para transformar sua experiência de fé diária. O folheto da missa na palma da sua mão, acompanhe as leituras da Igreja!

Description:
Welcome to the enchanted world of Barkskin! Join the friendly forest gnomes in a unique casual strategy game that combines quick reflexes, res
bluejetty:00151815:ios.description:
App Name: Barkskin: Forest Gnome Duel Subtitle: Casual Strategy & Forest Adventure
Description:
Welcome to the enchanted world of Barkskin! Join the friendly forest gnomes in a unique casual strategy game that combines quick reflexes, resource management, and competitive dueling.
Embark on a relaxing yet thrilling journey through the mystic woods. Your goal is simple: outsmart your opponent in a battle of wits and luck using the ancient forest compass!
Game Features:
Unique 1v1 Duel Mode Engage in exciting turn-based battles against forest opponents!
 Best of 5 Rounds: It’s a race to victory! Compete in 5 intense rounds. The first player to win 3 rounds claims the glory.
 Score Comparison: Spin your forest compass to generate nature elements. Compare your score with your opponent — the higher score wins the round!
 Energy Strategy: Manage your "Energy" wisely. Decide how much energy to use to power your compass and maximize your chances of winning.
Collect Magical Elements Discover the power of nature! Your compass is filled with unique forest items:
 Tools: Use Axes and Saws to build your score.
 Nature: Gather Clovers, Mushrooms, and Leaves to boost your total.
 Each element carries a unique value. Find the perfect combination to defeat your rival!
Power-Ups & Shop Visit the Gnome Shop to trade your collected coins for magical artifacts:
 Lucky Charm: Increases your success rate.
 Golden Horseshoe: Doubles your rewards for a limited time.
 Magic Clover: Grants a guaranteed victory effect for the next round.
 Fortune Cookie: Surprises you with random bonus coins!
Achievements & Progression
 Track your journey from a "Beginner" to a "Veteran Player".
 Unlock 8 unique badges by completing rounds and winning duels.
 Claim your Daily Bonus to keep your energy full and ready for adventure!
Relaxing Atmosphere Immerse yourself in stunning 3D forest environments with soothing sound effects. Barkskin is designed for quick, stress-free gaming sessions anytime, anywhere.
Disclaimer: This game is intended for an adult audience for amusement purposes only. It does not offer "real money gambling" or an opportunity to win real money or prizes. Practice or success at social gaming does not imply future success at real money gambling.

⭐ Ever missed an important call or message because you didn’t hear the notification or see your screen in time? Flash Alerts - Flashlight ensures you never miss a thing by turning your device's flash into a visual alert for calls and messages.
FEATURE OF FLASH APP: FLASH NOTIFICATIONS, FLASH ALERT
✅ Be alerted of incoming calls, text messages, and app notifications with the led flash notification on call/flash on call/flash sms/flash alerts
✅ Customize the length of each flash.
✅ Select the number of light flashes for incoming SMS.
✅ Activate flash alerts for Normal, silent, and vibrate modes on your phone.
✅ ‘Do not disturb’ mode.

Get instantly alerted when people are trying to contact you with Flash app: Flash notifications, Flash alert – the flash alert for incoming call flash/incoming flash call/calling flashlight. The perfect visual light aid when you cannot hear your phone or need to keep it on silent mode.
After each phone call, you will see a useful call information screen where you will be able to instantly adjust your flash alert/flash notifications for future use.

SiDi wallet from Warba Bank, is all about “Financial Freedom”, it's the easiest, most secure way to bank online.
We're here to help migrant workers in Kuwait get “Financial Freedom” and take control of their money. Say goodbye to long bank queues, unnecessary journeys to the ATM or exchange houses and inconvenient service fees.
Our mobile app means you can open a bank account and manage your money from your mobile phone. All your financial services can all be done from the comfort of your homes in a fast, safe and easy manner through the SiDi app.
SiDi app features:
FREE ACCOUNT OPENING
Open a SiDi bank account now for free with no minimum balance through the app in 6 easy steps and less than 5 minutes.
FREE DEBIT CARD
Request your free debit card through the app and have it delivered to you. Your card can be used at shops, ATMs and online purchases.
FREE SUPER TRANSFER
Send money home for free through the app to select destinations. This service is free of charge and guarantees your recipient to receive the money in full at very competitive rates.
WALLET-TO-WALLET TRANSFER:
Send money from your wallet to any SiDi customers' wallet through the app for free.
WESTERN UNION:
Enjoy transferring money to 200+ countries and your recipient can collect their money in cash.
FREE MOBILE BILL PAYMENT:
You can now pay and schedule phone bills easily and securely through SiDi instantly and at no fees.

listings.description:
木鸟民宿是国内深耕短租、日租、民宿领域的老牌正规在线住宿预订平台，专注高品质非标准化住宿服务，于2012年5月正式上线，凭借十余年行业深耕积淀、严苛的房源审核体系、完善的全流程售后保障和超高性价比优势，成为千万用户出行住宿的首选品牌，累计收获海量用户好评与口碑沉淀，是值得长期信赖的短租民宿头部平台。
经过多年稳健扩张与业务升级，木鸟民宿现已实现海内外700多个城市全面覆盖，国内一线核心城市、新一线城市、热门旅游城市、滨海康养城市、小众文旅古镇全方位布局，核心覆盖北京、上海、重庆、天津、青岛、秦皇岛、三亚、大连、威海、日照、烟台、厦门、承德、大理、北海、深圳、沈阳、成都、苏州、杭州、西安、广州、长沙、昆明、南京、武汉、郑州等百余座热门城市，无论都市出差、周末周边游、长途跨省旅行、海外出行，还是异地求职求学、家庭团聚、朋友聚会、团队团建，都能快速找到适配房源，彻底告别异地住宿焦虑。

截至目前，平台坐拥175万套真实核验优质房源，房源总量稳居行业前列，累计服务用户突破1亿人次。庞大的用户体量、稳定的平台运营，搭配全程无忧的住宿保障，全方位印证木鸟民宿的硬核实力与优质服务口碑，是短途游、长途旅行、旅居备考、商务出差、家庭出行的高性价比住宿首选。

bluejetty:00015281:ios.description:

Created by the most trusted name in music; you can expect a robust, guided learning path to jumpstart your playing ability as a beginner or intermediate player. Whether you’re learning to play your favorite songs, building a healthy habit, or finding a new creative outlet — we’ve got you covered!
Learn to play guitar with the industry's elite instructors and over 3000+ bite-sized video lessons, with chords, scales, songs and riffs that you can practice at your own pace.
Play your way with Fender Play.
How Does It Work?
EXTENSIVE MUSIC LIBRARY
Play songs by your favorite artists with our 1000+ song library!
Fender Play helps you to master the chords, techniques and guitar scales to play songs from your favorite artists, including:
"Come As You Are" - Nirvana
"when the party's over" - Billie Eillish
"Red" - Taylor Swift
"Good Riddance (Time of Our Lives) - Green Day
"Paint it Black" - The Rolling Stones
"Master of Puppets" - Metallica
QUALITY LEARNING EXPERIENCE
Guided Learning Tools - Begin playing in a few short lessons with learning, practice and feedback activities.
Bite-Sized, Quality Lesson Videos - Top quality lessons from our experienced instructors help show you a unique hands-on perspective, breaking down each skill, riff or popular song.
Personalized Learning Path - Choose your instrument and your favorite genre to customize your learning experience.
Integrated Lesson Feedback - Cutting-edge listening technology by MatchMySound helps to assess your playing, give you feedback and help improve your score.
No Ads - Enjoy consistent and quality lessons, free of ads or other distractions.
INNOVATIVE PRACTICE TOOLS
Practice Mode - Built-in metronome and tempo control to help you learn timing.
Reminders - Set practice reminders to prioritize practicing in a way that fits your schedule.
Tone Integration - Tap into amp presets that work with select Fender amps to get the right tone to sound like your favorite artists.
Practice Features for All - Scrolling tablature, chord charts, chord drills, backing & isolated tracks, looping, tuning, metronome and more.
COMMUNITY & MOTIVATION
Highly Supportive Community - Live instructor office hours, giveaways and more are here to help you feel supported and motivated to stick with your instrument.
Streaks - Keep your streak going by practicing every week!
Backing Tracks - Feel like you’re jamming with a full band, even if you’re practicing alone.
Chord Challenge - Master chord transitions and improve finger dexterity. Beat your own high score by increasing the speed and tempo of chords from your favorite songs.
Simply download the Fender Play app and learn to play guitar on your iPhone, iPad, or iOS device and get started learning how to play guitar today!

bluejetty:00186188:ios.name: Spanish Words and Puzzles Lite
bluejetty:00186188:ios.summary: Spanish Words and Puzzles is a ReadnLearn app that teaches phonics, letter names and spelling in Castilian or Latin American Spanish to children from preschool to Grade 1. The Puzzle Box component develops observational skills through shape
bluejetty:00186188:ios.description:
Spanish Words and Puzzles is a ReadnLearn app that teaches phonics, letter names and spelling in Castilian or Latin American Spanish to children from preschool to Grade 1. The Puzzle Box component develops observational skills through shape and frame tray puzzles. The Lite version includes a free sample of six words and six puzzles.
Apple has featured ReadnLearn apps in the Kids and Education categories.
________________________________
BRIEFLY
Spanish Words and Puzzles keeps children engaged through a star reward system. Children earn a star for completing each word or puzzle successfully. Every five stars, they can redeem them for toys and decorative items for their own interactive iPad room, choosing from four room colors and over one hundred different items and toys. A clean navigation interface gets children into uninterrupted play within a few taps.
________________________________
SPANISH PHONICS
ReadnLearn uses the systematic phonics method recommended by leading educational authorities. Children start by learning the sounds of individual letters, then discover how those sounds form syllables and words. Spanish is a transparent language — letters consistently map to the same sounds — which makes phonics a highly effective approach for Spanish learners of all abilities. This method is proven especially helpful for children with autism, speech delay and dyslexia.
________________________________
FEATURES
● Star reward system: children earn stars to decorate their own interactive iPad room.
● Four (4) room colors and over 100 items and toys to choose from, endless combinations.
● Four (4) player profiles for personalized learning.
● Verbal instructions and motivational voice feedback in English, Castilian Spanish or Latin American Spanish.
● Children pick up where they left off or complete levels at their own pace.
● Monitor each child's learning progress at a glance.
● Six words and six puzzles in this Lite version. Thirty words and forty puzzles in the full version.
● More words and puzzles available through in-app purchase.
● Adaptive learning through three difficulty levels for each game:
SPANISH WORD BOOK — three levels for preschool through Grade 1 (ages 2–7):
○ Level 1: Learn letter sounds with hints and free letter placement.
○ Level 2: Learn letter sounds without hints and free letter placement.
○ Level 3: Learn letter names without hints, strict left-to-right placement.
PUZZLE BOX — three levels for observational skills:
○ Level 1: Pieces not rotated, picture hint available.
○ Level 2: Pieces not rotated, reduced picture hint.
○ Level 3: Pieces randomly rotated, no picture hint.
________________________________
DISCLOSURE
At ReadnLearn, your child's privacy and safety is our priority. Our app:
◇ Does not collect or share any personally identifiable information.
◇ Does not contain social network integration or social features.
◇ Does not contain ads.
◇ Does not contain In-App Purchases.
◇ Contains "Feedback", "Tell a Friend", "Rate Now" and "Buy Now" buttons, behind a parental gate.
◇ Contains a "More Games" button and page, behind a parental gate.
For more information: readnlearn.com/app-lectoescritura/privacy-es/
________________________________
IF THIS APP HELPED YOUR CHILD
Leaving an honest review helps other families dealing with autism, speech delay and learning differences find this app. Tell us what you want added or changed — every piece of feedback shapes the next update.
app-feedback@readnlearn.com
________________________________
ABOUT ReadnLearn
ReadnLearn was founded by Aris Karavias, a children's illustrator and educational app developer with 27 years of experience and 25 published apps. His son Marios has autism and speech delay. Every design decision in every app comes from watching Marios learn. ReadnLearn apps are used by families in over 100 countries and are available in six languages.
app-feedback@readnlearn.com / app-support@readnlearn.com
readnlearn.com

Spanish Words and Puzzles keeps children engaged through a star reward system. Children earn a star for completing each word or puzzle successfully. Every five stars, they can redeem them for toys and decorative items for their own interactive iPad room, choosing from four room colors and over one hundred different items and toys. A clean navigation interface gets children into uninterrupted play within a few taps.
________________________________
SPANISH PHONICS
ReadnLearn uses the systematic phonics method recommended by leading educational authorities. Children start by learning the sounds of individual letters, then discover how those sounds form syllables and words. Spanish is a transparent language — letters consistently map to the same sounds — which makes phonics a highly effective approach for Spanish learners of all abilities. This method is proven especially helpful for children with autism, speech delay and dyslexia.
________________________________
FEATURES
● Star reward system: children earn stars to decorate their own interactive iPad room.
● Four (4) room colors and over 100 items and toys to choose from, endless combinations.
● Four (4) player profiles for personalized learning.
● Verbal instructions and motivational voice feedback in English, Castilian Spanish or Latin American Spanish.
● Children pick up where they left off or complete levels at their own pace.
● Monitor each child's learning progress at a glance.
● Six words and six puzzles in this Lite version. Thirty words and forty puzzles in the full version.
● More words and puzzles available through in-app purchase.
● Adaptive learning through three difficulty levels for each game:

SPANISH WORD BOOK — three levels for preschool through Grade 1 (ages 2–7):
○ Level 1: Learn letter sounds with hints and free letter placement.
○ Level 2: Learn letter sounds without hints and free letter placement.
○ Level 3: Learn letter names without hints, strict left-to-right placement.

PUZZLE BOX — three levels for observational skills:
○ Level 1: Pieces not rotated, picture hint available.
○ Level 2: Pieces not rotated, reduced picture hint.
○ Level 3: Pieces randomly rotated, no picture hint.
________________________________
DISCLOSURE
At ReadnLearn, your child's privacy and safety is our priority. Our app:
◇ Does not collect or share any personally identifiable information.
◇ Does not contain social network integration or social features.
◇ Does not contain ads.
◇ Does not contain In-App Purchases.
◇ Contains "Feedback", "Tell a Friend", "Rate Now" and "Buy Now" buttons, behind a parental gate.
◇ Contains a "More Games" button and page, behind a parental gate.
For more information: readnlearn.com/app-lectoescritura/privacy-es/
________________________________
IF THIS APP HELPED YOUR CHILD
Leaving an honest review helps other families dealing with autism, speech delay and learning differences find this app. Tell us what you want added or changed — every piece of feedback shapes the next update.
app-feedback@readnlearn.com
________________________________
ABOUT ReadnLearn
ReadnLearn was founded by Aris Karavias, a children's illustrator and educational app developer with 27 years of experience and 25 published apps. His son Marios has autism and speech delay. Every design decision in every app comes from watching Marios learn. ReadnLearn apps are used by families in over 100 countries and are available in six languages.

bluejetty:00128373:ios.name: Aces Up Solitaire ·
bluejetty:00128373:ios.summary:
Aces Up Solitaire is a simple to learn & fast-paced card game that requires a little strategy and a little luck to win. If you enjoy playing the classic solitaire, then Aces Up Solitaire is a game for you.
Mobilityware’s version of Aces Up
bluejetty:00128373:ios.description:
Aces Up Solitaire is a simple to learn & fast-paced card game that requires a little strategy and a little luck to win. If you enjoy playing the classic solitaire, then Aces Up Solitaire is a game for you.
Mobilityware’s version of Aces Up Solitaire has added a wild card so players can rely more on strategic moves to win, and not just luck. Aces Up Solitaire is the perfect combination of easy to learn and challenging to master, which both casual and strategic gamers will love.
This puzzle card game brain teaser is a variation of the classic patience card game and is also known as Idiot’s Delight, Once in a Life Time, Ace of the Pile, Rocket to the Pocket, Loser Solitaire, Firing Squad, Aces High, and Drivel.
HOW TO PLAY ACES UP SOLITAIRE
The goal of the game is to clear all the cards from the game board, except for the four aces. To clear cards from the game board you must find cards of the same suit on the board, that have no cards sitting on top of them, and tap the smaller value to be removed. If you get stuck and there’s no card moves available, tap the stockpile to place another card face up in each column. Once you have removed all the cards from the gameboard and the stockpile, except for the four aces, you win!
EARNING WILD CARDS
Earn wild cards by clearing the cards from the game board. The wild card allows you to discard any card from the game. Each game, players can earn up to 3 cards. Wild cards help avoid situations where you get stuck and have no moves to make! No one wants to be dealt a hand they can’t win. Each wild card you save grants additional bonus points for that game.
ACES UP SOLITAIRE: NEW CARD GAME FEATURES
SOLITAIRE with a TWIST
- Love classic Solitaire, Spades or Poker? You’ll love the free brain teasers in Aces Up Solitaire
- Classic Solitaire Feel w/ whimsical animations
- Strategically use wild cards when you get stuck with no moves
- Fast & Addicting strategy game to train you brain
- Balloons show your progress in the game. Launch all 4 balloons to win. 
BRAIN TRAINING: PLAY NEW CARD GAME PUZZLES DAILY
- Card Puzzles: A new Daily challenge puzzle is added daily designed to challenge your Solitaire Skills
- Strategy is key to win! Use logic and strategy to solve each puzzle
- Too Easy? Try to win a game without using a wild card!
BECOME AN ACES UP LEGEND
- Complete the card puzzles to gain XP and become the first to claim the title of “Aces Up Legend”
- Track performance on your personal leaderboard and develop new strategies
- Are you competitive? Check the global leaderboard to see how your score stacks up against others
- Complete challenges to earn trophies that will sit nicely in your trophy room
MobilityWare makes the best card games to keep your brain sharp: the #1 Solitaire, Spider Solitaire, Mahjong Solitaire, Freecell Solitaire, and Addiction Solitaire games. Take our newest card game, Aces Up, for a test ride today.
Aces Up Solitaire is ad-supported, but only between deals. We won’t interrupt your card game with an ad!
Questions? Comments? Concerns? We would love to hear from you! Reach us at http://www.mobilityware.com/support
Aces Up Solitaire is created and supported by MobilityWare.

bluejetty:00152056:ios.name: Royal Lands - Save The King
bluejetty:00152056:ios.summary:
► A GAME FIT FOR A KING
Looking for a medieval game where you get to play a King who is building his kingdom from the ground up? Royal Lands has the perfect blend of strategy and idle gameplay for all ages to enjoy – harvest items, build y
bluejetty:00152056:ios.description:
► A GAME FIT FOR A KING
Looking for a medieval game where you get to play a King who is building his kingdom from the ground up? Royal Lands has the perfect blend of strategy and idle gameplay for all ages to enjoy – harvest items, build your kingdom, and gain citizens, but also go on adventures to conquer castles and enemies as your realm grows! This exciting game will hone your strategy skills to the max as you try and balance feeding your growing population, earning gold, and conquering kingdoms.
► IDLE ADVENTURE 
You begin the game as a lowly peasant king, with no citizens or land to your name – just an axe and the desire to be the greatest of them all! Harvest wood, berries, rocks, and more, then use these to feed the people who decide to follow you or to build your kingdom. Of course no medieval castle game is complete without battles, so be prepared to attack your neighbors and steal their land, as well as defend your own.
► Mylord will like:
◾Emphasis on strategy – This tower defense game is more than just the sum of its parts. You’ll need to keep track of and balance all sorts of needs within your realm, from harvesting food to collecting payment. On top of that you’ll need to manage your army and keep your kingdom up and running, which is no easy task!
◾ Idle aspect – While you’ll need to use your noggin to figure out the best methods for harvesting strawberries and mining rocks, the game’s idle aspect keeps this fun and chill. Soon you’ll have tons of workers at your beck and call, ready to build, defend, and harvest for their leader. But don’t worry, any time you want to take a little break from the action and take part in the harvest, you’re more than welcome!
◾ Endless options – As you raise your kingdom from the forest floor, have fun building it just the way you want. Customize your character, choose how you want to spend your time in the game, and more! Plus there are tons of new territories being added, meaning there’s always something new and exciting to come explore in the game.
► TEST THE LEADERSHIP
If you’re a fan of tower defense, strategy, and save the king games, Royal Lands is sure to float your boat (and build your castle!) Enjoy all the fun of idle games while also going on exciting adventures to capture castles, grow your kingdom. 
As you build you’ll unlock tons of exciting new lands to conquer, items to harvest and use, and citizens to care for your land and fill out your army, so hop in the game now to test and see if you’ve got what it takes to be a king!
Privacy Policy: https://say.games/privacy-policy
Terms of Use: https://say.games/terms-of-use

bluejetty:00063687:ios.description:
What will your future baby look like?
Choose any 2 parents, and make a baby!
Try Make A Baby's other wacky filters to combine some hilarious pics!
MAKE A BABY
Baby Maker takes two photos, analyzes their faces, and generates a custom baby for you in seconds. Try it with your boyfriend, girlfriend, friends, and more. You select the parents, and make a baby!
GET BABY-FACED
This wacky new filter will put a baby face on any person’s body. Want to see what you would look like with the face of a baby? Well, what are you waiting for!?
PREGNANT BOOTH
Make anyone pregnant with Pregnant Booth! You choose who to target with this hilarious filter, where there really are no limitations!
BABY GAME
Play, feed, and burp this digital baby pet daily to keep them happy. How big will your baby get? Take care of your baby to increase its weight and height, and earn Star Levels in the process.
CHIBI EFFECT
Sparkle up your photos with our adorable, big-eyed chibi effect. Add some pop and cuteness to your world with this playful photo filter.
FACE PLACER
Get a glimpse of your baby-self with Face Placer. Simply take a new photo or select one from your library to upload. Our filters will handle the rest with this crazy baby-generating effect.
Get the #1 baby generator app! Make A Baby now to see your own future baby.
Make A Baby provides the best and most accurate results when used with front-facing and well-lit photos taken with Apple devices. Restore your past purchases at any time via the Restore button on the subscription offer window.
Some filters and Baby Game are completely free to use with logo watermarks. Premium features are marked by a star icon on our home screen and require a subscription to access. Access the Baby Stats in Baby Maker for free, but a subscription is required for unlimited access to the full Baby Maker feature.
Regarding the Collection, Use, and Disclosure of User and Device Data:
If you are using an iOS app you can simply uninstall the app in order to remove any stored data. We do not collect, share, or save any user's photos or face data. We do not share user face or photo data with third parties.
Subscription pricing and terms:
Make A Baby Future Face Maker offers one weekly auto-renewing subscription option. The subscription price is for customers located in the United States. Pricing in other countries may vary and actual charges may be converted to local currencies depending on your country of residence.
Your Make A Baby subscription will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase. Your iTunes Account will be charged when your in-app purchase is confirmed.
Read more about our privacy policy here:
https://ninjachemist.info/privacypolicy.html
Read more about our terms and conditions here:
https://ninjachemist.info/terms.html

You will advance more quickly than with any other conventional approach if you use this application since you will be able to take examinations anywhere and when
bluejetty:00068815:ios.description:
Do you really want to get a passing score on the DKT on your very first try? 
You will advance more quickly than with any other conventional approach if you use this application since you will be able to take examinations anywhere and whenever you choose, whether you are at the bus station, in a bar, in the classroom, or at your place of employment. 
Put your knowledge to the test by practising different subjects. The question bank for the DKT exam is broken up into ten different sections. The following classifications are included in this version: 
- Background Information - Intoxicating beverages and illicit narcotics 
- The effects of fatigue and taking precautions when driving 
- Crosswalks - Negligent driving - Traffic lights and lanes - Intersections - Seat belts and handles - Speed restrictions - Pedestrians - Neglect of driving - Intersections 
Our practise exams are based on the official examination, so they are realistic in the same way that the actual test is. 
- In the event that you make a mistake, the application will immediately inform you whether or not your response is incorrect and the reason for this. Learn from your mistakes and always remember the correct answers. 
- We will always give you brand new questions: In order to help you maintain your concentration during the practise exam, we will always give you brand new questions. 
- You may personalise the practise exam by selecting which questions to include and determining the total number of questions you wish to go through.

bluejetty:00170155:ios.name: NIGHT CROWS
bluejetty:00170155:ios.summary:
A new stage of battle, the new Battlefront 'Asphodel', makes its appearance.
Experience even stronger growth with the 'Sacred Bell' Artifact, which can be crafted through this Battlefront.
Additionally, Resonance Card content has been added
bluejetty:00170155:ios.description:
A new stage of battle, the new Battlefront 'Asphodel', makes its appearance.
Experience even stronger growth with the 'Sacred Bell' Artifact, which can be crafted through this Battlefront.
Additionally, Resonance Card content has been added, allowing you to discover the fun of new growth utilizing diverse combinations and strategies.
Created with Unreal Engine 5, the 13th-century European continent where magic exists invites you to a huge war of chaos.
▣Creation of the World▣
In 13th-century Europe where magic still exists, we created a new world in which fantasy meets reality. Night versus day, light versus darkness, order versus chaos, and oppression versus rebellion— everything clashes and collides in the lands of medieval Europe. Dive into the most realistic experience of the European continent, brought to life with Unreal Engine 5.
▣Way of Life▣
In RPG, the character becomes another "you." Gone are the days when you had to rely on luck and chances. The time and effort you put in, and the promotions and advancements based on your choice will make your company grow, soaring to fulfill the missions given as a Night Crows member. That is the system of growth and way of life NIGHT CROWS are so eager to achieve.
▣Fly High▣
Now, the ground, sky, and everything in between will become a battlefield. With the use of "Gliders," the sky has finally become another stage for players in the European continent of NIGHT CROWS. Going beyond the simple flight using elevation differences, Gliders in NIGHT CROWS enable gliding, hovering, and various strategies for combat by utilizing updrafts, offering a three-dimensional action experience that breaks away from flat-surfaced battles.
▣True Action▣
The excitement of the battle in NIGHT CROWS is maximized through the realistic display of the battle itself and the vivid experience of growth. Experience "real action" that stimulates all senses by combining the motions of monsters upon taking damage and the hit impact distinguished by the weapon of each class, which include one-handed swords, two-handed swords, bows, and staffs.
▣A Huge War▣
This colossal war will begin in the name of god. Based on inter-server technology, the Battlefront works as a massive arena that breaks through size limits, enabling the clash of the three servers with over a thousand players. The enhancement of PVP skills specialized for each class, Gliders, and three-dimensional battlefields that utilize elevation differences allow the Battlefront to go beyond the existing battle experience. Through NIGHT CROWS, you now will stand "in the middle of a colossal battlefield of the European continent."
▣One Market▣
Everything becomes connected in the world of NIGHT CROWS. The three servers are connected through inter-server technology, and all individuals within them will collide and compete against each other for better rights and faster growth while cooperating and having exchanges through the connected economy of "World Exchange." One market of conflict and cooperation, one economy, and one world — that is the world of NIGHT CROWS.
[About Access Control]
[Optional] Saving of photos, media, and files: Used to download resource data and save game data, for support center and community activities, and to save gameplay screenshots.
[How to turn off access]
 - Go to Settings > Privacy & Security > find the data being accessed > turn access on or off
■ SUPPORT ■
e-mail: nightcrowshelp@wemade.com
Official Site: https://www.nightcrows.com

bluejetty:00018891:ios.description:
***The Original Baby Care Adventure Game with Over 3+ Million Downloads!***
Play super cute baby care games as you help mommy and the family take care of adorable babies through fun activities, dress up, bath time, cooking, cleaning and more!
Perfect for girls, toddlers and kids who love baby games, pretend play, daycare fun and family adventures!
Features:
• Cute baby care & daycare activities
• Fun dress up, makeover & decoration games
• Cooking, cleaning & bath time mini games
• Easy gameplay for toddlers & young kids
• Bright colorful graphics & adorable animations
• Tons of interactive family fun levels
Level 1: Feed the cute hungry baby in the kitchen! Change bibs, give milk bottles, apple sauce, baby food and yummy snacks!
Level 2: Baby nursery room time! Change diapers, give a pacifier, play with teddy bears and help care for the adorable baby!
Level 3: Baby bath time fun! Wash, rinse, brush teeth and play with rubber duckies in the bathtub!
Level 4: Play room games! Play with rattles, toy cars, bouncing balls, helicopters and fun bunny makeover activities!
Level 5: Help mommy set the table! Decorate with plates, bowls, flowers, silverware and more!
Level 6: Bedtime baby care! Prepare the baby for sleep with blankets, toys, mobiles and night lights!
Level 7: Clean up the family living room! Vacuum, dust, decorate and organize the house!
Level 8: Baby bike riding adventure! Ride bikes with mommy, daddy and the family!
Level 9: Mommy & baby care time! Care, play and learn with the cute baby!
Level 10: Cooking game time! Make a delicious sandwich with fun ingredients!
Level 11: Baby ball pit playground! Decorate, play music and enjoy colorful toys!
Level 12: Dress up makeover salon! Create tiger face paint, princess makeup and fun beauty looks!
Level 13: Playdate party time! Play with baby friends in the playhouse and enjoy fun activities together!
Level 14: Baby birthday party games! Decorate, wear party hats, dance to music and celebrate!
Level 15: Get ready for a family car ride! Clean the car, prepare the car seat and dress the baby!
Level 16: Family photo makeover! Fix outfits, apply makeup and get ready for picture day fun!
Level 17: Care for the magical baby unicorn!
Level 18: Outdoor garden fun! Plant flowers, water seeds and grow a beautiful garden!
Level 19: Bake a chocolate cake dessert! Mix ingredients and decorate tasty treats!
Level 20: Baby spa salon time! Take bubble baths, decorate and play with bath toys!
Level 21: Bathroom clean-up helper game! Flush toilets, clean garbage and organize the room!
Level 22: Baby beauty salon makeover! Create hairstyles, apply makeup and play dress up!
Level 23: Fix the family car with daddy in this fun pretend play activity!
Level 24: Laundry room clean-up & makeover fun!
Level 25: Cooking party kitchen game! Mix ingredients and prepare delicious treats!
Level 26: More baby nursery room adventures!
Level 27: Design & decorate a brand new baby room! Paint walls, hang pictures and customize everything!
Level 28: Baby princess & babysitter makeover party fun!
Level 29: Daddy makeover salon! Shave daddy’s beard and create funny new styles!
Level 30: Family party celebration! Enjoy a super fun day filled with games, music and activities!
*Please note that levels 16-30 must be purchased separately.
*Please note that Baby Care & Dress Up Game is free to play, but you are able to purchase game items and remove ads with real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases.*

bluejetty:00034795:ios.name: Singing Lessons: Learn to Sing
bluejetty:00034795:ios.summary: Singing Lessons is designed to help beginner singers to improve their vocal technique and acquire general musical knowledge. Our method uses exercises that have been scientifically proven and that are used every day in the most prestigious
bluejetty:00034795:ios.description:
Singing Lessons is designed to help beginner singers to improve their vocal technique and acquire general musical knowledge. Our method uses exercises that have been scientifically proven and that are used every day in the most prestigious music academies in the world. 
Our app includes practice tracks, Vocal exercises, vocal warm up, vocal cool down, pitch training, guess the note exercises, vocal drills, pitch test, pitch practice, ear test, ear training and more. 
Our singing practice starts with some easy vocal exercises using piano scales. Pay attention which octave you are singing on, that let you get familiar to your vocal range.  
You can select your voice type: (Baritone, Bass, Tenor, Alto, Mezzo, Soprano, Mezzo-soprano) and thus customize the exercises to obtain better results. If not sure what’s your voice type, you can take a test inside the app. 
Music Lessons can be expensive around the world, that’s why we decided to create a free vocal training app, giving you an opportunity to have a Free vocal coach / Free singing lessons well explained like an Udemy singing Course. 
We teach to sing female singers, male singers, beginner and advanced, children and adults and every person who want to learn how to sing. 
If you’re a newbie singer don’t focus on sing perfectly in a couple of days, instead of that, focus on master the singing basics and singing techniques. Learn to sing professionally is not an easy task. Some people were born and grow up with a beautiful voice, the rest of us must work hard to build a strong and powerful voice. So, start slow and then you’ll notice yourself matching pitch, singing in tune, after that you’ll feel how your songs sound better. This is how we build an awesome voice (Specially a singing voice). Hit Higher notes is just a matter of time.
Intermediate Lessons include how to sing high notes, develop vocal techniques like vibrato, falsetto, melismas, sing harmonies, vocal dynamics, whistle voice, chest voice, mixed voice, head voice and blending.
Key Features: 
* Basic singing Lessons 
* Vocal exercises at your fingertips 
* Technique Lessons 
* Find your vocal range and voice type. 
* Increase vocal range 
* Sing high notes easily 
* Learn to sing from scratch 
* Download audios and practice without connection 
* Track your progress with smart voice notes. 
* Develop Falsetto and other singing skills. 
* Singing Rhythm, Tempo, diction, Melody and Harmony. 
* Voice care 
* Create and record professional Vocals 
* Reduce nasal sound. 
* Mastering Harmony and mastering vibrato 
* Vocal Freedom, Vocal agility, Agile Voice 
* Music theory: Vocal cords, vocal register, resonance, tessitura, timbre, Absolute pitch, perfect pitch, Vocal Folds and more. 
Privacy Policy: https://singinglessons.app/privacy.html
Terms of use: https://singinglessons.app/terms.html

bluejetty:00071225:ios.description:
Dive into Gomoku: The Classic Five in a Row, Now on Your Phone!
Explore the timeless strategy of Gomoku, also known as Five in a Row, Caro, Omok, Renju, or Gobang. This classic board game, traditionally played on a 15x15 intersection Go board, challenges players to align five stones in an unbroken row to claim victory.
Gomoku brings this captivating game right to your phone, retaining the authentic feel of playing with black and white Go pieces. Whether it's family game night or a solo challenge against diverse AI opponents, this mobile version caters to all. With five difficulty levels ranging from Easy to Expert, even the most skilled players will find themselves tested.
Each victory in Gomoku is not just a mark of pride but also earns you experience points, increasing from +1 for Easy to a challenging +7 for Expert wins.
Key Features:
* Convenient Undo function.
* Ability to Save and Load games in progress.
* A range of AI difficulties, offering five levels to test your skills.
* Timer-based gameplay for added excitement.
* Custom board editor for a personalized gaming experience.
* A variety of board and piece sets to choose from.
* Zoom in and out for the best view.
* Multiple board sizes for varied gameplay: select from 9x9, 11x11, 13x13, and the classic 15x15.
Embrace the free-style version of Gomoku supported in this game, where forming a row of five or more stones leads you to victory. Get ready to enjoy the strategic depth of Gomoku on your phone!"

Binaural beats are a natural phenomenon created when two slightly different frequencies are played separately in each ear. bluejetty:00137417:ios.description:
Achieve the perfect cook from the palm of your hand with the Ninja ProConnect™ app. Now you can enjoy the cookout while controlling your grill from just about anywhere. Monitor and adjust times, temps, and settings directly from the app – no need to babysit the grill. With hassle-free connected cooking, you will receive real-time notifications for when it is time to add food, flip, and more so you can cook with confidence.
Ninja ProConnect™ features:
• Control your grill from your fingertips: Easily connect your grill to your phone via Bluetooth and WiFi and adjust temps, times, and settings directly from the app. Even start and end a cook from the app.
• Real-time cooking updates: From preheat to ready-to-eat, the app keeps you in the know while you enjoy your cookout.
• Monitor your cook with up to two thermometers: Dual thermometer compatibility allows you to monitor and cook two different proteins two different ways.
• Easy-to-use cooking charts: Easily get the perfect cook—just search for your protein and get chef-recommended settings for each cooking function. Filter by food, mode, and length of time.
• Easily program your cook: From the palm of your hands, you can select your cooking mode, input your cook time and temp, and press start to be on your way to fast, easy, and flavorful meals. Even add 100% authentic smoky flavor to your favorite meals.
• Compatibility: Compatible with OG900 series.

bluejetty:00073802:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00073802:ios.description:
Whether you are foiling, freestyling, kitesurfing in breaking waves, or riding your local bay, river, or lake, precision matters. 
Powered by over 90,000+ exclusive Tempest Weather Stations and 150,000+ additional sources, get hyperlocal weather data where you ride, not guesses from miles away. With stations on buoys, piers, breakwaters, and key waterfront locations, iKitesurf covers the riding spots that matter most.
Plan with confidence using our Tempest Rapid Refresh Model combined with government data to deliver industry-leading Nearcast AI predictions. Then go deeper with radar, high-resolution forecast maps, and fully customizable alerts so you never miss a session.
Real conditions. Better sessions.
- Coastal observations from proprietary Tempest Weather Systems along with all public domain marine forecasts and reports (NOAA, NWS, METAR, ASOS, CWOP) including all major airports creating over 150,000 unique stations.
- Exclusive Tempest Weather Systems deployed at key coastal locations report wind, rain, pressure and more than 24 other weather observations. 
- Apple Watch compatibility
- Live wind from our systems provides a better windy conditions flow map – augmented by current station reports with advanced quality control.
- Proprietary Nearcast AI provides enhanced forecasting for temperature, wind gust, speed, direction, humidity, dewpoint, precipitation rate, probability of precipitation, and cloud cover percentage.
- Public domain forecast models including High Resolution Rapid Refresh (HRRR), North American Mesoscale Forecast System (NAM), Global Forecast System (GFS), Canadian Meteorological Centre Model (CMC), Icosahedral Non Hydrostatic Model (ICON).
- Free subscription for unlimited wind alerts with customizable thresholds to email, text, or get in-app. Plus National Weather Service (NWS) Marine Forecasts & Marine Warnings / Alerts.
- Create a personalized Favorites list and instantly track conditions at all your go-to spots, so you’re always ready when it’s on.
- Explore rich, interactive maps featuring real-time and forecasted wind, temperature, radar, satellite, precipitation, cloud cover, and nautical charts.
-Master the waves with:
 - Tides charts
 - Wave height, wave period
 - Water temperature
 - Sunrise / sunset
 - Moonrise / moonset
 - Historical wind statistics
 - Windy days per month
 - Wind direction distribution
Go Beyond the Basics: Upgrade to Plus, Pro, or Gold membership to gain access to more weather stations, ad-free browsing, and more.
- Access exclusive high-quality Pro stations at top coastal locations and unlockKitesurf’s hyper-accurate Pro forecasts written daily by a team of real meteorologists for kiting hotspots coast-to-coast.
- Detailed weather info, gusts, rain radar, satellite, NOAA, NWS, at spots of interest to coastal residents and property owners near the ocean, rivers and other bodies of water, including:
On the water features:
 - Sea surface temperatures
 - Sea surface currents
 - Detailed historical wind statistics
 - Historical wind speed average by year
Does your spot need a station? Join the Tempest Weather Network!
Get a Tempest Weather System for your house, business, club, pier, or backyard.

Contact Tempest: help.weatherflow.com/hc/en-us/requests/new

bluejetty:00115410:ios.summary:
Your all-in-one QR & Barcode Scanner – fast, smart, powerful.

bluejetty:00115410:ios.description:
Your all-in-one QR & Barcode Scanner – fast, smart, powerful.
Turn your iPhone into a universal scanner for everything: QR codes, product barcodes, documents, business cards, Wi-Fi log-ins, even restaurant menus and airline boarding passes. Whether you’re price-checking in Target, saving contact info at a trade show, joining a friend’s Wi-Fi, or filing receipts for taxes, this app makes it effortless.
Scan QR codes in a flash to open websites, join Wi-Fi, redeem coupons, or download apps. Read barcodes to compare prices at the register or online. Digitize business cards, documents, and PDFs with one tap. Batch-scan dozens of codes at once to inventory products, validate event tickets, or process shipping labels. Create custom QR codes for contacts, calendar events, links, or Wi-Fi passwords — and share them instantly.
Key Features
• Ultra-fast QR & barcode scanner
• Scan product barcodes and compare prices
• QR code generator for links, contacts, Wi-Fi, text, more
• Business-card OCR to save contacts instantly
• Join Wi-Fi networks without typing passwords
• Batch mode – scan multiple codes in one shot
• Scan from live camera, photo library, or screenshots
• Auto-detect with flashlight and pinch-to-zoom
• Save and export your scan history
• Create QR codes in PNG or SVG format
• Built-in support for menus, boarding passes, coupons, tickets, puzzles
• Clean interface with full Dark Mode support
No ads, no clutter — just powerful tools to scan, create, and organize your QR and barcodes.
Subscription & Free Trial
• 3-day free trial (one per Apple ID).
• Choose Weekly or Annual plan.
• Payment is charged to your Apple ID at purchase confirmation.
• Subscription renews automatically 24 h before the end of the current period unless canceled.
• Manage or cancel anytime in Settings › Apple ID › Subscriptions.
• Cancel during the trial and keep Premium features until the trial ends.
• Prices may change; discounts can’t be applied retroactively.
Privacy Policy: https://heyapps.co/code-reader/privacy
Terms of Use: https://heyapps.co/code-reader/terms

bluejetty:00115077:ios.summary: Step into "Gloomy Tales: One-Way Ticket" – a thrilling mix of mystery hidden object games, halloween games, and creepy games. When a monster drags your friend into the underworld, you must face halloween stories filled with shadows, ghosts,
bluejetty:00115077:ios.description:
Step into "Gloomy Tales: One-Way Ticket" – a thrilling mix of mystery hidden object games, halloween games, and creepy games. When a monster drags your friend into the underworld, you must face halloween stories filled with shadows, ghosts, and mystical riddles. Explore a haunted mansion, uncover secrets, and join allies to battle darkness. If you crave creepy games with spine-tingling puzzles, festive chills, and hauntingly immersive halloween stories, this is the ultimate free-to-play adventure!
This time, you were invited to take a group photo in a big, historical mansion. The place is spooky. You realize how scary it truly is when a monster takes your friend Millie through a portal in front of a crowd. He took her to the world of the dead, so you will have to risk your life to save her. Luckily, you have help: Professor Power and his sister Astra will help you get there, and a ghost called Faceless certainly wants to be your friend and trick Allister on his home turf. Will it be enough? Also, not to brag, but the party host Anna Charlestone has some experience with going against the supernatural as well, even though she’s not telling you about it… What kind of dark secrets does this girl hide?
· Haunted spirit of Halloween!
Immerse yourself in festive halloween stories with atmospheric mystery hidden object games. Collect spooky items, solve mystical riddles, and enjoy a world that blends creepy games with the ultimate vibe of halloween games, where every corner hides surprises.
· Gloomy atmosphere!
Embarking on this mysterious event of horror hidden object games you will have the opportunity to visit many curious corners of the Halloween party filled with hidden objects, Halloween stories and scary horror secrets! What's a world without some horrorland, right?
· Choices that matter!
Your journey in this blend of mystery hidden object games and halloween games is shaped by the decisions you make. Confront a terrifying abduction, explore chilling halloween stories, solve mystical riddles, and survive the thrills of creepy games where fate is in your hands!
· A variety of achievements!
Risk everything as you confront creepy games challenges and navigate Halloween stories! Sharpen your wits by solving horror hidden object games and enjoy moments of respite with engaging fun Halloween games, all while earning an array of achievements that showcase your mastery!
Dare to enter the mansion and uncover what lies beyond the veil—your darkest free-to-play adventure begins now!
-----

Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00120873:ios.description:
Guided hypnosis for astral projection, lucid dreaming and inner exploration, created and voiced by Joel Thielke, Certified Clinical Hypnotherapist.
Begin with Inner Wisdom, an introductory journey you can play in full, then continue with the original Astral Projection journey, which plays offline.
Each session is yours to shape: choose how you are guided in, add a program, and finish with a wake or sleep ending. The journeys are made for quiet, focused listening with headphones, lying down in a safe place.
WHAT'S INSIDE
- 101 hypnosis programs by Joel Thielke, led by Astral Projection, Lucid Dreaming & Sleep, Find Your Spirit Guide, Past Life Regression and Higher Self
- Shelves for Astral & Dreams, Psychic & Intuition and Spirit & Transformation, plus confidence, relationships, motivation, performance and wellbeing
- Six inductions, classic and new: the original Short, Long and Sleep, plus Beach (a calm walk along the shore), Speed (a fast way in) and Staircase (counting down step by step)
- Wake, sleep, quiet-pause or no-ending choices, and optional spoken instructions
- Repeat, a sleep timer and playlists for longer listening
- Sound Mixer: one background sound is included; layering and saved mixes are a separate purchase
- Tap the player to hide the controls and rest your eyes
- Lock-screen and Control Center playback controls
ONE PAYMENT, NO SUBSCRIPTION
Buy a single program, including the original Astral Projection journey, or Unlock All for every program in one payment. Nothing renews. If you had the app before version 4.1, the Astral Projection journey stays yours. Programs you bought before are still yours: tap Restore Purchases in Settings.
Hypnosis programs are intended for relaxation and self-exploration. Do not listen while driving or operating machinery. This app is not a substitute for medical or psychological care.

bluejetty:00175360:ios.summary:

Featuring the most popular Cat
bluejetty:00175360:ios.description:
** The #1 Catholic Bible App**
Designed to help Catholics read and understand the Bible, learn the teachings and tradition of the Catholic Church, and grow to live the life God is calling them to more fully.
Featuring the most popular Catholic Bible in America, the Great Adventure Catholic Bible, with the one-of-a-kind Bible Timeline® learning system that has helped hundreds of thousands of Catholics finally read AND understand God’s Word.
TOP FEATURES
THE HOLY ROSARY
Pray the Rosary with Fr. Mike Schmitz, Fr. Mark-Mary Ames, Jeff Cavins, the Sisters of Life, and Paul Rose with recordings of the Joyful, Luminous, Sorrowful, and Glorious mysteries in the Ascension app. Pray in English or Latin, with options to chant the prayers.
DAILY MASS READINGS + REFLECTIONS
Read the official Daily Mass readings and watch reflections from trusted Catholic presenters who dive deeper to unpack the readings each day. Pray also with guided lectio divina prompts directly in the app.
THE GREAT ADVENTURE CATHOLIC BIBLE
Read the full-text of the Great Adventure Catholic Bible, listen on audio with recordings from Fr. Mike Schmitz, get answers to 1000+ most-asked questions about the Bible, and dive deeper into each book and verse with the Bible Timeline® learning system and the Bible Guide.
PREP FOR SUNDAY MASS
Watch or listen to recordings of Fr. Mike Schmitz’s homilies and watch Encountering the Word where Bible scholar Jeff Cavins provides historical, Biblical, and spiritual context to the readings at Sunday Mass.
“IN A YEAR” PODCASTS
Get the best experience of the Bible in a Year, Catechism in a Year, and Rosary in a Year podcasts, with additional content, prayer aides, transcripts, answered questions, linked references and Bible verses, and more!
STUDY PLANS
Browse from 80+ study plans taught by leading Catholic presenters, including Fr. Mike Schmitz, Jeff Cavins, Dr. Edward Sri, Sarah Christmeyer, Jackie Francois Angel, and many others. Study plans are a companion to help you understand the Bible better, learn more about Catholic teaching, and strengthen you to more fully live the life God is calling you to.
SAINT OF THE DAY
Read daily reflections on the lives of the saints, following the memorials and feast days on the liturgical calendar.
CATHOLIC PRAYERS
Discover novenas, litanies, guided lectio divina and visio divina experiences, and more!
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING AND TERMS
All users can access the full text of the Bible, the full text of the Catechism, Daily Mass readings and reflections of the day, the full Rosary with all recorded voices, and most Ascension podcasts in the app for free.
To access all content and programs in the Ascension App, Ascension offers two auto-renewing subscription options:
$8.99 per month
$59.99 per year
(Please note these prices are for users in the USA)
Your Ascension subscription will renew automatically unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can go to your Apple account settings to manage your subscription and turn off auto-renew. Your account will be charged when the purchase is confirmed. Please contact us at support@ascensionpress.com if you have any issues or questions.
Privacy policy: 'https://ascensionpress.com/pages/app-privacy-policy'
Terms and conditions: 'https://ascensionpress.com/pages/terms-and-conditions'

bluejetty:00002754:android.description:
- Be found, find more.
We built Trovo to make it easier than ever for an audience to find you and for you to find your audience. Get featured on the front page with Boost Rocket, check out what’s trending with Vibetags, and use our mobile go-live tools to share content anytime, anywhere.
- Connect on a whole new level
We’re bringing a new dimension to live-streaming. Earn gems, rack up points, receive spells, win a Treasure Box. Through our chat room and subscriber benefits, we’re geared up to give the entire streaming and viewing experience a new dimension, both on- and offline. You want it interactive, you got it.
-We’re in it together
Everyone on Trovo is part of our community. Whether it’s on Discord/Whasapp/Telegram, during Product Roundtables, or at our Dev Corner Stream events, anyone can jump in. Together is always better.
-Up your game.
Maybe you’ve been doing this for years. Maybe you’re a n00b. It doesn’t matter. Trovo supports streamers at all stages. Through our New Streamer Onboard Program, Level-up and Partnership Program, we’ve got everything you need to skyrocket your stream.
-Help shape the platform
Slide into our DMs, hit us up on Discord/Whasapp/Telegram: we’re all ears. We’re totally open to learning directly from our community about what they want and need, so we can roll out updates at warp speed. Together we can continue to make Trovo amazing.

bluejetty:00118781:ios.description:
Conheça nossa plataforma de investimentos pessoais! Aqui você encontra a segurança que seu patrimônio merece.
Invista com o ABC Brasil e desfrute da tranquilidade e solidez que apenas um banco nota máxima pelas principais agências de risco pode oferecer.
Variedade de investimentos em renda fixa
Com o ABC Brasil você pode investir em renda fixa e ter a possibilidade de retornos superiores à poupança.
Conheça os investimentos selecionados por nossos especialistas e aproveite:
• LCA: Para você que deseja investir com baixo risco e ter rentabilidade maior que a poupança. Investimentos para todos os objetivos com opções de liquidez a partir de 9 meses e proteção garantida pelo Fundo Garantidor de Crédito. Além de isenção de imposto de renda (IR) e IOF para pessoa física.
• CDB: Invista com opções de resgate a qualquer momento, contando com um investimento de baixo risco, que possui liquidez diária e imposto regressivo - quanto mais tempo aplicado, menos impostos você paga sobre os rendimentos.
• COE: Combine elementos de renda fixa e renda variável em um único produto para obter e potencializar resultados em diferentes cenários econômicos, podendo contar com proteção total ou parcial do dinheiro aplicado. Uma opção diversificada para a sua carteira de investimentos.
• Debêntures: Invista a longo prazo, com isenção de imposto de renda (IR) e IOF nas incentivadas e tenha uma rentabilidade diferenciada.
• Tesouro Direto: Feito para investidores que desejam a segurança do Tesouro Nacional e baixo risco para suas aplicações. Conta com um investimento inicial a partir de R$30,00, opções com liquidez diária e diversos indexadores.
Uma plataforma de investimentos sólida
Somos um banco focado em acelerar o seu sucesso e pronto para atender as necessidades do seu patrimônio pessoal.
O ABC Brasil possui um time especialista em soluções financeiras, multidisciplinar e altamente capacitado. Nosso objetivo é impulsionar o crescimento do seu patrimônio, promovendo relações de longo prazo baseadas em lealdade, transparência e resultados.
Invista conosco e tenha uma maior rentabilidade para os seus investimentos em renda fixa. Tudo de forma 100% digital e em poucos passos. 
Baixe o aplicativo e comece agora mesmo a usar nossa plataforma de investimentos!
Dúvidas e sugestões? Entre em contato por sac.abcbrasil@abcbrasil.com.br
Para mais informações, acesse: https://www.abcbrasil.com.br/personal/

#Voca helps you speak languages more naturally and confidently.
Powered by advanced AI, Voca lets you practice real conversations anytime, anywhere. Whether you’re learning English, Spanish, Japanese, or any of our supported languages, Voca provides instant feedback to help you improve pronunciation, fluency, and grammar.
#Key Features
- Real-Time Speaking Practice — Talk with AI that listens, responds, and coaches you just like a real tutor
- Instant Feedback — Get smart, personalized insights on pronunciation, grammar, and fluency
- Daily Speaking Challenges — Build confidence with daily prompts and realistic dialogue tasks
- Smart Learning Paths — Lessons tailored to your level, goals, and chosen language
- Sound Natural — Learn authentic expressions and real-life communication skills across multiple languages
#Subscription Information
Unlock all features with a subscription available through in-app purchases. A 3-day free trial is included, after which users can choose between a monthly or yearly plan.

- Subscription Required: After the trial, continued access requires a subscription (auto-renews monthly or yearly). Pricing varies by region

bluejetty:00090769:ios.description:
Manage your SYLVANIA Smart WiFi devices with SYLVANIA Smart WiFi App.
• Quick and Easy Setup – connect new devices in seconds.
• Organize your devices by groups and rooms to control them with a simple touch.
• Control your devices from anywhere – turn on/off, customize the brightness and color to match your mood, an occasion, or the time of day. You can use the app to control your devices wherever you have an internet connection.
• Voice control – use Amazon Alexa or Google Assistant smart speaker to control your devices with just your voice. It’s as easy as, “Alexa, turn the lights to red,” or say, “Hey Google, dim the lights to 50%.”
• Use default dynamic presets of color effects or customize your own.
• Sync your compatible color lights to the sound of your music and have a party.
• Regulate your circadian rhythm with Bio-Adaptive Lighting mode with compatible lighting devices. You can use the default setting or customize your own setting. The light will automatically change color and brightness based on the time of day. 
• When away from home, use the Vacation Mode to fool burglars.
• Create automations to simplify your life. Never return home to a dark house. Set timer to turn on the lights to wake you up in the morning. You can even use it to indicate the weather – for example turning the light to blue if it’s raining outside.
• Share controls with friends and family.
Rethink, reimagine, and relive your home experience with SYLVANIA SMART+ devices.
For more information about SYLVANIA SMART WiFi products, visit https://shop.ledvanceus.com

bluejetty:00178536:ios.description:
L’IDENTITÉ NUMÉRIQUE LA POSTE, C’EST COMME PRÉSENTER VOTRE PIÈCE D’IDENTITÉ AVEC VOTRE SMARTPHONE
- Prouvez votre identité sur des centaines de services en ligne et libérez-vous de vos multiples comptes et mots de passe à gérer.
- Utilisez FranceConnect avec votre Identité Numérique La Poste et accédez à des démarches en ligne nécessitant la certitude que c’est bien vous et uniquement vous derrière la démarche en cours. 
- Retirez votre colis en Bureau de Poste en ouvrant simplement votre application Identité Numérique La Poste sur votre smartphone.
Ce service simple, sécurisé et gratuit vous fait gagner du temps et vous protège au quotidien.
COMMENT CRÉER VOTRE IDENTITÉ NUMÉRIQUE LA POSTE ?
Vous êtes majeur.e, possédez une pièce d'identité française en cours de validité et disposez d'un smartphone compatible ? Téléchargez notre application et suivez les étapes de création OU rendez-vous en bureau de poste pour créer votre Identité Numérique avec un chargé de clientèle.
OÙ UTILISER L’IDENTITÉ NUMÉRIQUE LA POSTE ?
Vous pouvez utiliser votre Identité Numérique La Poste pour accéder à plus de 1400 services publics et privés en ligne via le portail FranceConnect : services publics, fournisseurs d’énergie, banques, mutuelles, services postaux, et bien d’autres.
COMMENT UTILISER L’IDENTITÉ NUMÉRIQUE LA POSTE ?
A chaque fois que vous vous rendez sur un site proposant de vous connecter avec L’Identité Numérique La Poste :
1 - Cliquez sur le bouton L'Identité Numérique La Poste ;
2 - Saisissez vos identifiants ;
3 - Confirmez que c'est bien vous qui vous connectez en validant la demande de connexion sur l'application L'Identité Numérique.
L'Identité Numérique La Poste repose sur la combinaison unique de votre identifiant, votre application mobile et votre code secret. Cette procédure d'authentification forte permet de garantir vos accès en s'assurant que c'est bien vous qui êtes à l'origine de la demande de connexion. Avec La Poste, L'Identité Numérique c'est plus simple, plus sûre et plus pratique.
SOYEZ VIGILANT, NE COMMUNIQUEZ JAMAIS VOTRE CODE SECRET OU N’ACTIVEZ JAMAIS VOTRE IDENTITÉ NUMÉRIQUE SI QUELQU’UN VOUS LE DEMANDE EN FACE À FACE, PAR TÉLÉPHONE OU PAR MAIL.
- La Poste ne réalise pas de démarchage téléphonique pour inciter à la création d’Identité Numérique ou pour proposer un accompagnement à la création d’une Identité Numérique.
- La Poste ne vous demandera jamais le code confidentiel de votre Identité Numérique. Ne confiez jamais votre code confidentiel à un inconnu, votre Identité Numérique est personnelle.

bluejetty:00071192:ios.name: Save Location GPS - Live Share
bluejetty:00071192:ios.summary:
Save Location GPS - The app name says it all! This is your Personal Location Assistant.
Save your favorite places. Never forget where you parked the car. Share important locations with your friends or colleagues. 
Features of Save Locatio
bluejetty:00071192:ios.description:
Save Location GPS - The app name says it all! This is your Personal Location Assistant.
Save your favorite places. Never forget where you parked the car. Share important locations with your friends or colleagues. 
Features of Save Location GPS :
• Save & Share Location
Save your current location with just one click with accuracy. 
• Online/Offline Support
App will work with and without internet. You can save new location without internet. (GPS will take time to locate without internet)
• Save Location Detail
Also saves important details like Latitude, Longitude, Title, Address, and Photos to mark any location.
• Edit Saved Location
Easily edit your saved locations, or remove unwanted locations.
• Group your Locations
Have some favorite restaurants or hiking spots? Group them together for future reference.
• Different Map Types
You can see maps in Roadmap, Satellite, Hybrid and Terrain views.
• Favorite Locations
Add locations to Favorites to always remember your favorite places. Access it quickly from favourite screen.
• Navigate to Locations
Navigate with ease and find the quickest route to all your destinations with Save Location App.
• Login and Sync Locations
Login and access your favorite locations on any device. 
• Export and Import Locations
Easily export all the location data into a CSV file so you can easily make use of that data. Want to map out a group of locations to share with a work team? This feature is perfect for you.
• Support/Feedback/Feature request
We love to hear from you! In-app message us any issues or feedback. Have a new Feature idea? We would love to hear and we will for our best to serve you.
Here is some use cases :
• Visiting a new friend for the first time? The Save Location App will quickly show and save the location details with exact accuracy so you can reference it later for your next visit! The app even stores the date so you remember the last time you saw Grandma!
• Find the best restaurant in town and want to remember to bring your loved ones? Save the location in the app and even share it with your friends so they know where to find you. 
• All location data can be saved in the app for reference from other devices, all with security to ensure only you and people you want to see your location data can access it. 
This app is perfect for adventurers, business people, team leaders and those who socialise with family and friend Just imagine all the places you've been and thought how you would like to share with others. This is your chance.
Subscription pricing and terms:
Save Location GPS offers an auto-renewing yearly subscription to provide you premium services. Payment will be charged to the credit card connected to your iTunes Account when you confirm the initial subscription purchase. Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current subscription period. Your account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be identified. You may manage your subscription and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to your Account Settings after the purchase. Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when you purchase a subscription, where applicable.
Privacy Policy & Terms of Service : https://savelocationgps.com/privacypolicy.html

bluejetty:00126185:ios.description:
Glucose Companion is a handy blood sugar and weight tracker.
Keeping track of blood sugar is a good habit to keep healthy, heredity, unbalanced diet, fat, lack of exercise, too much stress etc will lead to diabetic. If blood sugar is found abnormal, quick actions should be done to keep it from getting worse.
Use Glucose Companion now to monitor your blood sugar and share your measurements with your doctor, it will help greatly to your physician to diagnose and treat your diabetes, you can also use this app to calculate the units of insulin you need to inject.
Key Features:
⁃ Easily add and edit blood sugar, weight and test date.
⁃ Add note to the readings.
⁃ Track blood sugar and weight by chart.
⁃ Analyze times and percentage of each blood sugar range.
⁃ Show MAX, MIN and AVG number of readings by number and histogram.
⁃ Show statistics of measurement by day, week, month or year.
⁃ Create a reminder for measuring Glucose, doctor visiting or anything else.
⁃ Calculate average blood sugar and weight.
⁃ Create a reminder to measure your blood suger, doctor visit or others.
⁃ Save snapshots to Photos. 
⁃ Migrate data to full version.
⁃ Export (Email) readings in format of CSV, HTML or PDF.
⁃ Custom date range of readings to be exported.
⁃ Custom your own color range.
⁃ Passcode function to protect your info.
⁃ Supports Touch ID as passcode.
⁃ Supports mg/dL and mmoL/L, US and SI.
⁃ Clean and humanized interface.
⁃ Support WiFi backup and restore.
⁃ Supports Dropbox backup and restore.
⁃ Supports AirPrint in app.
⁃ Supports transferring data to Health app.
⁃ Supports 3D Touch function.
⁃ Supports Apple Watch version.
⁃ Supports Universal version.
If you have any questions or suggestion, please mail to userfeed@vip.tom.com.
