bluejetty:00085075:ios.description:
ArriveCAN still contains Advance CBSA Declaration, which allows you to answer customs and immigration questions up to 72 hours in advance of flying into Canada. It is currently available to international air travellers who enter Canada at selected airports.
By submitting your customs and immigration information in advance, you will spend less time at a primary inspection kiosk (PIK) or eGate when you arrive at the airport. This contributes to shorter line-ups in arrivals halls.
At the border, you will be prompted to scan your travel document at a primary inspection device and confirm your identity. Once your identity has been confirmed, your Advance CBSA Declaration will be retrieved from ArriveCAN for you to review and certify. If changes are required, you can edit and update your declaration prior to certification.
Use of the Advance CBSA Declaration feature of ArriveCAN is entirely optional.
Please refer to the accessibility notice for this app: https://www.canada.ca/en/border-services-agency/services/arrivecan.html#accessibility-notice
This app supports English, French and Spanish (as per your device’s language settings).
For more information: http://www.canada.ca/ArriveCAN

bluejetty:00120063:ios.description:
Drops makes language learning an effortless fun. Practical vocabulary is bound to your memories through beautiful graphics and quick mini-games.
The crazy part? You have only 5 mins per day to learn Tagalog. Might sound insane but works like a charm! :)
These are the ingredients of the secret sauce:
100% illustrated: Pictures directly carry the meaning - you don’t have to use your native language at all! No intermediary. Faster, more effective and of course more fun for Tagalog learning process! :)
5 min sessions: limiting practice time sounds crazy but it it makes it incredibly addictive - which is cool thing for learning. The barrier of entry is close to zero so you can’t have any excuses: you’ll have 5 minutes even on the busiest day!
Effortless play: We know why games are fun and addictive and distilled the essence into Drops. The result is a truly immersive experience but it’s not waste of your time while you play because you build a valuable knowledge.
Quick: Keyboard typing is painfully slow. Welcome rapid swipes and taps! Especially for Tagalog vowels, and consonants. Trust us, you’ll need those extra seconds during the quick learning session ;)
Vocabulary only: Zero grammar, just handpicked practical words. That’s our focus and we do it extremely well. The app teaches the Tagalog alphabet as well.
Forge a habit: Drops wants to make you language learning addict. Effectiveness is nothing without a well established habit. We help you build one!
We are extremely proud of our lovely word pronunciations by seasoned voice talents!
Drops is free for casual learners: more than 2700 words in 150+ topics are all available for everyone. Hardcore language learners can subscribe for premium to progress faster with unlimited Tagalog language learning time.
Our goal is to empower people of the world via language knowledge by providing a special tool that utilizes the universal language we all speak: pictures.

bluejetty:00065938:ios.description:
Learn to play the Diatonic Button Accordion (Melodeon) quickly and fun, for FREE
LEARN SONGS, SCALES, CHORDS AND EXERCISES
 * Songs: Learn didactic songs with the note game!
 * Chords: Learn all musical chords, with bellows pull and push variations!
 * Scales: Learn all musical scales, using the correct fingers on each note! The app indicates which finger to use and which note to play!
 * Exercises: There are 2 modules with 40 exercises to take you from basic to advanced, unlocking each exercise in a fun and educational game.
ACCORDIONS WITH REALISTIC SOUNDS
* There are 120 accordions, each with a different sound!
* Realistic sounds. More than 50 registers like on a real accordion. Musette, Violin, Concertina, Bassoon, Bandoneon, Organ, Harmonium, Piccolo, Organ y muchos otros
* Create your own accordion with your colors and shapes
LOOPS, RHYTHMS AND METRONOME
* Percussion rhythms and loops: Norteño, Vallenato, Bhangra, Bhajan, Qawwali, Carnatic, Cumbia, mesquite, Folk, Forró, and more.
* Metronome included. Change the speed (BPM) of loops, rhythms and metronome to learn at the correct time
RECORD AND SHARE YOUR MUSIC
* Recording and playing your music
* Save your recordings as video or MIDI
* Share your song on social media with 1 click!
ADJUST AND FACILITATE YOUR LEARNING
* More than 100 FREE keys: G/C/F, E/A/D, F/Bb/Eb, among others...
* Show the notes in each button, and highlighting when playing
* Increase or decrease the size of buttons. There are up to 3 rows and 16 basses
* Change notes by opening and closing the bellows like a real accordion!
* Play using a PC (computer) keyboard via USB or Bluetooth, providing a much more realistic feel that is closer to a real accordion!
Accordion Diatonic Cassoto is an educational, fun and FREE app. Created for children and adults to learn to play songs on the diatonic accordion, and practice with loops, playbacks, and metronome, in the correct tempo/beat.
It already comes with more than 80 loops and variations of the most popular musical styles, such as: Norteño, Vallenato, Forró, Country, Waltz, Bhangra, Bhajan, Cumbia, Chamamé, Vanerão, among other styles.
There are more than 100 FREE keys/tunnings for you to learn to play in the tone you prefer!
Make recordings of your songs and save them as video or MIDI. Share on your social networks with just 1 click
Questions or suggestions, please contact: gmobilerapps@gmail.com

bluejetty:00064047:ios.description:
Curious about Scientology? Watch Scientology TV on your phone, tablet or TV and find out for yourself. No subscription or login required.
Scientology has launched its own television channel—the Scientology Network. 
Airing 24/7, the Scientology Network aims to satisfy the overwhelming curiosity about our religion. The new network won’t just answer people’s questions, it will take them inside the religion itself.
To accomplish that, the network offers exclusive innovative content that moves religious broadcasting in an entirely new direction. Like Scientology itself, that approach is fresh, different and dynamic. It does not seek to preach, convince or convert, but simply inform.
This new genre of religious broadcasting includes original programs that take viewers into the everyday lives of Scientologists, the Church as an institution and its organizations. These programs show our religion in action, providing not just insights into the only major religion to emerge in the last century, but also offering a fresh take on compelling television entertainment demanded by today’s digital world.
What is in the app?
- Simply install the app and you can begin watching instantly. 
- Watch the live stream 24/7 or browse titles and watch your favorite shows on demand. Every title is broadcast in 17 languages.
- Create a free personal profile to sync your viewing across all your devices. 
- Download full TV shows and films for offline viewing.
- Video on demand: Watch full episodes of the Scientology Network original series—Inside Scientology • Meet a Scientologist • Voices for Humanity • Destination: Scientology • I am a Scientologist • L. Ron Hubbard: In His Own Voice.
- Films on Scientology beliefs and practices: Principles of Scientology • Scientology: The Fundamentals of Thought • The Problems of Work: Scientology Applied to the Workaday World • Scientology: Tools for Life.
- Groundbreaking writings of L. Ron Hubbard illuminated on film in L. Ron Hubbard Library Presents: Is It Possible to Be Happy? (narrated by L. Ron Hubbard himself) • My Philosophy • The True Story of Scientology • Personal Integrity • What Is Greatness? • The Third Party Law • Honest People Have Rights, Too • Anti-Social/Social Personality • What is Dianetics? • Dianetics of Grief.
- The Way to Happiness: L. Ron Hubbard’s moral code and common sense guide to living universally applied to anyone regardless of religion or cultural background. 
- Humanitarian Documentaries that are at the core of the Church’s drug education and human rights campaigns: The Truth About Drugs: Real People, Real Stories • They Said, They Lied • The Story of Human Rights • 30 Rights Brought to Life • Psychiatry: An Industry of Death • Making a Killing: The Untold Story of Psychotropic Drugging • The Marketing of Madness: Are We All Insane? • Diagnostic & Statistical Manual: Psychiatry’s Deadliest Scam • The Hidden Enemy: Inside Psychiatry’s Covert Agenda • The Age of Fear: Psychiatry’s Reign of Terror.
Unlike conventional TV channels, the Scientology Network produces all its television content in-house at Scientology Media Productions. These original programs air with no paid advertising.
- Documentary Showcase: Fundamental to Scientology is a humanitarian mission of extraordinary scope, now extending to some 200 nations. Included therein are programs for human rights, human decency, literacy, morals, drug prevention and disaster relief. For this reason, the Scientology Network provides a platform for Independent filmmakers who embrace a vision of building a better world.
The all-new series, Documentary Showcase, debuts films weekly from award-winning Independent filmmakers whose goal is to improve society by raising awareness of social, cultural and environmental issues.
Privacy policy: https://www.scientology.org/privacy-notice.html

listings.name: Scientology Network
listings.description:
Curious about Scientology? Watch Scientology TV on your phone, tablet or TV and find out for yourself. No subscription or login required.

Scientology has launched its own television channel—the Scientology Network. 

Airing 24/7, the Scientology Network aims to satisfy the overwhelming curiosity about our religion. The new network won’t just answer people’s questions, it will take them inside the religion itself.

To accomplish that, the network offers exclusive innovative content that moves religious broadcasting in an entirely new direction. Like Scientology itself, that approach is fresh, different and dynamic. It does not seek to preach, convince or convert, but simply inform.

This new genre of religious broadcasting includes original programs that take viewers into the everyday lives of Scientologists, the Church as an institution and its organizations. These programs show our religion in action, providing not just insights into the only major religion to emerge in the last century, but also offering a fresh take on compelling television entertainment demanded by today’s digital world.

What is in the app?

- Simply install the app and you can begin watching instantly. 

- Watch the live stream 24/7 or browse titles and watch your favorite shows on demand. Every title is broadcast in 17 languages.

- Create a free personal profile to sync your viewing across all your devices. 

- Download full TV shows and films for offline viewing.

- Video on demand: Watch full episodes of the Scientology Network original series—Inside Scientology • Meet a Scientologist • Voices for Humanity • Destination: Scientology • I am a Scientologist • L. Ron Hubbard: In His Own Voice.

- Films on Scientology beliefs and practices: Principles of Scientology • Scientology: The Fundamentals of Thought • The Problems of Work: Scientology Applied to the Workaday World • Scientology: Tools for Life.

- Groundbreaking writings of L. Ron Hubbard illuminated on film in L. Ron Hubbard Library Presents: Is It Possible to Be Happy? (narrated by L. Ron Hubbard himself) • My Philosophy • The True Story of Scientology • Personal Integrity • What Is Greatness? • The Third Party Law • Honest People Have Rights, Too • Anti-Social/Social Personality • What is Dianetics? • Dianetics of Grief.

- The Way to Happiness: L. Ron Hubbard’s moral code and common sense guide to living universally applied to anyone regardless of religion or cultural background. 

- Humanitarian Documentaries that are at the core of the Church’s drug education and human rights campaigns: The Truth About Drugs: Real People, Real Stories • They Said, They Lied • The Story of Human Rights • 30 Rights Brought to Life • Psychiatry: An Industry of Death • Making a Killing: The Untold Story of Psychotropic Drugging • The Marketing of Madness: Are We All Insane? • Diagnostic & Statistical Manual: Psychiatry’s Deadliest Scam • The Hidden Enemy: Inside Psychiatry’s Covert Agenda • The Age of Fear: Psychiatry’s Reign of Terror.

Unlike conventional TV channels, the Scientology Network produces all its television content in-house at Scientology Media Productions. These original programs air with no paid advertising.

- Documentary Showcase: Fundamental to Scientology is a humanitarian mission of extraordinary scope, now extending to some 200 nations. Included therein are programs for human rights, human decency, literacy, morals, drug prevention and disaster relief. For this reason, the Scientology Network provides a platform for Independent filmmakers who embrace a vision of building a better world.

The all-new series, Documentary Showcase, debuts films weekly from award-winning Independent filmmakers whose goal is to improve society by raising awareness of social, cultural and environmental issues.

bluejetty:00096240:ios.description:
Have you ever wondered what’s really behind a bark or a meow? Pet & More is a revolutionary mobile app designed to strengthen the bond between you and your furry companions. Using advanced Artificial Intelligence, our app analyzes sounds and visuals to help you better understand their world.
With Pet & More, you can learn not only what your adorable friends might be trying to say but also how they are feeling. Help them live happier and healthier lives by becoming more attuned to their needs.
KEY FEATURES:
*** Cat finder:Trying to locate your cat nearby or get their attention?
Cat Finder plays short, natural cat sounds designed to help attract a cat’s attention in the surrounding area.
This feature can be helpful when your cat is hiding indoors or when you want to gently draw the attention of nearby cats.
Results may vary depending on the environment and the cat’s personality.
Voice Translator: Is your cat's purr a request for affection, or does your dog's bark mean it's playtime? Simply record your pet's sounds and let our AI analyze vocal patterns to translate them into potential emotions like happiness, anxiety, or hunger.
Mood Scanner: A picture can reveal a lot. Snap a photo of your furry friend, and let our app analyze their facial expressions, body language, and posture to give you an insight into their current mood.
Video Analysis: Gain deeper insights from your pet's actions. Record a short video to help identify behavioral patterns like playfulness, attention-seeking, or discomfort, giving you a clearer understanding of what they might need.
Breed Identifier: Discover the unique heritage of your companion. Upload a photo of your cat or dog, and our AI will analyze features like fur, face, and body structure to reveal their likely breed composition, whether they are purebred or mixed.
FREE & PREMIUM FEATURES:
Pet & More can be downloaded for free. The free version offers limited access to all features and is supported by ads. You can try our translator, scanner, and identifier a few times to see how it works.
For unlimited access and an ad-free experience, subscribe to Pet & More Premium. Unlock endless translations and analyses to connect with your pet anytime.
IMPORTANT DISCLAIMER:
This application utilizes advanced AI to provide interpretations of your pet's vocalizations and behaviors. The results are intended for entertainment purposes and to enhance your bond with your pet. This tool is not a substitute for the advice of a veterinarian or a certified animal behaviorist. Please consult a qualified professional for any health or behavioral concerns. This app is intended for personal, non-commercial use only. Please use it responsibly.
Download Pet & More now and open the door to a new level of communication with your furry family member
About Subscriptions
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period.
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours of the end of the current period, and the cost of the renewal will be provided.
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase.
•You can cancel your subscription by entering the following address: https://support.apple.com/en-us/HT202039

* Curated collections for all styles and seasons

* Create photo watch face collections that auto-rotate throughout the day

* Pregnancy Smart Face: personalized countdown and milestone widgets

bluejetty:00119587:ios.summary: Simple In/Out is the easiest to use in/out board in the App Store. It is great for offices with people always on the go. Our easy to use interface lets you quickly set your status and get back to work. You can also configure your phone to u
bluejetty:00119587:ios.description:
Simple In/Out is the easiest to use in/out board in the App Store. It is great for offices with people always on the go. Our easy to use interface lets you quickly set your status and get back to work. You can also configure your phone to update your status automatically based on your device's location.
Here is a quick rundown of all the great features we offer in Simple In/Out:
* Board - Easy to read and configure status board.
* Users - Admins can add or edit users right from the app. Each user can have their own information and permissions.
* User Profiles - Individual profile pages for each user. You can email, call, or text a user right from their profile.
* Automatic Status Updates - Update your status right from your pocket.
*** Geofences - Uses low-power location events to determine if you are inside the defined area. We take privacy very seriously and your location will never be tracked or stored.
*** Beacons - Uses Bluetooth to determine if you are near a broadcast point. Beacon signals can be transmitted from our FrontDesk and TimeClock apps.
*** Networks - Updates your status when you connect to a specific WiFi hotspot.
* Notifications - Receive alerts right on your device for important events.
*** Status Updates - Alerts you each time your status has been updated automatically. This helps you make sure your status on the board is up to date.
*** Followed Users - Get notified instantly when another user updates their status.
*** Reminders - Get prompted if you haven't updated your status by a specific time of day.
*** Safeties - Alerts you when other users haven't checked in on time.
* Scheduled Status Updates - Create a status update in advance.
* Announcements - Stay informed about important company updates and new events.
* Active Time - Disable Notifications and Automatic Updates when you aren't working.
* Quick Picks - Easily update your status from your recent status updates or favorites.
* Groups - Used to organize your users.
* FrontDesk - (separate download) is also available for common areas to quickly swipe yourself in or out.
* TimeClock - (separate download) is also available for timekeeping.
* Free customer support via email
We love hearing from our users and are always interested in what they have to say. Most of the features in the app have come from your suggestions, so keep them coming!
email: help@simplymadeapps.com
https://www.simpleinout.com/privacy_apple
https://www.simpleinout.com/terms_apple
**This app may use your location even when it isn’t open, which can decrease device battery life.

bluejetty:00100069:android.description:
Who’s the imposter among your friends?
Find the Impostor is a fast, fun, and easy-to-play word guessing and social deduction party game where one player is the fake spy hiding in plain sight. Read the clues, bluff with confidence, and use deduction, deception, and instinct to solve who’s lying before time runs out.
A perfect brain challenge for parties, trips, and recent group nights — full of tension, laughs, debate, and chaos in seconds.
Gather your group, start playing, and test your intuition. Ideal for house parties, road trips, family nights, or hanging out with friends you love.
How to Play
1️⃣ Everyone sees the same secret word… except one player.
2️⃣ That player only sees the word “IMPOSTOR.”
3️⃣ Each player gives a clue by saying one related word.
4️⃣ The impostor must guess, fake it, blend in, and act like the liar isn’t them.
5️⃣ After a few rounds, players vote on who they think the impostor is.
New Accusation Options
Accuse and vote at any moment — or wait until the final reveal.
🗳️ Vote and eliminate a player mid-game to instantly check if they were one of the impostors
🕵️ Or play it safe and wait for the final vote to reveal the impostor and the secret word
🔥 Adds tension, strategy, and mind games to every round
Find the Impostor mixes word games, bluffing, and social deduction spy game into one addictive party app with multiple modes:
⚡ Spot the liar and expose the hidden spy
⚡ Bluff, argue, and debate using clues and logic
⚡ Use deduction, deception, and instinct to solve the mystery
⚡ Every round is a new challenge
Each game feels different — no two rounds are ever the same. It’s the ultimate party word game for social deduction fans.
Game Features
🔸 Play locally with 3 to 20 players on a single device
🔸 Over 15 free categories: food, movies, animals, soccer, anime, and more
🔸 Hundreds of unique secret words, constantly updated
🔸 Create custom categories with your own words
🔸 Competition Mode with points, winners, and leaderboard
🔸 Add multiple impostors or activate a timer for extra challenge
🔸 No accounts, no sign-up, no Wi-Fi — full privacy and offline play
🔸 Easy, simple, and quick to learn
🔸 Designed for kids, teens, and adults
🔸 Fully optimized for phones and tablets
🔸 Available in English, Portuguese, Italian, French, German and Spanish
Competition Mode
Take the game to the next level with a true deduction challenge:
🏆 Each round has a winner
⭐ Players earn points automatically based on their role
📈 Track who’s leading and who’s last on the leaderboard
🔥 Perfect for competitive groups who love strategy, mind games, and deception
Family-Friendly & Viral Fun
✅ A family-friendly party game app for kids, teens, and adults
✅ Not a drinking game
✅ Clear rules, simple terms, and safe content
✅ Viral on social media as one of the most fun and clever guessing games
Kids Mode & Family Play
👨👩👧👦 Kids Mode included, designed especially for children and families. Play a safe and adapted version of the classic impostor game with:
✅ Illustrated visuals and friendly design
✅ Simple and easy words for kids
✅ Educational and age-appropriate content
✅ No inappropriate language or themes
Perfect for family game nights, classrooms, or playing offline with kids of all ages.
Online Multiplayer Mode
🌍 Play online with up to 20 friends — everyone on their own device.
Create a room, share the code, and start playing in seconds, wherever you are. Perfect for remote game nights, group calls, or playing with friends at a distance.
Play anywhere, anytime — online or offline, at home, on trips, or during group calls.
🎉 Find the Impostor turns any hangout into a night of laughs, bluffing, and brain-burning deduction. Are you smart enough to stay hidden… or sharp enough to expose the fake?
📲 Download now and enjoy one of the most viral and ultimate party word games ever.
Created by Game of Shots – The Original Partyverse Studios.

bluejetty:00077713:ios.description:
Your Fast-Track to Quality Care
The MyMethodist app connects you to quality care from Houston Methodist — anytime, anywhere. Take control of your health and enjoy an experience more personalized to your needs. Whether you’re looking for same-day care, messaging your care team, managing appointments or finding a new doctor, everything is just a tap away.
Plus, stay informed and inspired with expert wellness tips, articles, videos and podcasts from our On Health team — all in one place.
With the MyMethodist app you can:
• Access your MyChart account to schedule with your provider, send a message, review test results and more. 
• Pay your bill as a guest.
• Find a new provider or schedule with an existing provider. 
• Quickly launch a 24/7, on-demand Virtual Urgent Care video visit.
• Schedule an in-person appointment at one of our Same Day Clinics near you.
• Find a location you need, from emergency care or injury clinics to imaging centers.
• Get expert health and wellness content through our On Health blog.
• Upload health and fitness data, including data from the “Apple Health app,” when enrolled in self-tracking programs.
To learn more about MyMethodist app benefits and functionality, please visit houstonmethodist.org/mymethodist-app/.

bluejetty:00054602:android.description:
FANTASTIC HIDDEN OBJECT PUZZLE ADVENTURE GAME FROM THE CREATORS OF ENIGMATIS AND GRIM LEGENDS!

62 hand drawn mysterious locations set in 18th century Europe! 
18th century Europe: fifty years after a mysterious, far-reaching plague swept the land of the Habsburg dynasty, a series of horrifying, unexplainable deaths occur in the fascinating, , and remote Serbian town of Kisilova. Fearing that the story may be repeating itself, the residents begin to flee their homes.
Put on your detective hat and embark on a dangerous adventure! 
Summoned by the Prince of Württemberg himself, Imperial emissaries come to Kisilova to investigate the mysterious events and prevent further deaths.

Continue the story in the Collector’s Edition!

bluejetty:00017935:ios.description:
The Freedom First Mobile App is a free mobile decision-support tool. It is fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your personal finances.
FEATURES
Alerts & Notifications: Set alerts for low funds and be notified about upcoming bills.
Add Tags, Notes, Images & Geo-Information: By enhancing transactions with custom tags, notes or photos of a receipt or check, you have the ability to stay organized and find exactly what you’re looking for when searching through your finances.
Contact: Locate ATMs or branches and contact Freedom First FCU customer service directly from the app.
SAFE AND SECURE
The app utilizes the same bank-level security that protects you when you’re on Internet Banking. The app also features a unique 4-digit passcode setting that prevents unauthorized access.
GETTING STARTED
To use the Freedom First Mobile App, you must be enrolled as a Freedom First FCU Internet Banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials. After you successfully login to the app, your accounts and transactions will begin updating.

bluejetty:00000561:ios.description:
Welcome to Food Street, a free restaurant and cafe management story world!
You are the Master Chef of your own cafe, bakery, diner or restaurant! 
Build and decorate the kitchen and restaurant of your dreams in a stunning farmville 3D world and start cooking with a huge selection of ingredients. Build a bakery to bake tasty dishes from all around the world, make street food, or create a 5-star restaurant that meets even gordon ramsey's taste! 
Show the world you are the rising super chef!
Visit friends, trade food items with other my restaurant owners around cafe world and play together in friendly online competitions in my town! Be the food tycoon!
Keep all the customers in food town happy as you bake, cook and do even more in Food Street, your master chef story in cafe land!
---------------------------
GAME FEATURES
---------------------------
Build, Decorate & Manage a World-Famous Restaurant!
• Customize your restaurant and start your cooking story. Build a bakery with the Bread Oven, a cozy cafe with the Breakfast Stove, or even your own Smoothie Bar!
• Get cooking! Bake tasty dishes in your restaurant from around the world with home-grown ingredients!
Farm for Fresh Ingredients!
• Keep your garden growing! Farm fresh ingredients like tomatoes, garlic and other vegetables from your own personal farmville garden!
• Lots of hungry customers? Expand your garden to keep the food craze alive!
Hire Your Own Chef & Wait Staff!
• Manager game where you can upgrade your restaurant, bakery or cafe so you don't overcook 2 a crisp!
• Hire a chef for all the cooking and a great serving staff that can dash around and take orders!
• Unlock and purchase new uniforms for your employees from other shops in town!
Trade Ingredients & Dishes with Friends!
• Trade ingredients to help each other out with cooking and support one another’s restaurants.
• Expand your menu to keep everyone in your town full and happy!
Collaborate in Food Clubs & Compete in Friendly Competitions!
• Compete against other restaurant owners to see which master chef can cook the tastiest dishes and come out on top of the cooking competition!
Prepare Your Cafe with Seasonal Events, Themed Dishes & Decorations!
• Keep your business looking snazzy with decorations that you can purchase for your restaurant and farm!
• Prepare your restaurant for special events and celebrations with seasonal decorations, special events and lots of food!
• Get ready for limited events during seasonal periods and fun, holiday-themed activities in your cafe or restaurant!
PLEASE NOTE: Food Street - Restaurant Gameis free to download. However, purchases can be made in the game for real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases in your device settings. A network connection is required to play.
---------------------------
SUPPORT
---------------------------
If you’re having problems with Food Street - Restaurant Game, we’re very sorry. Need help? Visit our Help Centre https://supersolid.zendesk.com/
Privacy Policy:
http://supersolid.com/privacy/
Terms of Service:
http://supersolid.com/tos/

bluejetty:00087252:ios.description:
The DUOTONE Academy App
A unique all-in-one tool to improve your kiteboarding skills in no time!
The Duotone Academy App is designed for aspiring kite surfers wanting to reach the next level. Whether you are a rookie or an experienced rider, the Duotone Academy App will show you what tricks to learn next in your progression. From beginner lessons to advanced freestyle moves, wave riding, and foiling, the app offers step-by-step tutorials for each kiteboarding discipline and level. In addition, you can connect with super coaches, including professional riders like Aaron Hadlow, Lasse Walker & more, to get further tips from the world’s best & land the trick of your dreams. To help you work on your training off the water, Duotone has teamed up with Porsche to bring their TAG Heuer Porsche Formula E Tea fitness routine expertise to kitesurfing. Reshape the way you train, become more athletic, and get the best out of every session! It’s never been easier to stay connected to the community; you can search for other riders, kite spots, Pro centers, events, and our partner shops all in one place. Follow centers & events to stay updated with what’s happening near you. Direct message other kiters to meet up for a session and get local insights on the spot.
What it’s all about:
- More than 250 tricks & fitness trainings
- Six kiteboarding disciplines
- Finding new kite buddies with the spot feature has never been easier
- Get in touch with riders from all over the world
- See our partner shops, Pro Centers, Camps & Test Events
- Learn from the best
LEVEL UP your riding
- Watch the correct execution of a trick/study lesson videos/follow the how-to’s, read the descriptions, and memorize the key elements
- Get pointers directly from the kiteboarding community by sharing your trick on the all-new stage
- Get feedback from our Super Coaches
- Improve your strength and mobility with our Porsche Motorsport workouts
- Reduce the risk of injuries by following our warm-ups before each session
Stay MOTIVATED
- Collect points, unlock badges, and compete with your friends on the leaderboard
- Upload your tricks and receive votes from the kiteboarding community
- Take part in our various Porsche challenges with the chance to win amazing experiences and prizes
Use the app WHEREVER you are
- Kite spots are not always located within signal reach, which is why the app also operates in offline mode
- Download lesson videos beforehand and access them even in the most remote places
Become PART of the DUOTONE family
- Get feedback directly from our Super Coaches

bluejetty:00043431:ios.description:
About This App:
GeoBallistics is a mobile app available for iOS devices and is compatible with Vortex Razor HD 4000 GB and Vortex Relay™ devices. The app allows users the freedom to build and create unlimited rifle profiles, connect with weather-hardware for onsite atmospherics, build/save/export satellite imagery range cards, and more. 
Key App Features:
• Online Rifle Backup
• Online Range Card Backup
• Match Downloads 
• Shooting Range Downloads
• Movers Calculator
• First Ever Holdover calculator
• Advanced Ballistics Solver
• Comprehensive Bullet Library
• Online weather access with station pressure
• Free WeatherFlow hardware compatibility
• Kestrel LiNK hardware compatibility (PRO version)
• Shot-angle calculator
• Shot-bearing calculator
• Unlimited Rifle Profiles (PRO version)
• Ability to save charts to camera roll (PRO version)
• Ability to export charts as .csv (PRO version)
• Ability to save/load satellite range cards for later use (PRO version)
• Muzzle Velocity Truing
• Coriolis effect auto-calculated with position and latitude
The GeoBallistics mobile app is powered by the BallisticsARC (Ballistics, Atmospherics, and Range Card) solver, and combines the functionality of a ballistics calculator, an atmospheric device, and a GPS rangefinder into one application.
The BallisticsARC solver is an advanced 3 DOF solver with provisions for MV vs Temp, Coriolis, spin drift, crosswind jump, moving targets, multiple targets with unique azimuths and angles and much more.
GeoBallistics includes 4 modes: HUD Mode, Chart Mode, Map Mode, and Comp Mode. All modes are accessible with 1 custom rifle. In order to add additional rifles and save/export range cards, use Kestrel devices, or backup data online, you must upgrade to the PRO version for a one-time fee.
HUD Mode puts everything you need on one screen for a single target. This is also where the moving target feature and max ordinate display is located.
Chart Mode is a traditional calculator that allows for a complete solution. Solutions include considerations for gyroscopic drift, Coriolis effect, wind influence, shot angle, atmospheric conditions, and more. Chart Mode also allows FREE integration of the WeatherFlow products.
Map Mode allows users to range targets by dropping pins on satellite imagery of a shooting location. Range and solution are displayed by tapping on the target pins. Map Mode also introduces external ballistic data overlays on satellite imagery. These overlays display a bullet's performance along its path according to parameters specified for each rifle profile.
Comp Mode allows the user to enter a course of fire with multiple targets with unique variables such as shot angle and shot azimuth. Now features the Holdover Data Zero setting (HDZ) calculator. This is a first-in-class feature that allows you to easily set an optimal zero for holdover stages.

The Outdoor Bank App is your personal financial advocate that gives you the ability to aggregate all of your financial accounts, including accounts from other banks and credit unions, into a single view. It’s fast, secure and makes life easier by empowering you with the tools you need to manage your finances.
Here’s what else you can do with The Outdoor Bank App:
- Keep your transactions organized by allowing you to add tags, notes and photos of receipts and checks.
- Set up alerts so you know when your balance drops below a certain amount
- Make payments, whether you’re paying a company or a friend
- Transfer money between your accounts
- Deposit checks in a snap by taking a picture of the front and back
- Reorder your debit card or turn it off if you’ve misplaced it
- View and save your monthly statements
- Find branches and ATMs near you
Secure your account with a 4-digit passcode and fingerprint or face reader on supported devices. 
To use The Outdoor Bank App, you must be enrolled as a Peoples State Bank digital banking user. If you currently use our Internet Banking, simply download the app, launch it, and login with the same Internet Banking credentials.

Have you ever dreamed of managing your own hospital, treating a variety of unique patients, and exploring a fun world of medical challenges? You can achieve those dreams in Hospital Mania - Zoo Story!
Step into the wild world of Hospital Mania - Zoo Story, where you'll manage your very own crazy clinic and treat a delightful menagerie of animal patients! This isn't just any medical simulator; it's the ultimate time-management challenge, packed with frenzy and fun!
Dive into the Heart of the Zoo's Health Care!
Become the go-to doctor in this happy hospital adventure! From the moment you begin, you'll embark on a journey through over 70 unique clinics and conquer more than 2700 riveting levels. Each new area brings fresh medical mysteries and a diverse array of zoo animals waiting for your expert care. Heal everything from a sprightly kangaroo's sprain to a cuddly panda's sniffles. Master hundreds of illnesses and fill your clinic’s achievement book as you become a true animal doctor!
Master the Art of Time-Management & Strategy!
Success in Hospital Mania isn't just about speed; it's about smarts! Hone your time-management skills as you juggle multiple treatments, prepare the right medical tools, and strategically manage your resources. Can you handle the clinic mania when a sudden rush of animal patients arrives? Every tap counts in this fast-paced hospital simulator, requiring both quick reflexes and sharp strategic thinking to ensure every creature leaves your clinic happy and healthy.
Upgrade, Grow, and Conquer New Challenges!
To keep up with the demands of your thriving animal hospital, you'll need the best equipment! Earn coins from successful treatments and invest them wisely to upgrade your zoo clinic's facilities and advanced medical tools. Track your progress, unlock special rewards, and watch your hospital grow from a simple clinic into a state-of-the-art medical marvel. Your journey to becoming the ultimate hospital hero is just beginning!
Endless Fun & Crazy Events Await!
The fun never stops in Hospital Mania! Immerse yourself in exciting special events with limited-time clinics, from festive Halloween celebrations to vibrant Spring Festivals. New animal patients and expansions are regularly added, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging. Need a boost? Connect with friends, send energy, and share your most epic medical victories! Play anytime, anywhere, with or without internet connection.
Ready for a truly crazy and rewarding hospital simulator experience? Don't wait! Download Hospital Mania - Zoo Story today and unleash the frenzy of managing your own happy hospital!
Got some trouble with our hospital games, questions or ideas?

Step into the wild world of Hospital Mania - Zoo Story, where you'll manage your very own crazy clinic and treat a delightful menagerie of animal patients! This isn't just any medical simulator; it's the ultimate time-management challenge, packed with frenzy and fun!

Dive into the Heart of the Zoo's Health Care!
Become the go-to doctor in this happy hospital adventure! From the moment you begin, you'll embark on a journey through over 70 unique clinics and conquer more than 2700 riveting levels. Each new area brings fresh medical mysteries and a diverse array of zoo animals waiting for your expert care. Heal everything from a sprightly kangaroo's sprain to a cuddly panda's sniffles. Master hundreds of illnesses and fill your clinic’s achievement book as you become a true animal doctor!

Master the Art of Time-Management & Strategy!
Success in Hospital Mania isn't just about speed; it's about smarts! Hone your time-management skills as you juggle multiple treatments, prepare the right medical tools, and strategically manage your resources. Can you handle the clinic mania when a sudden rush of animal patients arrives? Every tap counts in this fast-paced hospital simulator, requiring both quick reflexes and sharp strategic thinking to ensure every creature leaves your clinic happy and healthy.

Upgrade, Grow, and Conquer New Challenges!
To keep up with the demands of your thriving animal hospital, you'll need the best equipment! Earn coins from successful treatments and invest them wisely to upgrade your zoo clinic's facilities and advanced medical tools. Track your progress, unlock special rewards, and watch your hospital grow from a simple clinic into a state-of-the-art medical marvel. Your journey to becoming the ultimate hospital hero is just beginning!

Endless Fun & Crazy Events Await!
The fun never stops in Hospital Mania! Immerse yourself in exciting special events with limited-time clinics, from festive Halloween celebrations to vibrant Spring Festivals. New animal patients and expansions are regularly added, keeping the gameplay fresh and engaging. Need a boost? Connect with friends, send energy, and share your most epic medical victories! Play anytime, anywhere, with or without internet connection.

Ready for a truly crazy and rewarding hospital simulator experience? Don't wait! Download Hospital Mania - Zoo Story today and unleash the frenzy of managing your own happy hospital!

Got some trouble with our hospital games, questions or ideas?
Contact us here!
contact@hospital-mania.com

Create your next logo on your iPhone, iPad or iPod Touch with InstaLogo Logo Maker 2. And with a fresh new design and Apple Watch support, it’s even easier to create a great-looking logo and design on the go.

InstaLogo Logo Maker 2 turns your iOS device into a logo-making machine. In minutes, you can design logos, posters, flyers, invitations and more. *****
You’re in good hands with the most popular logo maker app on the App Store, whenever you want to:
Create Beautiful Logos
- Choose from a massive library of logos
- Import your photos from your Photo Library
- Select from a huge selection of fonts, or import your own
- Copy and paste text, images and more into InstaLogo Logo Maker 2
- Pinch, drag and spin your logo elements to change size and perspective
Adjust & Modify An Existing Logo

- Add professional-grade shadows
- Use grid lines to align everything perfectly
- Move elements by the degree, for super accurate results
Fix A Mistake
- Undo and redo every step
- Erase any part of your logo, or the whole thing, easily
- Move things around with the Lasso tool
Release Your Creativity
- Draw with your finger or a stylus, now with 3D Touch support
- Select colors from the new color palette app on Apple Watch
- Let your creativity fly with support for iPad Pro and Apple Pencil
Share and Save Your Logos

- Upload your images to Dropbox, Evernote and Box, so they’re safe and shareable
- Share your logos by email or upload them directly to Facebook
*****
Feature List:
- Works on iPhone, iPad and iPod touch
- Support for iPad Pro, Apple Pencil and Apple Watch
- Multitasking support on iPad Air 2 and newer
- 3D Touch support for iPhone 6s, 6s Plus, 7 and 7 Plus
- Works in landscape and portrait
- Over 50,000 logo combinations
- More than 270 handpicked latin and non-latin fonts
- Import your own images from Photo Library
- Move, resize, rotate, flip, and nudge objects
- Fill text and logos with images
- Add custom borders to your text
- Adjust text spacing and arc
- Professional RGB/HSB/Hex color picker
- Favorites color palette
- Canvas and photo cropping
- Adjust the opacity of every object
- Smart guides
- Professional shadow editor
- Full Undo and Redo
- Finger and stylus support
- Eraser tool
- Lasso tool
- Transparent PNG support
- AirPrint support
- Available in 29 languages
*****
Some features may require in-app purchases.
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
InstaLogo 2 is free to download. Pro Subscription gives you unlimited access to our premium content and features.
- Subscriptions are billed weekly, monthly or annually at the rate depending on the subscription plan.
- Free trial subscription is automatically renewed unless cancelled 24 hours before the renewal.
- Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable.
- Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase, but refunds will not be provided for any unused portion of the term. 
- Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase.
- Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours prior to the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal.

bluejetty:00014794:ios.name: Things 3 for iPad
bluejetty:00014794:ios.summary:
Get things done! The award-winning Things app helps you plan your day, manage your projects, and make real progress toward your goals.
Best of all, it’s easy to use. Within the hour, you’ll have everything off your mind and neatly organize
bluejetty:00014794:ios.description:
Get things done! The award-winning Things app helps you plan your day, manage your projects, and make real progress toward your goals.
Best of all, it’s easy to use. Within the hour, you’ll have everything off your mind and neatly organized—from routine tasks to your biggest life goals—and you can start focusing on what matters today.
“Things offers the best combination of design and functionality of any app we tested, with nearly all the features of other power user applications and a delightful interface that never gets in the way of your work.”
—Wirecutter, The New York Times
KEY FEATURES
• Your To-Dos
Your basic building block is the almighty To-Do—each a small step toward a great accomplishment. You can add notes, tag it, schedule it, and break it down into smaller steps.
• Your Projects
Create a Project for any big goal, then add the to-dos to reach it. Use headings to structure your list as you outline your plan. There’s also a place to jot down your notes, and a deadline to keep you on schedule.
• Your Areas
Create an Area for each sphere of your life, such as Work, Family, Finance, and so on. This keeps everything neatly organized, and helps you see the big picture as you set your plans in motion.
• Your Plan
Everything on your schedule is neatly laid out in the Today and Upcoming lists, which show your to-dos and calendar events. Each morning, see what you planned for Today and decide what you want to do. The rest is down to you :)
MORE THINGS TO LOVE
As you dive deeper, you’ll find Things packed with helpful features. Here are just a few:
• Reminders — set a time and Things will remind you.
• Repeaters — automatically repeat to-dos on a schedule you set.
• This Evening — a special place for your evening plans.
• Calendar integration — see your events and to-dos together.
• Tags — categorize your to-dos and quickly filter lists.
• Quick Find — instantly locate to-dos, headings, or tags.
• Type Travel — jump from list to list with your keyboard; just start typing!
• Magic Plus — drag the + button to insert to-dos anywhere in a list.
• Share extension — create to-dos with content from other apps.
• Widgets — see lists on your home/lock screens.
• Mail to Things — forward an email to Things; now it’s a to-do.
• Markdown — structure & style your notes.
• And much more!
MADE FOR IPAD
Things is tailored to the iPad, with excellent pro features as well. Chief among them is the outstanding support for your keyboard & trackpad. You can edit your to-dos without touching the screen, utilize plenty of shortcuts, and navigate your lists at blistering speed—just start typing!
“Things has the best implementation of external keyboard support I’ve ever seen in an iPad app.”
—Federico Viticci, MacStories
You can also enjoy a beautiful dark mode at sunset, connect your calendars, open multiple windows, add a variety of widgets, scribble with Apple Pencil, create to-dos via Siri, import from Reminders—Things can do it all! There’s even Shortcuts integration if you want to automate your workflows.
AWARD-WINNING DESIGN
Made in Stuttgart, with two Apple Design Awards to its name, Things is a fine example of German engineering: designed not only to look fantastic, but to be perfectly functional as well. Every detail is thoughtfully considered, then polished to perfection.
“It’s like the unicorn of productivity tools: deep enough for serious work, surprisingly easy to use, and gorgeous enough to enjoy staring at.”
—Apple
GET THINGS TODAY
Whatever it is you want to accomplish in life, Things can help you get there. Install the app today and see what you can do!
• Things is also available for Mac, iPhone, Apple Watch, and Apple Vision Pro (sold separately).
• Sync is provided for free via our Things Cloud service.
• A free trial is available for Mac: www.things.app
If you have any questions, please get in touch. We provide professional support and will be glad to help you!

bluejetty:00046356:ios.description:
With StAT Book-a-Bus, you can book transit trips within St. Albert on weekday and Saturday evenings and throughout the day on Sundays and Holidays. Just download the app and ride!
Think of StAT Book-a-Bus as an easy-to-use ride booking service for transit to and from St. Albert’s Transit Centres or for other trips within St. Albert. 
How it works:
- Download the app and create an account.
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Meet your bus at a nearby bus stop or at one of St. Albert’s two transit centres - Nakî or St. Albert Centre. 
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our routing algorithm finds the best route to get riders to their desired destination on time. You are getting the convenience of traveling when and where you want at an affordable cost. 
SUSTAINABLE.
Book-a-Bus allows St. Albert Transit to provide rides where and when they are requested without the need for extra buses to operate fixed-route service. This saves valuable resources and reduces CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you can do your part to make your city a little bit greener and cleaner, every time you ride.
Questions?
Reach out at transit@stalbert.ca 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating. You’ll have our eternal gratitude.

bluejetty:00131657:ios.summary:
Share Location is an app that allows you to easily share your real-time location or locate friends and family.
When you share your location, those you share with can view your real-time location from any web-enabled device, no app or sign
bluejetty:00131657:ios.description:
Share Location is an app that allows you to easily share your real-time location or locate friends and family.
When you share your location, those you share with can view your real-time location from any web-enabled device, no app or sign up required!
Share your location with a family member who’s always worried or request location from a friend who’s always late. No matter what, Share Location makes it easy to answer “Where are you?”.
Share Location features:
- Share your real-time location
- Easily locate friends and family
- Share your location temporarily or permanently
- Get directions to friends and family
- See past location history
- Monitor battery level, driving speed, and weather conditions
- Receive alerts when friends or family are nearby
- Get notified when friends and family come and go with Place Alerts
- Send Quick Messages to friends and family with a single tap
- Track a lost or stolen phone
- Runs in the background
- Works anywhere you have GPS and data
Use Share Location anytime you need an easy way to share your location or locate friends and family.
Download Share Location today!
You can use Share Location for free or subscribe to Pro and receive unlimited access to all features including 30 days of Location History, unlimited Place Alerts, and the option to share your real-time location Indefinitely, completely ad-free. There is a free 3-day trial for Pro. After the trial ends, the subscription will auto-renew on a monthly or yearly basis. You will receive your first charge 3 days after starting your trial. You can turn off the auto-renew for this subscription at any time by going to your iTunes Account Settings. If you do not want to be billed during your trial, you must turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before it expires.
Share Location has the following subscriptions:
* Pro - 3-day trial, then $69.99/yr
* Pro - 3-day trial, then $9.99/mo
Terms of Use: https://sharelocation.app/terms-of-use
Privacy Policy: https://sharelocation.app/privacy-policy

bluejetty:00115930:ios.description:
Find anyone across 400+ social media platforms with the most advanced AI-powered search technology. Whether you're reconnecting with old friends, verifying online profiles, or conducting professional research, SearchNow makes finding people simple, fast, and private.
Multiple Search Modes
Fast Search - Get quick results in ~15 seconds. Perfect for basic searches when you need information fast. Available free for all users.
Super Search (Premium) - Our most comprehensive search across 400+ websites and platforms. Uncover detailed information in ~2 minutes with our deep web search technology.
Username Search (Premium) - Find someone's profiles across all major platforms using just their username. Results in ~1 minute.
Face Search (Premium) - Revolutionary AI-powered facial recognition search. Upload a photo and find matching profiles across the web in ~30 seconds. Includes 5 monthly credits with premium subscription.
Privacy First
Your privacy is our priority. SearchNow uses anonymous authentication - no personal information required. All searches are stored locally on your device by default, with optional cloud backup. We never track, sell, or share your search data.
Powerful Features
Search History - Access all your past searches instantly with cached results. Search, filter, and manage your history with ease.
Saved Searches - Save frequently used search parameters for quick access. Perfect for ongoing research or regular checks.
Real-Time Updates - Track search progress in real-time with our advanced job queue system. Get notified when results are ready.
Smart Results - View beautifully formatted results with social media cards, profile images, and confidence scores. Support for markdown rendering ensures readable, organized information.
Export & Share - Export search results for reports or share findings with colleagues while maintaining privacy.

Unlimited Super & Username searches
5 Face Search credits monthly (more available for purchase)
Full search history access
Priority customer support
Ad-free experience
Cloud backup for your searches

Finding lost contacts and old friends
Verifying online dating profiles
Professional background research
Social media investigations
Digital footprint analysis
Identity verification
Recruitment and HR professionals
Journalists and resea

bluejetty:00128081:ios.description:
Explore dozens of art, coloring, and educational activities with Crayola® Create and Play™+, the official Crayola app for curious kids to learn through fun, creative play! Discover interactive digital learning experiences built in collaboration with experts from the world-famous Smithsonian Institution, where curiosity and exploration is brought to life!
Crayola Create & Play+ encourages curiosity, artistic independence, and a safe place to develop self-expression. It’s so much more than drawing and coloring pages! Each of the activities helps develop imagination and a creative point of view...we're all kids at heart, and everyone can be creative! Our regular content updates add new features, activities, and learning games. There’s always something new to explore and master!
*5-STAR PARENT TESTED AND PARENT APPROVED APP*
*GOOD PLAY GUIDE APPROVED*
*EDUCATIONAL APP STORE CERTIFIED*
*WINNER OF THE ACADEMICS CHOICE AWARD*
CREATE DIGITAL MASTERPIECES
• Use REAL Crayola art tools to create masterpieces! Color, draw, doodle, paint, stamp, sticker, glitter, and more!
• From princesses, dinosaurs, and unicorns...to fairies, cats, robots, and race cars, there are fun art projects for all ages to enjoy.
• There’s more than coloring and painting in the art station! Stretch creativity to the limit with pixel art, glow art, tracing, and art lessons too!
• Enjoy UNLIMITED coloring pages and activities, PLUS new content every month!
• Kids can see their art in their own personal gallery!
COLORS OF THE WORLD
• Color and create with Crayola’s award-winning, skin tone-accurate colors and ethnically diverse coloring pages and activities.
PRACTICE KINDNESS & CARE FOR PETS
• Design pets and watch them come to life!
• Pets have a mind of their own! Choose a home for them and watch them explore!
• Feed, wash, and interact with pets in their habitat! Each pet has its own unique personality.
CRAFTABLES
• Bring imagination to life in Crayola Create & Play with Craftables!
• Build rockets and fly them up to the sky!
• Design and decorate kites, silly masks, or even a hot air balloon!
• Create one-of-a-kind Dinosaurs! Kids can pick their bones and make it their own! 
EXPERIMENT, DISCOVER & PLAY
• Match, mix, and delight in colors!
• Sort the crayons, become a color-slicing ninja!
• Grow a color garden and attract real butterflies (yes, gardening is creative too!). Better yet, kids can see their garden come to life in the room around them with the AR camera!
ENCOURAGE CRITICAL THINKING BY PLAYING GAMES IN THE ARCADE
• Stack as many ice cream scoops as possible in Scoop Stacks! 
• Children can solve puzzles made from their own artwork!
• Play fun action games with pets, and much more!
LEARN NEW CLASSROOM SKILLS
• Try coding, practice spelling and letters, and watch behind-the-scenes videos on how Crayola Crayons are made.
• Watch real Crayola professional artists as they teach new art and drawing techniques.
PLAY GAMES WITH A PURPOSE
• Inspired by STEAM and STEM education techniques, Crayola teaches core developmental principles through play.
• Coding exercises and games help spark excitement for science and math topics.
NEW GAMES & ACTIVITIES EACH MONTH
• Ever-evolving content updates keep the inspiration flowing, there's something for everyone!
Privacy Policy: https://www.redgames.co/crayola-create-and-play-privacy-policy
Terms of Service: https://aut.crayocom.cloud.sitefinity.com/company/app-terms-of-use
If you have any questions, please send an email to support@createandplay.zendesk.com

Playlet - Your Go-To App for Amazing Short Dramas
Hey there! Got a few minutes to spare and looking for something fun to watch? You’ve got to check out Playlet! It’s perfect for those times when you just want to kick back and enjoy some bite-sized entertainment.
Why You'll Love Playlet:
A Smorgasbord of Genres
We’ve got it all! Ever wanted to escape into an emotionally charged urban drama that feels oh-so-relatable? Or maybe you fancy a dreamy, steamy story about falling for a super manly, handsome, and caring billionaire (who doesn't, right?). 
Our lineup includes exhilarating female lead tales that make you want to cheer, sweet and hilarious romantic comedies, mysterious werewolf alpha sagas, heartwarming family dramas, jaw-dropping family feuds, and revenge plots so satisfying they’ll make you go "wow!" Trust us, there's something for everyone!
Homegrown Stories
Our local screenwriters are seriously talented. They’ve crafted stories that are packed with engaging plots and unforgettable characters. You’ll be hooked from the get-go.
A Touch of Hollywood
Our shows are produced by Hollywood star teams, so you know you’re getting top-notch quality. It’s like having a bit of that Hollywood magic right in your pocket!
Stunning Visuals and Sound
Enjoy our content in glorious HD with fantastic sound. It’s like having a mini-theater experience wherever you go. Perfect for those who love their entertainment crisp and clear.
Cool Membership Perks
Want to get more bang for your buck? Sign up for our subscription to unlock dramas and sweet discounts. Premium content without the premium price tag!
Light and Easy
Playlet is super lightweight and won’t hog your phone’s memory. You get smooth streaming and plenty of room for all your other apps and selfies.
So, why wait? Download Playlet now and turn your spare moments into awesome entertainment. Trust us, you’re going to love it!

bluejetty:00155684:ios.description:
Think of Via Jersey City as a whole new way to get around Jersey City — a ridesharing service that’s smart, easy, and affordable.
 With a few taps, book an on-demand ride in the app, and our technology will pair you with other people headed your way. No detours, no delays.
How it works:
- Book a ride on your phone.
- Get picked up on a nearby corner.
- Share your ride with others.
- Save cash and reduce carbon emissions.
What we’re about:
SHARED.
Our corner-to-corner algorithm matches people headed in the same direction. This means you’re getting the convenience and comfort of a private ride with the efficiency, speed, and affordability of a public one.
AFFORDABLE.
Aggregating people into one vehicle brings down prices. Enough said.
SUSTAINABLE.
Sharing rides reduces the number of vehicles on the roads, bringing down congestion and CO2 emissions. With a couple of taps, you get to do your part to make Jersey City a little bit greener and cleaner every time you ride.
Questions? Reach out at support-jerseycity@ridewithvia.com. 
Loving your experience so far? Throw us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00184425:ios.description:
A pack of 20 mini games for you to enjoy on your Apple Watch, Apple TV or your iPhone/iPad.
◉ Brick Puzzle
Drag finger to move the bricks around. Tap to rotate and swipe down to drop.
◉ Jewel Blitz
A match 3 game style. Detonate as many gems as you can in 60s.
◉ Gold Miner
Aim on the gold while the hook swings. Tap on the screen to release the hook.
◉ Number Puzzle
Swipe to combine numbers for score.
◉ Sudoku (6x6)
Fill in all the empty squares without using the same number twice in each column, row, or box.
◉ Bubble Shooter
Tap to shoot bubble.
◉ Find Word
With 4 letters, you have 10s to find a word. If time runs out, you lose.
◉ Color Lines
Remove balls by forming lines (horizontal, vertical or diagonal) of at least five balls of the same color. Get the highscore!
◉ Mine Sweeper
Tap to reveal a square. If a square containing a mine, you lose. Reveal all square to win.
◉ Brick Breaker
Drag your finger to move your paddle and hit the ball. Destroy all the blocks to finish levels. 
◉ Maze Man
Swipe to change direction, collect all things on the map but don't touch the devil!
◉ Boxing
Tap left/right to move, mid to punch..
◉ Crazy Tennis
Feel like crazy while playing with AI. Drag your finger to move your paddle. Don't let the ball out.
◉ Block Ninja
Control the ninja to avoid all spikes and get best score.
◉ Tappy Bird
Tap the screen to fly up. Don't hit anything.
◉ Snake
Swipe to change snake direction.
◉ Tic-Tac-Toe
Challenge your brain with the AI.
◉ Pin Hack
Find the pin number before timeout.
◉ ATM
Use your math skill to give the right money request.
◉ What Number
Find the next number of a number chain.
=> On Apple Watch please use Digital Crown to exit game.
Thanks for all your feedback!!!

bluejetty:00119454:ios.name: Pentair Pro
bluejetty:00119454:ios.summary: Get connected to your customers’ water and take your service model to the next level! Deliver unparalleled service to your residential customers with the Pentair Pro app and trusted Pentair water solutions technology that’s smarter than ev
bluejetty:00119454:ios.description:
Get connected to your customers’ water and take your service model to the next level! Deliver unparalleled service to your residential customers with the Pentair Pro app and trusted Pentair water solutions technology that’s smarter than ever. 
Pentair Pro: the digital toolbox keeping you one step ahead. Deliver trusted performance and reliability with smart Pentair water devices to help your customers to move, improve and enjoy their home water. Use the Pentair Pro app as one more way to:
BECOME A TRUSTED PARTNER 
• Remotely monitor & receive alerts: Use the dashboard to get systems history, instant status and alerts from customers’ connected devices, anytime, anywhere
• Deliver peace of mind: Proactively inform customers when equipment needs attention
SAVE TIME, GROW REVENUE 
• Reduce time on service calls: Get system info from the devices to diagnose and monitor from afar 
• Generate new leads and sales: Pro Locator on the Pentair Home app allows homeowners to find you for products and service 
• Get support from Pentair with online manuals, videos and other resources 
The Pentair Pro app currently works with the following Pentair Home connected water devices:
• FOR POOL AND SPA: 
INTELLIFLO 3 VARIABLE SPEED PUMP: The only pump with patented sensorless flow control and smart device control for optimal performance and efficiency.
INTELLISYNC POOL PUMP CONTROL: Help homeowners keep energy bills in check by controlling variable speed pump settings from a smart device.
CHEMCHECK WATER QUALITY MONITORING SYSTEM*: Effortless, hands-free testing to stay on top of pool water chemistry, monitoring pH, sanitizer performance & temperature.
INTELLICONNECT SYSTEM*: No more trips to the pool pad to adjust equipment settings! Homeowners can monitor, schedule and control up to five pool devices like pumps, heaters, lights and sanitizers.
COLORSYNC LED LIGHT CONTROLLER: Create dazzling light shows from seven existing themes and five colors. Compatible with all Pentair Color LED lights.
• 
FOR WATER TREATMENT:
 HOME CONNECTED WATER SOFTENER*: Sends automatic alerts for remote trouble shooting. Low salt alerts allow you to see which customers need salt refill services. Tell customers when to regenerate, before a scheduled service call. 
• FOR HOME WATER SUPPLY & DISPOSAL: 
TRILARM LEAK DETECTOR: Detects leaks, temperature changes & power outages anywhere a leak could occur.
SUMP PUMP SMART BATTERY BACKUP: Powerful plug-n-play battery operated unit to support main sump pump system during power outages, rising water levels and pump failure.
DEFENDER WELL SYSTEM CONTROLLER*: Detects issues and sends alerts for common system problems like tank malfunctions and pump dry run. Smart shut-off when potentially damaging conditions are detected. Compatible with many well systems.
INTELLIDRIVE WATER PRESSURE CONTROL CENTER* : Helps maintain strong, constant water pressure in your home, regardless of how many people or appliances are using water at the same time.
For product details and more information, please visit pentair.com/pro
The Pentair Pro app supports most of the mobile devices. Some features may not be supported in different smart devices. Some features require a working internet connection, WIFI and/or Bluetooth. Use of app is subject to Terms of Service and Privacy Policy. 
*Products that can be monitored by Pentair Pro upon homeowner’s consent. Ability to send information to Professional is optional and dependent on product feature availability. 
**Ability to get product alerts dependent on user opting in to receive alerts and also dependent on product feature availability. 
ABOUT PENTAIR: From great tasting water straight from the kitchen faucet, to industrial water management and everywhere in between, we bring water to life. Our smart, sustainable water solutions help people move, improve and enjoy water, the world over.

bluejetty:00062165:ios.summary:

Our Dyslexia Screening Test quickly and accurately le
bluejetty:00062165:ios.description:
Are You Dyslexic? Why Wait and Wonder? Let the Dyslexia Screening Test App from Neurolearning show you how you think and learn, and get you started on the road to a successful future.
Our Dyslexia Screening Test quickly and accurately lets users ages 7 to 70 who have not previously received intensive dyslexia-appropriate reading instruction be screened for signs of the thinking and processing traits associated with dyslexia. 
The initial app download gives users access to the following free content:
--The MIND-Strengths self-assessment surveys (for ages 7 and older), which allow users to discover their relative abilities in 4 key strengths areas associated with dyslexia
--5 short videos describing what dyslexia is and is not, common signs of dyslexia, and what our screener can do for users
--A brief pre-test to determine if you might be at risk for dyslexia
--Comments by previous users on their experience with our app
To take the dyslexia screener requires an in-app purchase of a testing slot. 
---- 
The Neurolearning Dyslexia Screening Test App measures several key brain functions that underlie reading and spelling skills, and that work differently in individuals with dyslexia. It combines these measures with an assessment of current reading skills to determine the likelihood that the test user is experiencing challenges at school or work related to dyslexia. After the screening, users are provided with a detailed and individualized report of their results. 
This report includes: 
- A Total Dyslexia Score, which measures the overall likelihood that any problems they have with reading and spelling are related to dyslexia 
- Six Dyslexia Subscale Scores, which measure the key brain processing functions that underlying dyslexia-related challenges 
- Detailed and individualized recommendations outlining steps that can be taken to improve performance and limit challenges at school or work 
- A detailed list of resources that can be used to implement the recommendations 
- Recommendations on when further professional assessment is needed 
 ---- 
Who should use the Neurolearning Dyslexia Screening App? 
Students 7 or older who: 
- Struggle to read, write, or spell 
- Have siblings or parents with dyslexia or other learning challenges 
- Read slowly or avoid reading 
- Underperform their apparent ability and “can’t show what they know” 
- Take longer to complete work or tests than expected 
- Struggle more each year as the workload intensifies 
- Received an unclear or confusing screening result at school 
Adults up to age 70 who: 
- Currently struggle with reading, writing, or speaking 
- Underperform at work for unclear reasons 
- Struggled in school but were never tested 
- Have never enjoyed reading, read slowly, or struggle when reading aloud 
- Have dyslexic children or grandchildren and recognize similar features in themselves 
----
Neurolearning’s mission is to bring quality dyslexia testing within everyone's reach. For 20 years Drs. Brock and Fernette Eide have tested countless individuals with learning differences from all over the world in their Neurolearning Clinic in Seattle, Washington. They’ve also promoted better assessment and understanding of different learners through their influential books (“The Mislabeled Child” (2006) and the internationally best-selling book, "The Dyslexic Advantage" (2011)), and by the formation of the non-profit organization Dyslexic Advantage in 2012. The Eides are also frequent invited lecturers at conferences and meetings around the world, have been visiting lecturers at leading schools of education including Stanford University and Hunter College. 
In 2014 the Eides joined with pioneering technologist and entrepreneur Nils Lahr to found Neurolearning SPC, and to bring quality testing for learning differences within everyone’s reach.

bluejetty:00183379:ios.description:
Remote control for your Big Green Egg! 
Remotely manage and monitor cooking temperatures, monitor the temperature of your food, view graphs of your cooks and receive alerts when your cook is finished or when the EGG temperature is too high or low. 
The EGG Genius app works with an EGG Genius WiFi Temperature Controller to:
• Control the device through your smartphone, tablet or computer to remotely manage and monitor the internal temperature of the EGG 
• Monitor the temperature of your food; view graphs of your cooks
• Receive alerts when your cook is finished or when the EGG temperature is too high or low 
• Quickly reach your desired cooking temperature as the blower ramps up to fan the lighted charcoal; once the desired temp is reached, the variable speed blower automatically adjusts the blower speed to optimize the set temperature. 
• Automatically lowers the pit temperature to keep your food warm when the cook is complete.
• Detects the sudden temperature drop from opening the dome and turns the fan off temporarily to avoid over-stoking the fire.
• In the case of a power outage, the unit continues running at the saved set temperature and reconnects to the WiFi network automatically when power returns. 
• Use up to 3 meat probes at once – additional meat probes with Y-cable can be purchased separately. 
• Powered by Flame Boss®
Big Green Egg® and EGG® are Registered Trademarks of Big Green Egg Inc.

bluejetty:00043973:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00043973:ios.description:
WORLD'S FIRST SELF LEARNING CRIB. It spots early signs of wake-up, learns sleep patterns and automatically soothes your baby to sleep, if needed.
===========
IT'S A BASSINET AND A CRIB - FROM BIRTH TO 24 MONTHS :
Cradlewise provides uninterrupted quality sleep to babies and saves parents an average of 2 hours a day. It combines the functionality of a bassinet, crib, baby monitor and sound machine – all into one product.
GETS THE BABY TO SLEEP :
When it’s time to sleep, simply place your baby in the crib. The crib automatically detects the baby’s wakefulness and soothes them to sleep with its bounce and sound.
GUARDS SLEEP :
Just-in-time soothing is key to safeguarding baby sleep. The crib spots sleep disturbances and soothes the baby back to sleep.
===========
APP FEATURES
BUILT-IN BABY MONITOR. PEACE OF MIND FOR YOU.
NIGHT VISION: See your baby without turning on the lights and disturbing your little one.
NOTIFICATIONS: Get notified when your baby wakes up, falls asleep, starts crying etc.
LIVE VIDEO: Watch your baby live through your smartphone app from anywhere, anytime.
BACKGROUND AUDIO: Take a break or catch up on other work while listening to your baby in the background.
ROOM TEMPERATURE: The Cradlewise app has a room temperature monitoring feature that lets you quickly check your baby’s room temperature from the home screen, making it easier to to check anytime, anywhere.
ADD CAREGIVERS: We know that new parents already have their hands full. And since it takes a village to raise a child, our caregiver functionality provides you with just that - a virtual village. Add a caregiver and control the level of access.
DARK MODE: Dark mode reduces the brightness level on your phone, and it’s a game changer for minimizing light disruptions at night, especially when you want to check on them at 3am in the morning.
TWIN MODE: Add multiple babies to your profile. Seamlessly switch between baby profiles to manage and view all connected cribs from your single account.
WATCH YOUR BABY’S SLEEP IMPROVE OVER TIME.
DAILY SNAPSHOT: Track your baby’s sleep patterns and stay on top of changes.
SLEEP TRACKING: Track your baby’s sleep data - understand patterns from historical logs to understand your baby’s sleep better.
QUICK TIPS: User guides and tips to help you best adjust your crib’s settings to improve your baby’s sleep.
CURATED SOOTHING MUSIC
BUILT-IN SOUND MACHINE: Curated white, pink and brown noise tracks to calm a fussy baby. Option to create your own soundtrack.
BABY SAFE VOLUME: Smart mode stops sound when the baby has fallen asleep. Sound volume is capped to 60dB to be safe for your baby.
STREAM MUSIC OVER SPOTIFY TO THE CRIB: This feature allows you to turn your cradle into a speaker by enabling you to pair your crib with the Spotify app. You can curate a Spotify playlist for your little one and can play your favorite pop songs, lullabies, nursery rhymes, soothing sounds, or whatever they’re into, from wherever you happen to be.
===========
LET’S BE SOCIAL:
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cradlewise/
Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/cradlewise/
Blog: https://www.cradlewise.com/blog/
Medium: https://medium.com/cradlewise
Have questions? Feel free to contact us at info@cradlewise.com
Visit our website https://www.cradlewise.com/ to know more.

bluejetty:00150837:ios.description:
HappyNest makes laundry day easier with personalized wash, dry, and fold laundry service and next-day return. We pick up your laundry right from your doorstep, clean it at a professional laundry facility, and return it washed, dried, and folded just the way you like it.
Available across 38 states and serving 58 million households, HappyNest combines the convenience of pickup and delivery with consistent laundry care, provided by trained local teams. Manage your pickups, customize your laundry preferences, and track driver updates, all from the app.
SIMPLE, TRANSPARENT PRICING
Wash, dry, and fold starts at $32.95 per bag, with no contracts or commitments.
• Professional laundry care and next-day return included
• Detergents, fabric softeners, and dryer sheets included
• No third-party delivery fees
• Free account creation
• Pay only when your laundry is picked up
HOW IT WORKS
1. Create your free account. Get started right in the app.
2. Personalize your laundry. Choose detergents, wash settings, folding preferences, and more.
3. Schedule a pickup. Leave your laundry out at your designated pickup spot. No need to be home.
4. Get it back tomorrow. Enjoy fresh, clean, neatly folded laundry delivered to your door.
WHY CUSTOMERS CHOOSE HAPPYNEST
• Professional cleaning, every time. Your laundry is cleaned at a professional laundry facility, never in a stranger's home.
• Your preferences, remembered. Consistent, professionally trained local teams help deliver the personalized care you expect.
• 10,000+ five-star reviews. Trusted by customers to take laundry off their to-do lists.
• Real customer support. Get help from our dedicated team 7 days a week.
• Updates along the way. Receive notifications before pickup, when we're in your area, and when your driver is on the way.
LAUNDRY, YOUR WAY
Customize your service to fit your routine:
• Pickup availability 7 days a week
• Detergent options, including familiar brands, eco-friendly, hypoallergenic, and fragrance-free choices
• Fabric softeners and dryer sheets
• Wash and dry temperatures
• Folding preferences
• Special instructions
• Customizable notification types and frequency
YOUR LAUNDRY, AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Use the HappyNest app to:
• Schedule and track pickups
• Manage your account and billing
• Update laundry preferences anytime
• Receive pickup and delivery updates
• Pause service with a vacation hold
Spend less time doing laundry and more time doing what you love.
Visit www.happynest.com to learn more.
