HappyNest makes laundry day easier with personalized wash, dry, and fold laundry service and next-day return. We pick up your laundry right from your doorstep, clean it at a professional laundry facility, and return it washed, dried, and folded just the way you like it.

Available across 38 states and serving 58 million households, HappyNest combines the convenience of pickup and delivery with consistent laundry care, provided by trained local teams. Manage your pickups, customize your laundry preferences, and track driver updates, all from the app.

SIMPLE, TRANSPARENT PRICING
Wash, dry, and fold starts at $32.95 per bag, with no contracts or commitments.

• Professional laundry care and next-day return included
• Detergents, fabric softeners, and dryer sheets included
• No third-party delivery fees
• Free account creation
• Pay only when your laundry is picked up

HOW IT WORKS

1. Create your free account. Get started right in the app.
2. Personalize your laundry. Choose detergents, wash settings, folding preferences, and more.
3. Schedule a pickup. Leave your laundry out at your designated pickup spot. No need to be home.
4. Get it back tomorrow. Enjoy fresh, clean, neatly folded laundry delivered to your door.

WHY CUSTOMERS CHOOSE HAPPYNEST

• Professional cleaning, every time. Your laundry is cleaned at a professional laundry facility, never in a stranger's home.
• Your preferences, remembered. Consistent, professionally trained local teams help deliver the personalized care you expect.
• 10,000+ five-star reviews. Trusted by customers to take laundry off their to-do lists.
• Real customer support. Get help from our dedicated team 7 days a week.
• Updates along the way. Receive notifications before pickup, when we're in your area, and when your driver is on the way.

LAUNDRY, YOUR WAY
Customize your service to fit your routine:

• Pickup availability 7 days a week
• Detergent options, including familiar brands, eco-friendly, hypoallergenic, and fragrance-free choices
• Fabric softeners and dryer sheets
• Wash and dry temperatures
• Folding preferences
• Special instructions
• Customizable notification types and frequency

YOUR LAUNDRY, AT YOUR FINGERTIPS
Use the HappyNest app to:

• Schedule and track pickups
• Manage your account and billing
• Update laundry preferences anytime
• Receive pickup and delivery updates
• Pause service with a vacation hold

Spend less time doing laundry and more time doing what you love.
Visit www.happynest.com to learn more.

Uncover various secret stories, anecdotes, and scandals via high-speed merging!
You will be a MC of Merge Night Live, sharing different tales of betrayal, entertainment, fashion.ect. There will be many chapters with different characters and themes.

- Merge two same items to upgrade them into one advaced item
- Unlock multiple items via merge: coffee, cake, donut, soda...
- A sweet and exciting merge game.
RENOVATE
- How to change a dirty and dusty room to a brand new one? Merge!
- How to find the secrets of the cheating in marriage? Merge!
- How to punish the shameless plagiarist? Merge!
Complete orders to win stars and then renovate: life shuffles from underdog to queen!
RELAX
- Play anywhere&however!
- Stand, sit, lie... Just merge as you like
- Relaxing puzzle game which is best for time killing!
Experience quick merge across interesting storylines and roles!
※Compatibility: iOS12 or above is supported
We're glad to receive your suggestions via: https://www.facebook.com/mnlglobal/

bluejetty:00031073:ios.description:
O que você encontra no Afya Whitebook? Conteúdos para suporte às suas maiores dúvidas na decisão clínica!
* Precifique seus procedimentos com a Calculadora de Honorários Whitebook, e tenha acesso a todas as tabelas CBHPM.
*CBHPM - Calculadora de Honorários Médicos: consulte todas as tabelas do CBHPM em um só lugar e calcule seus honorários de forma automática. Realize buscas pelo código ou nome do procedimento e personalize os cálculos conforme as necessidades de cada caso do paciente. Além disso, compartilhe o orçamento diretamente com o paciente via WhatsApp, Email ou SMS!
*Gerenciador de Plantão: Uma nova solução gratuita para você organizar seus plantões e controlar o seu financeiro. Tudo isso dentro do app Afya Whitebook.
Interação Medicamentosa: consulte rapidamente se a combinação de dois ou mais medicamentos pode causar interferências leves, moderadas, graves ou contraindicadas. Veja os possíveis efeitos da interação e receba orientações sobre como administrar os fármacos com segurança. Reduza riscos, evite a perda de eficácia dos medicamentos e previna efeitos colaterais indesejados!
* Medicamentos e Bulário: informações para prescrever medicamentos com segurança: posologia, nomes comerciais, classes terapêuticas, uso clínico, geriátrico e pediátrico, contraindicações e mais. São mais de 3 mil medicamentos!
* CID 10: consulte qualquer código de doenças do CID 10, por meio da busca pela descrição ou código e com acesso a uma lista com capítulos.
* Administração de drogas e infusão: recomendações sobre preparação e administração de medicamentos em diversos contextos.
* SUS e TUSS: pesquise códigos de exames e procedimentos.
* Calculadoras e Escores: acesso às mais importantes calculadoras e escores de medicina: calculadora gestacional, de ventilação; escalas; escores pediátricos ou clínicos; bomba infusora e mais. São mais de 200 ferramentas disponíveis!
* Condutas médicas, fluxos, rotinas e medicina de urgências: consulte o conteúdo elaborado por médicos de diferentes áreas para compreender contexto e etapas das condutas, incluindo de emergência e cirúrgicas. Confira condutas pediátricas na seção Pediatria!
* Clinical Drops: a categoria de vídeos curtos e objetivos traz dicas práticas de médicos especialistas, baseadas nas pesquisas e diretrizes mais atualizadas, e responde a dúvidas da prática médica.
* Decision Tracks: fluxogramas interativos práticos e dinâmicos para apoiar as suas decisões de diagnóstico, estratificação de risco e tratamento, além de exercitar o raciocínio clínico.
* DDX - Diagnóstico Diferencial: mais segurança e praticidade para a investigação diagnóstica. Em 3 etapas, insira sinais, sintomas e resultados de exames do paciente, a ferramenta analisa a combinação e apresenta as principais hipóteses de diagnósticos.
* Guias práticos: visualize etapas ou detalhes de procedimentos como reposição hidroeletrolítica, procedimentos, ECG, VM, intoxicações, USG a beira-leito e mais.
A Afya é o maior hub de educação e soluções digitais médicas do Brasil. Unido a ela e com o desejo de entregar ainda mais eficiência na sua decisão clínica, o Whitebook se tornou Afya Whitebook. Agora juntos, podemos fazer mais pelo médico, da graduação à prática, oferecendo mais suporte, autoridade e experiência em toda a sua jornada.
Acesse nossa política de privacidade (Privacy Policy):
http://quem-somos.pebmed.com.br/privacidade.html
Termos de uso (EULA):
https://pebmed.com.br/termos-de-uso/

bluejetty:00018713:ios.name: MealCam
bluejetty:00018713:ios.summary:
MealCam is where you save pictures of everything that you eat. It is great for intermittent fasters to observe their feeding window lengths without starting timers.
You can shortcut from the Lock Screen or Control Center to capture Meals v
bluejetty:00018713:ios.description:
MealCam is where you save pictures of everything that you eat. It is great for intermittent fasters to observe their feeding window lengths without starting timers.
You can shortcut from the Lock Screen or Control Center to capture Meals very conveniently.
The UI is focused on images instead of calories. Instead of obsessing over numbers, you can look more holistically at what and when you eat to measure things like:
-How many colors did I eat?
-How many ingredients did I eat that had water in them? (i.e. fruit/veg vs processed food)
-How much time did I give my body to digest before I ate again?
While it may seem simple. When you use it consistently it becomes immensely powerful.
It may be the catalyst to a skinnier, healthier you because of the insights you gain...
...or simply because of the improved accountability you gain by simply taking a picture of every meal! (You might ask yourself, "should I really be eating this?" as you reach for MealCam)
...it could also uncover a food allergy you never knew you had but was responsible for your bloating and discomfort.
---
Focusing on calorie counting can often be misleading because to meet a goal you may eat processed food that has an artificially-engineered low/no calorie number...
...when what your body really wanted was a hydrating piece of fresh fruit!  
(Colorful fresh produce isn't usually sold with nutrition labels... and yet isn't it the healthiest food for us?)
So by focusing instead on things like colors and water content you'll get a more holistic view of what you eat.
...and it's easier! (It only takes seconds to take a picture of a meal)
---
With photos of your meals you'll have a broader perspective of what you eat where you can observe patterns you would otherwise be unaware of.
You can ask questions that get to the root of problems:
- What made my digestion like this?
- Why am I bloated?
- Did I eat something yesterday that caused me to break out?
- Why did I gain weight this month?
MealCam allows you to recall what you were eating days, weeks, or months ago. (Unlike our memory which often can only recall the past few meals)
...and the very act of taking a picture of every meal makes you more conscious of what you eat.
You can also create a 1 day or 7 day summary of your meals to share with your doctor, personal trainer, or nutrition coach.
---
MealCam uses of all the greatest new features in iOS:
-It uses iCloud to privately sync your meals between devices.
-It has a useful Widget.
-It supports multitasking on iPad and works in all orientations.
~Private iCloud Syncing~
Meals can be stored in your private iCloud database where they sync with all your devices. Since MealCam uses iCloud's private database, I as the developer do not have access to them. They're for your eyes only.
You also have the choice to store them locally on your device without syncing.
~Widget~
A common thing you may ask yourself is, especially if you are intermittent fasting is: what time was my last meal?
The widget is the perfect place to quickly answer this question. It shows a timeline of today's meals. Or if you haven't eaten today, how long it's been since your last meal.
You can quickly reference what time your last meal was without opening the app and decide if you're ready to eat again. You can also put an accessory widget with this info on the Lock Screen.
~Multitasking~
MealCam works in all sizes and orientations so you can use it for multitasking on the iPad. 
You can use MealCam side by side with other apps. For example, when you are looking for recipes online you can use MealCam to see what you've eaten the past couple nights.
---
I hope you enjoy MealCam as much as I do!
- Kevin (the developer)

bluejetty:00073892:ios.name: Guitar Pro
bluejetty:00073892:ios.summary:
The Guitar Pro application allows all musicians to view and play sheet music and tablature created with the famous Guitar Pro tab-editing program for Windows and Mac.
This mobile version is the ideal companion for you to practice your favo
bluejetty:00073892:ios.description:
The Guitar Pro application allows all musicians to view and play sheet music and tablature created with the famous Guitar Pro tab-editing program for Windows and Mac.
This mobile version is the ideal companion for you to practice your favorite songs and share them any time, anywhere! Coming up with some arpeggio, a riff, a chord sequence? You can now note and save it all on the single-track tablature NotePad.
Powerful score player
• Supporting GP3/4/5/6/7/8 (.gp) and PowerTab (.ptb) file formats, 
• Tab (with rhythmics), slash, and standard notations, 
• Compatible with mySongBook portal to sheet music (monthly subscription and single buying),
• Switch between Dark and Light viewing modes, 
• Load files via WiFi and web browser, iTunes, e-mail,
• Integrated sheet-music library with search, filters, and favorites,
• Multitrack player with soundboard: volume / solo-mute / soundbanks,
• Metronome and visual countdown, 
• 3 zooming levels,
• Guitar or bass fretboard (for right- and left-handers), and virtual keyboard,
• On-the-fly tempo changes, 
• On-the-fly global transposing by half-tones,
• Playing any selection in loops,
• Simplified navigation between sections,
• E-mailing files directly from the application,
• Exporting files to PDF,
• Compatible with the Fretlight Wireless Guitar.
NotePad tool to create a tablature
• Use the NotePad to edit a single-track tablature for guitar, bass, banjo, ukulele, and mandolin,
• Tablature for 4- to 8-string instruments,
• 19 built-in sounds,
• Customizable tuning and tempo,
• Export your ideas into Guitar Pro 6 and 7 formats so as to later carry on with your composition on the Guitar Pro desktop version.
———————————————————————-
The app is updated frequently, so feel free to contact our team to ask any question or give your feedback.
For more info:
Need help: https://support.guitar-pro.com
Facebook: http://www.facebook.com/arobas.music
Twitter: http://www.twitter.com/arobasmusic
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/guitarpro_official
FAQ:
Q: Can I create or edit sheet music with this app?
A: Unlike Guitar Pro for Windows and Mac, this app does not let you change the notation in an existing Guitar Pro file, or create sheet music in standard notation. It is however possible to edit a single-track tablature with the NotePad tool and export your work into .gpx and .gp formats to finish your composition in Guitar Pro 6 or 7. Editing a drum track is not available with the NotePad tool.

bluejetty:00062982:ios.description:
● GAME CENTER -- Play online, chat, invite friends, auto-match with random players
 { Real-time } Play online in real-time
 { Turn-based } Play online at your own pace
● VERSATILE -- Play offline vs. computer or against another person in 2-player mode
● CUSTOMIZABLE -- More options than any other backgammon app
● UNIVERSAL -- Supports iPad, iPhone, & iPod touch
Play & learn backgammon at skill levels from beginner to world-class!
Backgammon NJ HD is a full-featured game which uses an advanced, neural network-based, artificial intelligence. Play against a computer AI, another person in 2-player mode on one device, or online against friends & others. Using Tutor Mode & Hints, Backgammon NJ HD can show you how to improve your game.
Discriminating players will appreciate how well the AI plays. It uses a neural network trained on millions of positions, a bearoff database, & a match equity table to achieve strong gameplay that will challenge even expert players.
REVIEWS
"[I] know strong bg play when I see it. This app is the strongest iPhone bg app I've played with by far. It does not cheat period. ...Analyzing these matches with eXtreme Gammon confirms a world class level of play with normal luck factors. If you are losing, get over it. So would 99.9% of the other backgammon players in the world. It is just that good. Learn from it." -Richard Munitz, Giant of Backgammon, #21 world ranking in 2009
"Backgammon NJ plays at an extremely high level with an excellent interface, and I often use it to practice on my iPhone when I am traveling. I recommend it highly to my students & friends." -Phil Simborg, Professional Backgammon Teacher & Player, www.mindgamescenter.com
"I've played over 500 games now; I've checked about 5% of these against World Class Desktop programs (GNU, BGBlitz); and I've actually used some of the competition. NJ has the best interface & has more useful functions than any other backgammon apps out there."
"For serious backgammon players, Backgammon NJ is the way to go." -Macworld.com, May 2012
IS THIS GAME RIGHT FOR YOU?
This game is best for people:
• Who recognize the strength of neural network backgammon bots
• Who want to improve their game by playing against a world-class level AI
• Who will use the in-depth, technical features included in the app to prove that it is honest (https://www.njsoftware.com/note.html)
• Who won't expect to win consistently on the higher skill levels
FEATURES
• Neural network-based AI
• 2 game types: Standard Backgammon or Nackgammon
• 4 skill levels: Easy, Medium, Hard, Expert
• Customizable board design & checker colors
• Mersenne Twister algorithm for random number generation
• Doubling cube
• Single games or match play up to 25 pts
• Crawford rule for match play
• 1-player mode vs. computer
• 2-player mode on one device
• Game Center: Play real-time or turn-based online matches with friends & other players
• Chat with your online opponent
• Online Elo & Experience leaderboards
• Block list for auto-match
• Tap-to-move interface
• Highlighted checker movement options
• Hint & Undo
• Learn with Tutor Mode
• Game & dice stats, including Elo rating & ER
• Match info: GnuBG ID, win chances, equity, top 10 moves, cube decisions
• Email match files
• Practice mode with unlimited undo (1-player vs. computer)
• Manual match recording mode with unlimited undo & speed mode option
• Options to reverse board direction, resign, use one-tap moves, auto bearoff, auto finish, use Jacoby rule, & much more
• Match analysis (in-app purchase): Analyze past match files, view moves & errors for match, step through match, jump to position, play from position, save match files permanently
IMPORTANT
• If an online match ends for any reason, you'll receive the Elo pts you deserve. FAQ: https://gamecenter.njsoftware.com
• Contact us for help: https://contact.njsoftware.com

bluejetty:00090897:ios.name: CellWalk
bluejetty:00090897:ios.summary: CellWalk puts a living cell in your hands and on your desk. Zoom from a whole cell down to the atoms in DNA. Explore a cell modeled protein by protein from real structures discovered by scientists. Start your journey with Ako, an AI tutor t
bluejetty:00090897:ios.description:
CellWalk puts a living cell in your hands and on your desk. Zoom from a whole cell down to the atoms in DNA. Explore a cell modeled protein by protein from real structures discovered by scientists. Start your journey with Ako, an AI tutor that helps you understand what you see.
Built for students, teachers and anyone curious about how life works at the molecular scale. 2025 Apple Design Award finalist.
EXPLORE A REAL CELL
Zoom from a whole Mycoplasma cell down to single atoms. Thousands of proteins, DNA and RNA, ribosomes and membranes, rendered from published scientific data. Tap any molecule to learn what it is and what it does. Tap any term for an explanation at your level, written on your device with Apple Intelligence.
Place molecular scenes in your space with augmented reality on compatible iPhone and iPad devices.
LEARN WITH AKO
Ako helps you build understanding through questions. It brings molecular structures into view, invites you to look closer and explain what you notice, then builds on your answers to help you make connections. Socratic learning, one discovery at a time.
Type or dictate. Ask anything about what’s on screen or in your space. Your Ako lessons, your progress in them and what Ako has learned about you stay with you: on your device and, if you use iCloud, in your own iCloud. Get more of Ako with CellWalk Pro.
GUIDED TOURS
Start your journey with The Molecular Design of Life, a complete tour of the Mycoplasma cell made with Dr. David Goodsell. Each tour includes a guided narration, free explore mode and Ako practice lessons to test your understanding. CellWalk Pro adds more guided tours and lessons with an expanded library of cells and organisms. Explore the incredible molecular machines that power neurons and thought, or dive into the architecture of a virus like HIV.
LEARN BY DOING
Step into the Central Dogma of Biology with a hands-on interactive lesson on the all new Learning Path. Learn how the instructions in DNA are read and translated into the proteins that build and sustain your cells.
WHAT’S FREE
Explore The Molecular Design of Life tour and its accompanying Ako lesson and explore modes, and try the “What is a Protein?” interactive lesson on the Learning Path. You can also ask Ako in-depth questions with a free daily allowance.
CELLWALK PRO
Unlock all other guided tours and their accompanying Ako lessons, a larger daily question allowance and longer answers from Ako. Choose a monthly or annual auto-renewing subscription. One subscription covers iPhone, iPad and Mac.
ASK FROM ANYWHERE
Say “Ask CellWalk a biology question” and Siri answers from CellWalk’s own content without opening the app. “Continue my lesson in CellWalk” picks up where you left off. On iPhone and iPad, use Visual Intelligence on a textbook diagram, choose Search CellWalk with an Image, and tap a match to open that tour, lesson or molecule.
HOW THE AI WORKS
Ako is built with the Foundation Models framework. Where Apple Intelligence is available, it answers on Private Cloud Compute, and the on-device model explains the terms you tap. OpenAI, a third-party AI service, plans lessons and answers when Apple Intelligence isn’t available on your device or in your region.
The app asks your permission before sending your first question. You can change that permission under Account → Privacy. CellWalk doesn’t require a separate CellWalk account, and AI requests aren’t tied to your name. Find details under Account → Privacy → About CellWalk & AI.
Apple Intelligence features require iPhone 15 Pro or later, an iPad with M1 or A17 Pro or later, or a Mac with Apple silicon.
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Terms of Service: https://cellwalk.ca/terms-of-service
Privacy Policy: https://cellwalk.ca/privacy

bluejetty:00131605:ios.description:
Are you ready to solve the mystery of Appleton and unlock exciting family secrets? When someone burns down a family cafe, everyone’s a suspect! Join Love & Pies the most exciting story game and keep your ears open for small-town gossip! Help Amelia find answers, and maybe even find love in this crazy town.
Decorate, manage and build your own cafe and garden into a thriving business by merging cakes and combining cookies and cooking yummy dishes to serve customers in the restaurant. Use tips to renovate your space. Live the pie life as top baker in Love & Pies! 
Uncover juicy secrets in every room as single Mama Amelia solves mysteries in her family cafe. In a story game full of twists and turns, you’ll meet dramatic exes, nasty rivals, eccentric relatives, adorable pets and friendly customers. Endless drama, romance and secrets - it's a real merge mystery!
In Love & Pies you’ll:
MATCH & MERGE
Match, Merge & combine sweet ingredients to cook tasty cakes, pies and other treats to serve to the lovely customers of your cafe! 
RENOVATE & DESIGN
Renovate the old rooms & garden, collect beautiful themed decorations and makeover your cafe with your own unique design! Expand your cafe empire to include castles, manors & mansions!
DISCOVER & SOLVE
Progress through the story to discover new secrets, plot twists & clues to help you solve the mystery of Appleton!
LIVE EVENTS
Take part in rewarding live events in which you’ll aim to score points, climb the leaderboards & win beautiful decorations and tasty prizes! 
UNLOCK 
New merge paths, delicious recipes & stunning decorations to grow your restaurant and become the best cafe in Appleton!
If you like merge games then Love & Pies is just for you. Merge tasty treats, solve the delicious drama and discover Amelia’s love story. On top of this, you will be able to design your dream cafe! Jump in to Love & Pies today!

bluejetty:00065676:ios.description:
Rafeeq is Qatar’s 100% Qatari super app for food delivery, groceries, pharmacy, gifts, shopping, hotels and everyday services.
Order from your favorite restaurants, shop daily essentials, book hotels, send flowers and gifts, and access useful services in one app built for Qatar.
Food delivery across Qatar
Rafeeq started with food delivery, and it remains our core category. Order from leading restaurants and local favorites, including McDonald’s, KFC, Hardee’s, Pizza Hut, Jollibee, Zaatar W Zeit and many more.
From burgers, fried chicken and pizza to Arabic food, desserts, coffee and everyday meals, Rafeeq helps you get food delivered quickly and reliably.
Groceries and daily essentials
Shop groceries without queues or heavy bags. Order fresh produce, pantry items, drinks, snacks, household products, baby items and daily essentials from trusted stores across Qatar.
Pharmacy, health and personal care
Order pharmacy products, skincare, beauty items, supplements and personal care essentials from trusted pharmacies. Rafeeq makes health and personal care shopping simple, secure and convenient.
Hotels and travel
Browse and book hotels in Qatar and internationally. Compare options, check prices and confirm your booking through a smooth in-app experience for staycations, family trips and business travel.
Market: shopping in one app
Discover a growing range of stores and categories inside Rafeeq Market, including electronics, perfumes, beauty, toys, kids products, accessories, home and lifestyle items.
Flowers, gifts and digital cards
Send flowers, perfumes, digital cards and gift cards for birthdays, celebrations, family moments or last-minute occasions.
Rafeeq Stars
Shop exclusive items from creators through Rafeeq Stars, an influencer store experience available inside the Rafeeq app.
Essential services
Book useful lifestyle services directly through Rafeeq, including home cleaning, boat trips, pick and drop services and more. New services are added regularly.
Why use Rafeeq?
100% Qatari super app
Food, grocery, pharmacy, hotels, shopping, gifts and services in one app
Fast delivery across Qatar
Secure payment options
Local experience built for people in Qatar
Rafeeq gives you more choice, faster access and everyday convenience in one app.

bluejetty:00038247:ios.name: NHS App
bluejetty:00038247:ios.summary:
The NHS App gives you a simple and secure way to access a range of NHS services on your smartphone or tablet. 
You can use the app if you are aged 13 or over. You must be registered with an NHS GP surgery in England or the Isle of Man.
Yo
bluejetty:00038247:ios.description:
The NHS App gives you a simple and secure way to access a range of NHS services on your smartphone or tablet. 
You can use the app if you are aged 13 or over. You must be registered with an NHS GP surgery in England or the Isle of Man.
You can also log in through the NHS website on a computer to use NHS App services.
Access NHS services 
----------------------
Use the NHS App to access your NHS services, anytime and anywhere. You can request repeat prescriptions, use 111 online, find nearby NHS services and more.
Depending on your GP surgery, you may also be able to book appointments and contact your surgery about a health problem.
Manage your health 
--------------------
The NHS App gives you a convenient way to view your health information, including your test results.
You can manage your upcoming appointments and prescription requests. You can also make choices about your health, like your organ donation decision.  
Receive messages 
-------------------
You can get important messages from your GP surgery and other NHS services through the app. Turning on notifications can alert you to new messages.  
Manage services for other people 
--------------------------------- 
You can switch profiles to access services for other people in the NHS App, such as a child or family member. Your GP surgery needs to give you access and you must both share the same surgery.  
Log in securely 
---------------
The NHS App will guide you through setting up an NHS login if you do not have one already. You will be asked to prove who you are. The app will then securely connect to information from your NHS services.  If your iPhone or iPad supports Touch ID or Face ID, you can use it to log in, every time you use the app.

bluejetty:00163203:ios.description:
WHO-validated quit smoking app with 4.5M+ users. Start your smoke-free life today!
Ready to quit smoking for good? Kwit combines proven science with gamification to make quitting easier and engaging. As the first WHO-validated smoking cessation app, Kwit helps you break free from nicotine addiction using evidence-based cognitive behavioral therapy techniques that work.
Track your progress in real-time
Watch your quit smoking journey unfold with personalized statistics showing smoke-free days, money saved, cigarettes avoided, and health improvements. Every milestone becomes powerful motivation to stay tobacco-free. See exactly how your body heals as you progress through your transformation.
Science-backed craving management
Beat cravings with CBT-based tools including guided breathing exercises, mini-games, and instant motivation cards. Turn withdrawal moments into opportunities for growth with techniques developed by addiction specialists. When nicotine cravings hit, you'll have proven strategies to overcome them naturally.
Join the quit smoking community
Connect with supportive groups where fellow quitters share victories, challenges, and daily encouragement. Exchange tips with people who understand your journey. You're never alone in your mission to become smoke-free. Get real-time support from thousands of successful ex-smokers worldwide.
Expert-designed educational content
Access our comprehensive library of evidence-based articles, expert tips, and proven strategies from leading addiction specialists. Learn the science behind tobacco addiction and master techniques for lasting smoking cessation success. Understand withdrawal symptoms, identify triggers, and develop healthy coping mechanisms.
Nicotine replacement tracker and vaping support
Gradually reduce your dependence on patches, gum, vaping devices, and e-cigarettes with personalized guidance. Monitor your nicotine replacement therapy progress and take control of your consumption step-by-step until you're completely free from nicotine addiction.
9-day preparation program
Follow our scientifically-designed quit plan based on Prochaska's Transtheoretical Model and cognitive behavioral therapy principles. Prepare mentally and physically for your quit date with structured daily guidance that sets you up for long-term success.
Key features that make quitting easier:
• Real-time quit tracking with detailed statistics
• Evidence-based craving management tools and techniques
• Supportive community groups and chat features
• Progress rewards, achievements, and milestone celebrations
• Comprehensive educational content library
• Nicotine replacement therapy monitoring
• Guided breathing exercises and mindfulness practices
• Money saved calculator and spending tracker
• Health improvement timeline with medical insights
• Personalized motivation cards and daily inspiration
• Relapse prevention strategies and recovery support
Premium features for serious quitters:
Upgrade to access advanced analytics, extended content library, priority community support, one-on-one expert consultations, and personalized coaching plans tailored to your specific smoking habits and triggers.
Why choose Kwit over other quit smoking apps? We're the only WHO-validated smoking cessation app, combining rigorous scientific research with engaging gamification. Our approach is based on proven cognitive behavioral therapy methods, not just tracking. We focus on changing your relationship with smoking through education, community support, and evidence-based interventions.
Join 4.5+ million people worldwide who chose freedom from tobacco addiction. Download the WHO-recommended quit smoking app trusted by healthcare professionals and start your smoke-free life today. Your journey to better health, increased energy, and financial freedom begins now.
Contact us at hello@kwit.app for support.
Terms: https://info.kwit.app/en
Kwit complements your quit smoking journey but does not replace medical advice.

bluejetty:00091318:ios.description:
Endor Awakens: Dungeon Crawler is a thrilling evolution of Depths of Endor, where chaos reigns in the changing world after the fall of Mordoth. In this Dungeon Crawler, you'll venture through procedurally generated dungeons, encountering new challenges and treasures with every step.
The city has transformed with new features:
• Shop: Buy weapons and armor to prepare for your adventures.
• Inn: Meet new NPCs, take on common quests, and delve into the main story and side adventures.
• Guilds: Unlock skills via a new skill tree and customize your character to match your playstyle.
• Bestiary: Track the monsters you've faced and defeated.
• Bank: Store items you don't need for later use.
• Daily Chest: Log in every day for rewards and bonuses.
• Morgue: Resurrect fallen heroes and continue your journey.
Create your characters by choosing their race, gender, guild, and portrait. Hardcore mode adds extra challenge: if your character dies, there's no coming back. Pick a custom avatar from your device's gallery to make your hero truly unique.
Turn-based combat allows you to strategize every move, whether it's attacking, casting spells, using items, or defending. Beware of traps and events as you explore the depths of dungeons.
Endor Awakens offers endless possibilities for adventure, as you forge your path through this ever-changing world. Your choices shape your journey, with each dungeon and character offering new opportunities. Will you rise to defeat the chaos, or succumb to the darkness of the depths? The fate of Endor lies in your hands.

bluejetty:00161300:ios.description:
Better Weight is a free weight tracker and BMI calculator that helps you lose weight, gain muscle, or reach your ideal weight. Monitor your BMI, track progress, and see real results — all in one simple app.
Whether your goal is to slim down or build up, splitting it into smaller milestones is a smart plan. Set your target, track daily or weekly, and stay motivated. Small wins keep you happy and moving forward.
WEIGHT TRACKER & BMI CALCULATOR
Our weight tracker makes it easy to log every weigh-in. See your progress on daily, weekly, or monthly charts. Because numbers fluctuate, we show a 7-day low and meaningful trends instead of confusing daily readings.
The built-in BMI calculator lets you calculate your body mass index instantly. Know where you stand — underweight, normal, overweight, or obese — and track how your BMI improves over time.
BODY MEASUREMENTS & BODY FAT
Numbers on the scale don't tell the full story. Track body measurements like waist, hips, chest, and arms to see what's really changing. Calculate your body fat percentage and get the bigger picture beyond a single number.
GOALS, PLANS & CHALLENGES
Set your weight loss goal and create a step-by-step plan to reach it. Pick from curated 28-day challenges — healthy habits like daily exercise, stretching, drinking water, or eating right. Choose the difficulty and build a routine that fits your life.
SIMPLE & BEAUTIFUL SCALE
Our weight scale is designed to be beautiful and simple. Step on, log your number, and move on. Quick weigh-ins make it easy to build a daily habit. Use your weight log as a personal weight diary to look back on your journey anytime.
KEY FEATURES
- Free weight tracker — no time limits
- BMI calculator with health categories
- Weight loss tracking and planning
- Body measurement tracker for waist, hips, arms & more
- Body fat percentage calculator
- Milestones, goals, and progress charts
- 28-day challenges with healthy habits
- Daily, weekly & monthly views
- Smart weight monitor with meaningful trends
- Lose weight or gain — your choice
- Ideal weight calculator
- Personal weighing machine
- Before and after photo comparison
- Achievements and rewards
- Dark mode
- PIN, face recognition & fingerprint lock
- Pounds, Stones, and Kilograms
PRIVACY & SECURITY
Your data stays on your phone. Schedule backups to your private cloud or export anywhere. We don't send data to our servers and third parties cannot access your information. Your journey is yours alone.
Download Better Weight — the weight tracker and BMI calculator that makes every weigh-in count. Start today for free.

bluejetty:00159464:ios.description:
A trusted community for singles and their closest friends. Wingman is a free dating app that allows friends and family to become matchmakers for their single friend. This is 21st century matchmaking, where singles can hand the reins over to those that know them best. Whether it’s your best friend or a family member who will be writing your profile, a trusted testimonial is much better than a self-promotional bio.
The Wingman takes charge with the mission of finding your perfect match. After creating a testimonial for you, they’ll be able to search the dating feed and read what friends have said about their single friends. Once they find a potential match for you, they can approach the single and their wingmen and ask all the necessary questions on your behalf.
Just like in a real-life dating situation, Wingman makes it easier for you to set up friends from the comfort of your own home.
Hate online dating? Do it together, bring your friends, both single and non-single friends on board and find a match together as a team. A Wingman can be a friend, colleague, your brother or even your grandma. Let your personal matchmaker guide you throughout your dating journey. Singles with a Wingman get 80% higher matches than singles alone.
As Singles, you can like and swipe right on other singles that you are interested in matching with, then nudge your wingman to introduce you - as opposed to making a direct approach. There is no embarrassment or stigma with your wingman or wingwoman acting as the middleman.
Save the rejection and get notified only when there’s a match. Add multiple friends and family to play digital cupid for you and see who can do the better job at finding the perfect match.
Singles, sit back and relax. Let a wingman you TRUST to take the wheel and land you better matches.
Wingman is the best dating app for those looking to help their single friend or family member find a date. It’s not about you, it’s about creating opportunities and new connections for your single friend. It’s your chance to find dates for friends, approved by you.
HOW IT WORKS:
• Sign up and verify yourself
• Browse the feed and invite a single friend or wingman on board.
• As a Wingman, you write the profile for your single friend, telling the ‘good/bad/ugly’ then swipe right and make key introductions on behalf of your friend.
• As a Single, you can look for matches for yourself or nudge your wingman to introduce you, which saves any embarrassment, get notified ONLY when there’s a match.
• Get your whole team on board and have multiple friends playing cupid for you. See who can top the leader-board by making the most matches and be ready, as it can get competitive.
WHAT MAKES WINGMAN DIFFERENT
• It’s not about you - It’s about elevating your single friend and introducing them to someone you deem appropriate.
• Friends create trusted and authentic testimonials on behalf of their friend.
. Ask questions – You can ask questions to potential matches before swiping right
• Make a personalized introduction telling the potential match WHY they should meet your single friend.
• Chat with your teammates – Check in and support your single friend every step of the way
A dating app with a difference, Wingman is the number one dating app to help your friends find a date. Download for FREE now.

bluejetty:00073764:ios.description:
The WorthPoint app lets you price & research items on-the-go from your iPhone and iPad. We help collectors and resellers alike answer two burning questions: what is it, and what’s it worth? Whether you’re browsing at home or hunting at an antique mall, flea market, or garage/estate sale, take our suite of tools with you to discover value anytime, anywhere. 
No matter where you are, WorthPoint on your iPhone and iPad helps you see the collectibles market more clearly. Go ahead, try it out! 
Buy Better & Sell Smarter 
• Find accurate pricing trends with our Price Guide comprising nearly 2 decades of historical pricing data aggregated from the world’s leading auction houses and online marketplaces. 
Identify & Authenticate 
• Search our visual database of makers’ marks, autographs, patterns, and symbols to identify your item and discover its history, value, and authenticity. 
Catalog & Preserve 
• Store, track, and organize your prized possessions and watch them grow in value with the Vault — a personal digital archive. 
Antiques & collectibles, simplified. 
• Our Dictionary is your quick reference guide to the collectibles market written by real WorthPoint experts. 
Already a subscriber? Fantastic. You can use your same login credentials both in-app and on WorthPoint.com. Want to upgrade to access all WorthPoint has to offer? You can do that too -- just visit your Account page in-app or online. 
WorthPoint offers access to products through a paid subscription. 
• Payment will be charged to your app store account at confirmation of purchase 
• Subscription automatically renews on selected term basis (monthly or annual) 
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user by going to the user's My Account page after purchase 
• No cancellation fees 
Visit our support page: https://wp.force.com/FAQ/s/ 
Terms of use: https://www.worthpoint.com/page/terms-use

bluejetty:00024806:ios.description:
Fitbit and Health, together at last. Sync all your data from Fitbit to Apple Health. After the first sync, the app will automatically sync in the background throughout the day. **Important** Fitbit currently provides access to daily data only. We have requested Partner API status in order to provide intraday syncing.
Featured by: 
Gigaom, Mashable, MacRumors, AppleInsider, TechRadar, 9to5Mac, LifeHacker, Wearable World News, and many more.
Recommended in "How to Make the Most of Apple's HealthKit in iOS8" on AppleInsider.com
Need to sync from Health to Fitbit? Check out Sync Solver - Health to Fitbit as well.
Data types supported:
- Steps
- Flights Climbed
- Walking + Running Distance
- Weight
- Body Fat Percentage
- Body Mass Index
- Sleep Analysis (In bed and asleep time)
- Water
- Dietary Calories
- Resting Calories
- Active Calories
Notes:
- If you are using Sync Solver - Health to Fitbit, be sure to not sync the same data types as this will result in a data duplication loop.
- Since iOS schedules backgroud updates based on your app usage pattern, it may be necessary to manually sync from time to time in order to keep Sync Solver automatically syncing on a consistent basis.
- Intraday data granularity is not possible at this time due to Fitbit API limitations.

• 1 Year of all features or 1 Week of all features
• Payment will be charged to iTunes Account at confirmation of purchase
• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24-hours before the end of the current period
• Account will be charged for renewal within 24-hours before the end of the current period, and identify the cost of the renewal
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user and auto-renewal may be turned off by going to the user's Account Settings after purchase
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription to that publication, where applicable

Privacy Policy: https://appholdings.org/privacypolicy.html

Put that giant iPad to great use by duct-taping it to the wall (landscape, duh); lean back, pet your hairless cat, and keep an eye on your empire.
DIVE UNDER THE HOOD
Server up to something? DVR recording? Media Optimizer doing its… optimizing? You get a chonky lightning bolt to make sure this doesn’t go unnoticed.
ONE-HANDED CURATION
Browse and change artwork from the palm of your hand while checking out at your local co-op. It’s like that other swipey app, but with less risk of disease.

bluejetty:00146475:ios.description:
Make your message shine anywhere with LED Banner – Scroller Text Maker, the ultimate tool to turn your iPhone or iPad into a bright and dynamic LED display. Whether you want to display big scrolling text, create a digital sign, or design an eye-catching banner for parties, concerts, or business promotions, this LED Banner app gives you complete creative control.
With LED Banner – Scroller Text Maker, your screen becomes a powerful LED board that grabs attention instantly. Type your message, customize color, font, and speed, and watch your text move across the screen like a professional marquee sign. Perfect for events, nightlife, or social media content — it’s the simplest way to make your words stand out.
Key Features
Instantly create vivid LED banners, digital signs, and scrolling text displays.
Use Make It Big mode for large, full-screen LED text that can be seen from a distance.
Customize scrolling direction, animation speed, and RGB LED light color.
Choose from multiple fonts, themes, and visual effects — from classic marquee styles to modern pixel displays.
Add creative text, numbers, and symbols to make your message unique.
Save templates for quick reuse and display them anytime.
Functions as both a banner maker and a smart LED light app.
Fully optimized for iPhone flashlight, iPad display, and dark mode.
Designed for Every Occasion
Use LED Banner – Scroller Text Maker anywhere you need to be seen. Whether cheering at concerts, communicating in loud environments, welcoming guests, or promoting your store, your screen becomes your voice. Ideal for:
Concert or event messages
Party greetings and countdowns
Business and shop promotions
Car window messages or pickup signs
Creative content for YouTube, TikTok, and social platforms
Advanced LED Customization
The app includes precise LED strip control and full RGB customization, allowing you to fine-tune brightness, tone, and motion. Inspired by the effects of professional setups such as GVM LED, Tenmiro LED lights, and Keepsmile LED patterns, you can match your display to any mood or environment. Whether it’s bold colors or soft glows, your banner always looks perfect.
Dual Use: Banner and Light
Need more light while you create? Use LED Banner – Scroller Text Maker as a LED flashlight app, linterna gratis, or linterna luz LED. The flexible display and lighting functions make it useful for both communication and illumination, all in one simple interface.
Why Users Love It
Thousands of users rely on this LED banner maker for its clarity, versatility, and performance. It’s ideal for displaying text, announcements, and creative visuals with stunning brightness. The app combines all the tools you need to design, preview, and display custom LED messages — easily and effectively.
Make It Big. Make It Bright. Make It Yours.
Whether you’re performing on stage, attending a game, or promoting your business, LED Banner – Scroller Text Maker helps you communicate instantly through light and color. It’s more than a banner app — it’s your personal LED studio, ready whenever you need to be seen.
Experience the Power of LED Communication
From concerts to classrooms, from small gatherings to large venues, this LED banner app helps you express yourself in a new way. Create attention-grabbing displays, share messages instantly, and light up your surroundings with creative LED art. Download LED Banner – Scroller Text Maker today and discover how bright your words can be.
Premium Features (Purchase subscription required)
Access to all Premium Templates
Exclusive Sticker Collection
Unlimited Project Saving
Advanced Playback Controls
Pro Text & Background Themes
Elite Glow Stick Styles
Custom Countdown Features
Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/led-privacypolicy
Terms: https://sites.google.com/view/ledterms

bluejetty:00182837:ios.description:
Let’s imagine yourself as a karate & martial art master that is the ultimate king fighter in Kung Fu karate fighting. Karate is an ancient martial art built around self-defense that originates from Japan and China. Play the toughest & real kick fighting game app against world undisputed fighting champions ever. The game offers a real training game app specially developed for fans who love to play PRO karate action games. Karate & martial art fighting become extremely popular worldwide and have many fighting variations. This Karate Training game will help you to learn Karate for free through your handy IOS device.
In this game, there are blockage techniques to defend yourself from enemy attacks. Your opponents use various training styles including taekwondo, Muay Thai, Kung Fu, boxing, and others, show your top-level training to overcome all of your opponents with the power. Keep an eye on every move of your enemy that is fighting with you. Take timely decisions, attack the enemy with punches and kicks at the proper time and block enemy attack using accuracy and speed in your actions. Quickness is key to win the hand to hand fights.
Go toe-to-toe against 30+ bone-crushing fighters from Bangkok, Korea, Thailand, china, japan, and Singapore. Advanced animation and stunning 3D graphics bring the real Karate experience to your hand, while intuitive touchscreen controls make jab, hook, and uppercut feel natural and fun. Learn Karate for all levels and easy for free with this game app. Use your blockage techniques to defend yourself against your rivals. Look out for every move of your enemy and strike first to beat ‘em. Take decisions on time about utilizing your kickboxing moves to show who is a master in this martial arts fighting game. It is a full action-packed game for fans to play and enjoy. 
Learn how to fight hand to hand without any weapons, and by using your karate kicks. Do not hesitate if you are not a PRO because training mode will help you to get trained. You can select a fighter of your own choice and fight with your unique styles. Win all the matches to be promoted to a legends tournament. Get multiple rewards for winning each level. Get ready to battle against the world’s most powerful fighters. This Kung Fu karate game is for professionals who believe they can win against dangerous opponents. This game has awesome background music that will keep you engaged and energized throughout the game. 
Prove yourself by showing your ninja fighting move and earn points for each win. You can upgrade your fighter’s power, speed, and accuracy of their punches in the game. Strike hard and take your rivals down before they get a chance to hit you. Wrestle them to the end so that you can defeat them. Use your bone-crushing techniques to crush ‘em all. Do not lag in taking action because timing is the key to win this game. Use quick reflexes and special moves, unleash fierce punch boxing and combos, beat all fighters, and become the king of karate now. Advanced animation and stunning 3D graphics bring the real Karate experience to your hand. Easily learn Karate for all levels for free with this fun game. It is quite addictive, once you start playing you will not be able to miss out on this ultimate battle.
Karate Kings Fight 2‪6 Game Features: ‬‬‬‬‬
- Learn karate in training mode to test your pro fighting moves
- Select trained karate fighter with Kung Fu tiger fighting styles
- Get promoted by defeating king fighter tournament legends
- Win karate matches & get rewarded points to unlock the next match
- Battle against toughest fighters to win a world karate tournament
-Kung fu king pro karate tournaments with big rewards
-Background music & sound effects will increase your energy in the karate ring

Your menstrual cycle at a glance.
Track your cycle easily with symptoms and treatments, take notes and visualize it!
Want to share it with your doctor? No problem, just generate a printable report!
Want to personalize your tracking? Our tracker is fully customizable, modify it to your liking!
HOW PMDD TRACKER WORKS
- Track your menstrual cycle
- Track your emotional symptoms
- Track your physical symptoms
- Track your treatments
- Write notes
- Have an easy overview of how you are doing
- Recognize your phases
- Analyze your statistics over time
- Create PDF or CSV reports and share them with your doctor
- Define your own symptoms and treatments
- Collect new achievements
- Stay on track with daily reminders
- Lock your journal with Face ID or Touch ID
PERFECT FOR:
- PMDD
- PMDD tracking
- Premenstrual Dysphoric Disorder
- PMDD journal
- PMDD diary
- Mental health monitoring
- Therapy support tool
- Medication tracking

Consult with your doctor if you are experiencing any symptoms of an illness.

bluejetty:00152454:ios.description:
I Am Monkey is an adaptation of the popular VR experience set inside the cage of a zoo monkey. Visitors arrive with different personalities: some are gentle and generous, others are noisy, mocking, or aggressive. Each encounter changes the atmosphere of the cage, creating moments of comedy, chaos, and tension.
Zoo space becomes an interactive playground. Bananas, cameras, and random objects can be grabbed, eaten, or thrown. The bars, the floor, and every gift from visitors are fully interactive, making each session unique and alive.
With fully interactive objects, unpredictable visitor behavior, and a mix of humor and tension, I Am Monkey offers a sandbox experience that blends playful fun with thought-provoking encounters.
Gameplay features:
Be the Monkey – fully immersive VR perspective of a zoo animal.
Multiple play styles – charm, ignore, resist
Various visitors – humans who can be cute, friendly, or aggressive.
Sandbox interactivity – throw bananas, grab visitors’ objects or the visitors, manipulate your environment.
Play as a Monkey
In I Am Monkey you live behind bars, but your world is full of choices. Visitors come and go — some gentle, some cruel — each one shaping the story of the little Monkey.

bluejetty:00120117:ios.description:
21 fun games to help kids learn First Grade lessons! Games are designed using real 1st Grade curriculums and core curriculum state standards. 
Games include:
MATH
• Patterns - Learn to identify repeating patterns, a critical skill for first grade
• Ordering - Place objects in order based on size, numbers, and letters
• Compare Numbers - Advanced math topic that compares numbers to see what is greater or less than
• Add, Subtract, and Advanced Math - Help learn advanced math skills like additional and subtraction with fun falling fruit
• Fractions - Fun way to learn the visual representation of fractions
• Timed Math Facts - Quickly answer simple math facts to earn basketballs
LANGUAGE
• Word Bingo - Help your first grader with reading and spelling skills in a fun bingo game
• Compound Words - Combine words to build compound words
• Advanced Counting - Skip count by 2's, 3's, 4's, 5's, 10's and more
• Contractions - Teach your 1st Grader how to combine words to make contractions
• Spelling - Learn how to spell hundreds of words with helpful voice assistance
• Verbs, Nouns, Adjectives - Your child will learn different types of words like verbs, nouns, and adjectives
• Sight Words - Learn how to spell and recognize important sight words
• Reading Basics - Read articles and answer questions, with the ability to get assistance on tough words
• Plurals - Form the correct plural version of words
SCIENCE
• Geography - Identify the oceans, continents, and various types of landforms
• Body Parts - Learn and identify all the body parts of the human body, and learn how diagrams work
• Photosynthesis - Help the plant conduct photosynthesis and learn about the process vital for all plant life
• Dinosaurs and Fossils - Identify different dinosaurs and learn about how we can learn about dinosaurs from fossils
• 5 Senses - Learn the 5 senses, how they help us understand the world, and which body part each uses
• Animals - Classify and learn about a variety of animals, such as mammals, reptiles, birds, fish, and more
• Cause & Effect - Listen and match a cause with the correct effect
• Great Scientists - Learn about Albert Einstein, Rosalyn Franklin, and other outstanding scientists
Games are a fun and engaging way for kids to learn and practice new skills. RosiMosi games include voice narrations, colorful images and animations, and lots of fun sounds and music. 
=====================================
SCHOOL EDITION APPS
School edition apps have no in-app purchases, subscriptions, or ads and are completely safe for kids.
PROBLEMS WITH THE GAME?
If you are having issues with the game or have questions please email us at help@rosimosi.com and we will get it fixed for you ASAP.
LEAVE US A REVIEW!
If you're enjoying the game then we'd love for you to leave us a review! Reviews help small developers like us keep improving this game.

bluejetty:00147098:ios.description:
WayDay helps you get things done. It's a to-do list, habit tracker, daily planner, and reminder all in one app. It's easy to use, looks great, and works well for everyone — especially if you sometimes find it hard to focus or have ADHD.
What you can do
• Add one-time tasks or set repeating ones like “Clean every Friday.” 
• Drag and drop tasks to change priority fast. 
• Color-code what’s urgent — no more guessing. 
• Miss a task? It moves to tomorrow automatically. 
• Break big goals into small sub-tasks. 
• Reschedule with one tap: Today, Tomorrow, This Week, Someday. 
• Edit many tasks at once to save time. 
Build strong habits
• Create flexible schedules (Mon, Wed & Sat workouts? Done.) 
• See your streaks grow day by day. 
• Start timers for long challenges — 30 days smoke-free, for example. 
• Track any unit you need: steps, pages, minutes, cups — your choice. 
• Set as many reminders as it takes to stay on track. 
• Review your wins on a calendar anytime. 
Extra power
• Lists with icons for Work, Home, Hobbies, and more. 
• Quick-capture Inbox for ideas on the fly. 
• Notes for extra details.
• 7 Home Screen widgets — your day at a glance.
• Swipe-down search to find anything in seconds. 
• Archive of completed tasks to see how far you’ve come. 
• iCloud sync keeps all devices up to date. 
• Face ID or passcode lock for privacy. 
• Spotlight Search support. 
Make every day a WayDay — start your best routine today!
WayDay is free to use. Upgrade to WayDay Plus for even more features whenever you’re ready. 
Subscription details: Payment is charged to your Apple ID at confirmation and renews unless you turn off auto-renew 24 hours before the period ends. Manage anytime in Settings. 
Terms of Use: https://waydayapp.com/terms/ 
Privacy Policy: https://waydayapp.com/privacy/

bluejetty:00159219:ios.description:
● Share all your social media profiles instantly.
● Discover and connect with new people nearby. 
● Perfect for networking at conferences or socializing at parties, hangouts, clubs, college, and more.
Revolutionize the way you make new friends and share your social profiles with utmost ease. DigitsX is designed to be a contact-free way to connect. It lets you meet more new people around you with less stress and hassle.
■ SHARE SOCIALS
Forget about the frustration of spelling out your handles or messing with QR codes. Now you can add all the social profiles you want to share such as LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram, and share them in just two taps. 
■ FIND & MEET NEW PEOPLE
Unlike other social sharing apps, DigitsX is very fun to use as it uses your location to help you find new friends. The app shows the closest DigitsX profiles first. 
Also, the app broadcasts your social media account handles to people using the app near your general location. In that way, you can both exchange and store contact info. 
■ PERFECT FOR ANY SOCIAL GATHERINGS
From clubs and group hangouts to conferences and fairs, DigitsX is perfect to socialize with the people of your interest. It’s also ideal to use in college, or if you just moved into a new town.
This simple way of sharing contact info and meeting new people helps reduce friction and stress. Say goodbye to awkward approaches or impossible introductions, and download DigitsX now!
■ DIGITSX FEATURES:
● Search tool to find people, near and far, with authorized access to their contact information.
● Control the profiles seen by customizing the distance between you and other users.
● Filter who’s profiles you see by selecting social media handles you want to see and blocking ones you don’t.
● Save people and profiles you like and add them to your contact list to view later.
● Block user option.
■ AVAILABLE DIGITS:
* Instagram
* Facebook
* Tiktok
* Paypal
* Venmo
* YouTube
* Tinder
* WhatsApp
* Snapchat
* Twitter
* Linkedin
* Spotify
* VSCO
* Pinterest
* GroupMe
Now it’s time to share social profiles and meet new people the easy way with DigitsX.
► Download and try now for FREE.
_____
PLEASE NOTE:
DigitsX is free to download and most features are free. However, there are in-app purchases you can access to enhance your experience within the app. These include features such as seeing who viewed your profile and which previous encounters you may have missed.
Terms of service: https://app.termly.io/document/terms-of-use-for-ios-app/98058c86-a7b2-4a3a-a9d0-978f8da12cf0

bluejetty:00026882:ios.description:
Live the age of the ancient Spartan empires.
Raise your shield, grasp your spear, wear your Corinthian with honor, breath deeply, calm your heart, take a moment to think what you are fighting for, and then rush into the battle alongside your fellow spartans for the glory of your empire.
Fire and Glory is the newest strategy game that will bring you to ancient and epic times of legendary Sparta. You will fight alongside kings that made history like Leonidas. You will rise your empire, clash against your foes, live or die together with your fellow Spartans. 
Rise your Empire.
Kingdoms in Fire and Glory are the majestic display of true kings' glory, of their wealth and power. Gather all the resources you need and strategically use them to gain the upper hand against your belligerent neighbor's kingdoms. Build over 20 different buildings with 30 levels of power each. Train soldiers of 4 different tiers and equip them with refined weapons and armors imbued with powerful magical gems. Research and develop new technologies that will open your empire to abilities and roads of power never thought possible. 
Your soldiers are your brothers and sisters.
Carefully train them and equip them as you would do with your own kin because they are the men and women who fight alongside you, who will watch your back, live and die shoulder to shoulder. Unlock ever-growing elite units and make your enemies tremble in fear. The gods will look upon you with favor. 
A world to explore.
ravel and trade with exotic and incredible nations, speak freely your language and you will be understood by everyone with our automatic AI real-time translator. Engage with bizarre civilization and carve your name in the stones of time. May your fame precede you wherever you go.
A world to conquer.
It's time to change history and expand Sparta's borders over the limits of the known world and over. Those civilizations who looked down on you will soon know that a spartan king can become their worst nightmare. Attack empires all over the map, pillage their resources and grow your kingdom even more. Attack the wandering monsters like Dragons, Chimera, Tauren, Naga, Spider, Minotaurs, and more and gain items that you will combine to build stronger weapons and armors.
Honor your hero.
You will command your hero who will lead your armies and be the king of your empire. Protect him/her and make him worthy of carrying your name in battle.
Frequent in-game events will keep you busy in your well-deserved leisure time. Are you ready to fire war for the final glory? Come and experience this highly addictive MMO SLG game FOR FREE NOW.

bluejetty:00062087:ios.description:
The College of Coastal Georgia App brings campus to your fingertips and enables you to connect with the CCGA community. Stay on top of your events, classes and assignments with the built in calendar function, and get notified of important dates and deadlines. Learn about important resources, ask questions, and keep in touch with your campus at any time! 
Some other exciting features include: 
+ Classes: Manage classes, create to-dos & reminders, and stay on top of assignments. 
+ Events: Discover what events are happening on campus and set reminders. 
+ Featured Events: Orientation, Homecoming, etc. 
+ Groups & Clubs: Get involved with campus organizations and meet people with similar interests 
+ Campus Services: Learn about services offered, such as Academic Advising, Financial Aid & Counseling. 
+ Campus Community: Meet friends, ask questions, and keep up with what's happening on the campus wall. 
+ Campus Map: Find the quickest route to classes, events, and offices. 
+ Campus Experience: Keep track of attended events and services, and provide real-time feedback 
+ Receive Emergency notifications

bluejetty:00179297:ios.description:
iPassworder is a fast and simple password manager built for everyday use.
Add a new password in seconds, find what you need quickly, copy it with one tap, and move on. No complicated folders, no clutter, and no unnecessary steps - just a clean way to store and access your passwords and private information.
Keep logins, emails, bank accounts, cards, and other sensitive data in one easy-to-use vault. Unlock securely with your Master Password, Face ID, or Touch ID, and access your saved data even when you are offline.
iPassworder also includes a built-in Password Generator, helping you create strong, unique passwords whenever you need them. With Quick Password Create, you can generate and fill a password while adding a new entry with just one tap.
The app is ad-free, including the free version. And if you choose to upgrade, there are no subscriptions - just a one-time purchase.
Key Features:

Za korišcenje naše m-banking aplikacije morate imati aktiviranu uslugu elektronskog bankarstva.

bluejetty:00106114:android.description:
The World of Disney’s Frozen comes to life in an exciting new match 3 puzzle adventure. Join Elsa, Anna and Olaf as you build, renovate and decorate the Kingdom in a brand new game based on Disney’s Frozen & Frozen 2 movies. Design and decorate the Kingdom of Arendelle and beyond, all while playing match-3 puzzle games.
Explore and embark on an all-new Frozen adventure that takes you to new and familiar locations around Arendelle and the entire Frozen world. Embark on quests to Oaken's Trading Post to collect supplies in this amazing decoration game. Play hundreds of match-3 games and earn snowflakes to decorate the castle and make it look amazing!

Decorate the castle entrance, great hall, and many more rooms throughout Arendelle through your own design choices!

bluejetty:00014434:ios.description:
Manage users, groups, devices, reset passwords & receive critical notifications. 
The Microsoft 365 Admin App enables you to be productive from anywhere. The app allows you to receive critical notifications, add users, reset passwords, manage devices, create support requests, and more—all while you’re on the go. 
Who should use this app? People with an admin role to a Microsoft 365 or Office 365 enterprise or business subscription. 
What can I do with this app? 
- Add, edit, block, or delete users, reset passwords, assign roles, or manage aliases & devices. 
- Add groups, edit groups, and add or remove users from groups. 
- View all available and assigned licenses, assign licenses to users, add or remove licenses, view and download invoices. 
- Check the status of existing support requests, take actions on them, or create new ones. 
- Monitor the health of all services and view active incidents in Service Health. 
- Stay on top of all the upcoming changes and announcements via the Message Center feed. 
- Get push notifications about important information related to service health, message center, and billing. 
The app supports dark theme and is available in 39 languages. And if you're someone who is responsible for managing more than one tenant, you can sign-in to multiple tenants and quickly switch between them. 
We're listening and constantly improving the app based on your feedback. Tell us what you like, what we can do better, and what features you'd like to see in the app. Send your feedback to feedback365@microsoft.com.

Search the web. Plant trees. Fund climate projects.
Ecosia is more than just a search engine — it’s a simple way to take climate action every day. Just by browsing the internet, you can help plant trees in biodiversity hotspots, support lo
bluejetty:00084715:ios.description:
Search the web. Plant trees. Fund climate projects.
Ecosia is more than just a search engine — it’s a simple way to take climate action every day. Just by browsing the internet, you can help plant trees in biodiversity hotspots, support local communities, and combat climate change.
Search with purpose: Like other search engines, Ecosia earns money from ads. But unlike them, we use 100% of our profits to fund climate action. Over 250 million trees have already been planted across 35+ countries, restoring landscapes and saving wildlife.
Your data stays yours: We only collect what's needed to deliver search results, and your searches are always encrypted. — We want trees, not your data.
Our solar plants: Searching requires energy. Ecosia invests into renewable energy, phasing out fossil fuels from the electricity grid.
Transparency & Ownership: As a not-for-profit, steward-owned company, we publish monthly financial reports that show you which organisations were funded.
Download Ecosia and join a global community of millions taking meaningful action for the planet, one search at a time.

bluejetty:00140615:ios.summary:

Get the top
bluejetty:00140615:ios.description:
Set multiple timers and stopwatches at once. Build customizable multi-step routines for workouts, cooking, focus sessions, and everyday tasks. Adjust time on the fly without stopping. Timer+ handles everything you throw at it.
Get the top timer app that’s repeatedly rated 5 stars by users.
Create, name, and reuse timers for anything—yoga stretches, cooking rice, workouts, timed quizzes, therapeutic treatments, or remembering to take your pills.
Perfect for busy people, multitaskers, and forgetful folks.
Loved by parents, athletes, chefs, teachers, and students…
TIMERS
Great for laundry, cooking, naps, meetings, and study sessions.
+ Count down for a set duration of up to 99 days
+ Repeat up to 64 times
+ Add or remove time while a timer is running
+ Pause, resume, and skip repeats
+ Count up after a timer ends so you can extend it or see when it finished
+ Start a Quick Timer for one-off tasks without saving it
+ Schedule a timer to start at a set time, or to end by one
STOPWATCHES
Great for workouts, speeches, meditation, therapy, and timing between medications.
+ Track elapsed time from the moment you start
+ Pause and resume anytime
+ Record laps and label them so they’re easy to find in Timer History
COUNTDOWNS
Best for birthdays, deadlines, appointments, travel days, and other important events.
+ Count down to a specific date and time
+ Keep counting up after the moment passes
ROUTINES
Ideal for Tabata, HIIT, yoga flows, breathing exercises, baking bread, and other multi-step activities.
+ Combine Timer and Stopwatch steps in the order you need
+ Organize steps into Blocks, each with its own Repeats and rests
+ Give every step a custom name, duration, color, and alerts
+ Hear Announcements for the step name, what’s up next, halfway, and time remaining
+ Add a Start Countdown, Warmup, Cooldown, and steps between other steps or repeats
+ Let a step wait for you to tap Done, or move on automatically
+ Skip or extend a step while your routine is running
ROUTINE TEMPLATES
+ Start with ready-made Tabata Workout, Pomodoro, and EMOM templates
+ Customize a copy’s Blocks, Steps, Repeats, colors, sounds, and alerts
+ Build your own routine one step at a time
FOLDERS
+ Organize your timers into folders
+ Move one or several timers at once
+ See everything in All Timers, grouped by folder
TIMER HISTORY
+ Review completed and cancelled runs, including routine steps and stopwatch laps
+ See history for all timers or for one folder
+ Turn Timer History off or clear it anytime
WIDGETS & LIVE ACTIVITIES
+ Start, pause, cancel, or open timers from Home Screen widgets
+ See all running and paused timers with the Active Timers widget
+ Follow eligible timers and stopwatches on your Lock Screen and in the Dynamic Island
APPLE WATCH
+ View and control timers from your wrist
+ Use Quick Create to start a countdown timer or stopwatch in one step
SIRI & SHORTCUTS
+ Create, start, pause, and cancel timers with Siri, App Intents, and Shortcuts
QUESTIONS AND ANSWERS
Q: Why use Timer+ instead of the built-in Clock app?
A: Use Timer+ when the built-in Clock app is too limited for the way you actually time things. Save reusable timers, run multiple timers and stopwatches at once, build multi-step routines, repeat timers automatically, adjust time while a timer is running, run timers for up to 99 days, and keep counting after a timer ends.
Q: What is included in Timer+ Pro?
A: Timer+ Pro removes ads and unlocks unlimited saved timers, full timer history, advanced routines, and advanced announcements. Choose a recurring subscription or a one-time lifetime purchase.
www.timerplusapp.com/privacy
www.timerplusapp.com/terms

bluejetty:00077681:ios.description:
Ever spoken with Santa Claus before?
Make your children's day and spark wonder by letting them connect with Santa. Now, your child can have both audio and video conversations with Santa.
The “Santa Calling App” brings the enchantment of speaking directly with Santa, providing a genuine experience that brings joy and warmth. This app serves as a fantastic tool for parents aiming to encourage positive behavior in their children.
HOW TO RECEIVE A CALL FROM SANTA 
◆ Choose any Santa audio/video option. 
◆ Tap the “Call” button. 
◆ Santa will call you instantly.
Other intuitive features that make this game stand out among Santa lovers:
1. Make Santa in AR: This interactive AR game allows users to find and collect Santa’s accessories—such as his coat, bells, and face—virtually around them. With five levels, each level presents different accessories to collect, creating a highly engaging and fun experience for users.
2. Scratch & Reveal: Featuring 15 exciting levels, this game presents users with a set of items to find. They scratch cards within a time limit to reveal the correct item, with each level offering new, engaging challenges. The game’s unique combination of time variations and varying questions adds depth, encouraging users to keep playing and test their skills.
3. Santa Shell: In this game, users must track a gift box hidden under one of three coconut shells. The shells shuffle rapidly, and the game speeds up with each correct guess, making the challenge more intense and exciting. This game develops users' focus, quick thinking, and hand-eye coordination while providing a fun, competitive experience.
4. Birthday Greetings: Users enter the birthday person’s name, and Santa appears with a personalized call to deliver joyful birthday wishes, creating a charming and memorable surprise.
5. Nice or Naughty: Users scan their thumb to see if they’re on Santa’s “Nice” or “Naughty” list. The playful scan and Santa’s fun reveal make this a quick, entertaining experience for all ages.

* Subscription plans: Weekly. For exact pricing in your region, refer to the payment screen within the application.
* Upon confirmation of purchase, your payment will be charged to your iTunes account.
* Manage your subscriptions and disable auto-renewal from your Account Settings post-purchase.
* Unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the current period ends, your subscription will automatically renew.
* The renewal cost will be charged to your account 24 hours before the current period ends.
* Upon cancellation, your subscription remains active until the end of the current period. Auto-renewal will be disabled, but no refunds will be issued for the current subscription.

bluejetty:00026779:ios.description:
Join over 10 million women and seniors around the world who’ve chosen LazyFit to stay active, healthy, and confident.
No pressure. No gym required. Just simple, science-based workouts you can do anytime — right from your chair, bed, or living room.
- LAZYFIT FEATURES
28-Day Weight-Loss Challenge
Kickstart your transformation with short daily sessions that gradually build up intensity. Designed to help you burn calories and tone muscles while staying gentle on joints.
Chair Yoga
Stretch, strengthen, and restore — all from the comfort of your chair. Perfect for beginners or anyone with limited mobility, Chair Yoga helps you improve flexibility, posture, and balance without strain.
Pilates for Every Place
• Bed Pilates — Strengthen and stretch without leaving your bed; perfect for morning or bedtime routines.
• Mat Pilates — Classic floor routines to tone your core and improve posture, guided with easy-to-follow cues.
• Wall Pilates — Build balance and strength using wall support; ideal for beginners or joint-friendly training.
Each routine tones your core, eases tension, and improves balance — perfect for building strength at any age or fitness level.
Tai Chi Flow
Breathe deeply, calm your mind, and strengthen your body through graceful, flowing movements inspired by traditional Tai Chi.
Guided Walking Workouts
Turn every walk — indoors or outdoors — into a mindful fitness session. Follow calming audio guidance, track your steps and calories.
- Why You’ll Love LazyFit
• Low-impact & beginner-friendly — suitable for all ages and body types.
• Clear video guidance — follow step-by-step demonstrations with easy pacing.
• Smart progress tracking — see your improvements in strength, endurance, and balance.
• Personalized daily plan — LazyFit adapts to your energy, mood, and goals.
• Gentle reminders — stay motivated without pressure. Move Gently, Live Fully
- Start Feeling Better Today
Whether you’re returning to exercise, staying active from home, or caring for your body as it changes, LazyFit adapts to your rhythm.
Short on time? Choose 10-minute routines.
Need a break from screens? Follow calming audio guidance and focus on breathing.
Open LazyFit. Move your way — one gentle step at a time.

• Subscription automatically renews unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period
• The account will be charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period
• Any unused portion of a free trial period, if offered, will be forfeited when the user purchases a subscription
• Subscriptions may be managed by the user, and auto-renewal may be turned off, by going to iTunes Subscriptions after purchase
Note: Always consult a physician or a doctor before starting any fitness plan. Results can vary.
