bluejetty:00120359:ios.description:
The #1 preschool game in the app store. Learn and have fun by helping monkey pack lunch! Monkey Preschool Lunchbox is a collection of seven exciting educational games for your preschooler (ages 2 to 5). 
*** FEATURES ***
-7 different games that teach kids about colors, letters, counting, shapes, sizes, matching, and differences. 
-Lovable animated monkey helps kids along as they play the games.
-Dozens of sounds and voice recordings of colors, letters, fruit names, and more.
-Animated Stickers! Kids get sticker rewards to encourage their progress. 
-Designed for preschoolers -- no confusing menus or navigation.
-Unlimited play! Each game flows right into the next.
*** INCLUDED GAMES ***
1. COLORS. This picky monkey only likes fruit of a certain color, touch only the color they like to pack the lunchbox. Teaches colors, color names, and grouping.
2. MATCHING. Match pairs of fruit hidden behind the cards to pack lunch for this monkey.
3. COUNTING. Count off the fruit the monkey is looking for to fill up the lunchbox. Teaches numbers and counting.
4. LETTERS. This monkey only wants fruit that starts with a certain letter, pick the fruit that starts with that letter. Teaches letters and letter sounds.
5. PUZZLE. This monkey's fruit broke into pieces! How odd! Put it back together for them. Teaches shapes and pattern recognition.
6. SPOT THE DIFFERENCE. Help the monkey spot the fruit that looks different, or is a different size. Teaches patterns, bigger, and smaller.
7. SHAPES. Help the monkey find the fruit in the shapes.

bluejetty:00186739:ios.description:
** Free version with in-app purchases - A full version is also available **
The same collection that brought you our "Find them all: looking for animals" game has a new addition: the long-awaited world of dinosaurs!
"Find Them All: Dinosaurs & Prehistoric Animals" is an educational game for kids entirely spoken in 8 languages!
Younger kids will learn quickly to identify dinos and prehistoric animals (name, call, sounds and pictures) during a discovery phase which requires dexterity (scrolling, touch). 
Older kids are able to look for dinos in the night and use the camera to make their own photo album or create jigsaw puzzles (up to 42 pieces). 
** Try it: it's a free, fun and educational game! **
- Search for dinosaurs in their habitat and win animated cards.
- Take photos and listen to information about your favourite animals.
- Find all the animals before nightfall...or use a torch to find them in the dark.
- Make jigsaws from your photos (4, 6, 12, 20, 42 pieces).
- Play a photo quiz and try to win new snaps for your album.
- Find the cameraman and he’ll show you a video!
Kids can even print their cards and photos from the albums!
** "Find them all" collection features **
- Game for kids AGED BETWEEN 2 AND 8 - no advertising and parental control
- Spoken assistance and instructions (8 languages).
- Introduction to languages: names are available in 8 languages.
- Each round is different (different settings and positions in every round).
- Album printing function.
** World of dinosaurs 1 (lite version, free) **
Contains 8 dinos: Brachiosaurus, Spinosaurus, Carnotaurus, Pachycephalosaurus, Parasaurolophus, Pteranodon, Sauropelta, Styracosaurus.

- Altirhinus, Amargasaurus, Ankylosaurus, Archelon, Arthropleura, Ceratosaurus, Desmatosuchus, Dimorphodon, Diplocaulus, Eurhinosaurus, Kentrosaurus, Liopleurodon, Masiakasaurus, Megalodon, Meganeura, Microceratops, Nothosaurus, Olorotitan, Pentaceratops, Placodus, Pterodactylus, Tanystropheus , Therizinosaurus, Torvosaurus.

- Allosaurus, Archaeopteryx, Centrosaurus, Compsognathus, Dilong, Dilophosaurus, Diplodocus, Estemmenosuchus, Giganotosaurus, Gigantspinosaurus, Lambeosaurus, Maiasaura, Majungasaurus, Mononykus, Ouranosaurus, Pachyrhinosaurus, Prestosuchus, Psittacosaurus, Quetzalcoatlus, Rhamphorhynchus, Stegoceras, Suchomimus, Torosaurus, Udanoceratops.
** Prehistoric animals (In-App Purchase) **
- Mammoth, Woolly Rhinoceros , Cave Lion, Brontotherium, Deinotherium, Doedicurus, Macrauchenia, Paraceratherium, Smilodon, Daeodon, Uintatherium, Arsinoitherium , Cronopio, Eohippus, Phorusrhacos, Arctodus, Darwinius, Megatherium, Platybelodon, Titanoboa, Acherontisuchus, Megaloceros, Hyaenodon and Caveman!

bluejetty:00070769:ios.summary:

Set a custom step count goal and track your progress over time. The built-in graphs ma
bluejetty:00070769:ios.description:
Available on the iPhone and Apple Watch, Pedometer++ is the best way to review your step count, walking distance, active calories, and heart rate data. 
Set a custom step count goal and track your progress over time. The built-in graphs make reviewing your data easy and fun. Everyone loves awards, and Pedometer++ includes a range of Badges to motivate and reward your hard work! The app also totals how far you’ve walked each day, and even counts the flights of stairs you encounter each day.
With full-featured widget support, Pedometer++ can display your step count or update you on your daily progress right from your iPhone's lock screen or home screen. You can also share your workouts with others and view trends over time.
The Apple Watch app puts all this data on your wrist. With a wide range of Complications, it’s easy to check your progress with just a glance. Add a single Complication to your daily watch face, or add several to build a comprehensive fitness-focused look! 
DETAILS:
For best results, keep your iPhone on you as you move throughout the day, ideally in a pocket close to your hips. If you have an Apple Watch, you can set Pedometer++ to sync step data across your devices for the most accurate data possible.
The Apple Watch app can also start and track indoor and outdoor walking and running workouts and can serve as your guide while hiking.
ROUTES & MAPPING:
Pedometer++ is your ultimate companion for exploring the great outdoors. It allows you to import GPX files for waypoints and routes set by others. 
You can also use the app to create your own routes. Simply tap on your desired start and end points, and Pedometer++ will find the shortest route between them. You can then tweak the route based on terrain, trail popularity, or personal preference. 
Pedometer++ shows the distance of a route, the elevation changes you will encounter, and the estimated time it will take you to reach your destination. You can also monitor the weather that is expected along your route.
The best part is that custom routing is available on the iPhone and Apple Watch. Of course, being out in nature often means losing cell service, so Pedometer++ allows you to download offline map data for large areas, not just for your specific route. Offline map data is also available on the iPhone and Apple Watch, as long as your Watch is within range of your phone.
NOTES:
Pedometer++ integrates with the Apple Health app to collect and display step data collected by your Apple Watch. 
Pedometer++ includes an optional premium subscription. This is offered on a monthly or annual basis. If you choose to purchase a subscription, your payment will be charged to your iTunes account. Subscriptions automatically renew unless canceled within 24 hours before the end of the current period. After purchase, you can turn off auto-renewal anytime by going to your Account Settings on the App Store.
Access to iPhone-based workout tracking is only available to Pedometer++ Premium subscribers.
LEARN MORE:
Privacy Policy: https://pedometer.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://pedometer.app/terms

bluejetty:00041588:ios.description:
*** Sesame. Your key, reinvented. ***
Your physical key becomes an app in 1 second.
● Leave your keys behind
Just lock and unlock your door using the Sesame app on your phone. Better yet, open Sesame with a knock[1] on your phone or let the magic happen automatically[2] when your are back. Your keys, reinvented. 
● Share access
Allow guests in no matter where you are. Control who has access and when. 
● Log records 
Receive a notification whenever your door opens or closes. 
● Installs in seconds
Simply tape Sesame to your door with a single strip of 3M Command tape (supplied). It fits your lock without removing or swapping anything. No tools required. 
● Fits all deadbolts
Sesame works with just about any single cylinder deadbolt in the USA/ Canada/ Denmark/ Sweden/ Norway/ Singapore/ Japan/ Malaysia thanks to five-patented self-adjusting mechanisms. Sesame doesn't even need to be exactly at the center of your lock or at any specific angle. It just works with your lock perfectly.
● Long battery life
Sesame lasts about 500 days on lithium batteries (supplied), and sends a notification when the batteries are low.
● Apple Watch
Lock/unlock your door with Apple Watch. If Apple Watch doesn't connect to Sesame via Bluetooth, please turn Watch's Flight Mode on and off, and make sure Sesame is nearby your Apple Watch.
[1] Knock-iPhone-To-Unlock feature is available on iPhone 5S, 6, 6 Plus, 6S, 6S Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, 8, 8 Plus, X, X Max, XS, XS Max with iOS 9 or newer.
[2] Auto-Unlock feature is available on iPhone 4S, 5, 5C, 5S, 6, 6 Plus, 6S, 6S Plus, SE, 7, 7 Plus, 8, 8 Plus, X, X Max, XS, XS Max with iOS 9 or newer.
[3] Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery life.

bluejetty:00041038:ios.description:
CarLink - Smart Car Access, Status & Connectivity
Welcome to CarLink, the smarter way to stay connected to your car. CarLink helps you control key vehicle functions, monitor real-time status, and enjoy a more convenient driving experience - all from one app on your iPhone.
Compatible with 40+ leading car brands, including Ford, Toyota, Jeep, Tesla, Nissan, Acura, Audi, BMW, Buick, Cadillac, Chevrolet, Chrysler, Dodge, GMC, Jaguar, Land Rover, Lexus, Lincoln, Mercedes-Benz, MINI, RAM, Rivian, Volkswagen, and Volvo.
Key Features
1. Apple CarPlay Support: 
Seamlessly connect your phone to your car’s dashboard for easy access to navigation, calls, messages, and entertainment while driving.
2. Remote Lock & Unlock
Lock or unlock your car doors from your phone with just a tap. Perfect for everyday convenience and added peace of mind.
3. Real-Time Vehicle Status
Check important vehicle information at a glance, including tire pressure, battery range, fuel level, odometer, location, and more.
4. Safety & Access Monitoring
Stay informed with alerts and status updates that help you keep track of your vehicle and protect what matters most.
5. Hands-Free Driving Support
Use voice control to make calls, send messages, get directions, and manage music while keeping your hands on the wheel.
6. Advanced Navigation
Get real-time traffic updates, turn-by-turn directions, and route suggestions to help you get where you need to go faster.
7. Music & Entertainment
Enjoy your favorite music, podcasts, and audiobooks on the road with support for popular apps like Apple Music, Spotify, and Audible.
8. Easy Setup
Set up quickly and connect in just a few steps. CarLink is designed to make car connectivity simple and hassle-free.
Why CarLink?
CarLink combines smart vehicle access, real-time car information, and Car Play Mode convenience in one streamlined app. It’s built for drivers who want more control, more confidence, and a better connected driving experience.

bluejetty:00169817:ios.description:
Prepare yourself for a thrilling venture into the heart of the wilderness with Animal Hunter: Wild Shooting. In this action-packed shooting simulator, step into the boots of a skilled marksman and hunter, ready to engage in intense encounters with the most cunning and elusive wild animals – deer, lions, bears, giraffes, pigs, crocodiles, jackals, bulls, elephants, goats, leopards, rhinos, and hippopotamuses. Get ready to embark on the ultimate hunting safari where your sniping precision and combat skills will be put to the test.
Features:
- Deer Hunting Challenge: Immerse yourself in the thrill of the hunt as you track down majestic whitetail deer species and other wild game. Sharpen your aim, steady your trigger finger, and become the ultimate deer hunter. Perfect your sniper shooting skills and target with precision.
- Wilderness Warfare: Navigate through diverse and realistic natural environments, from dense forests to open plains. Engage in epic battles amidst the stunning terrains of untamed wilderness. Encounter authentic animals in various landscapes.
- Precision Shooting: Hone your sniper skills to perfection as you aim for the bullseye. Each trigger pull is an opportunity to demonstrate your shooting expertise. Practice gun shooting and enhance your accuracy in this hunting simulator.
- Modern Firearms Arsenal: Choose from a wide array of modern rifles, each equipped to help you achieve precision and power in your hunting expeditions. Load ammo, upgrade equipment, and prepare for the hunt.
- Stealthy Assassin: Adopt the tactics of an elite assassin as you silently stalk your prey. Approach with caution and strike with precision to ensure a successful hunt, whether targeting deer, wolves, or grizzly bears.
- Epic Battles: Engage in intense clash scenarios as you face off against cunning deer, lions, pigs, crocodiles, bulls, leopards, and hippopotamuses, testing your reflexes and tactical abilities in a dynamic FPS experience.
- Action-Packed Gameplay: Dive into fast-paced, heart-pounding action that keeps you on the edge of your seat. Every moment in "Animal Hunter: Wild Shooting" is an adrenaline rush. Experience a socially interactive and action-packed sports game.
- Achieve Hunter Greatness: Earn accolades and rewards for your exceptional hunting skills. Become a legendary deer, lion, pig, crocodile, bull, leopard, and hippopotamus hunter. Fulfill your hunter spirit and rise to the challenge.
-Realistic Graphics and Authentic Experience:- Enjoy 3D graphics that bring stunning terrains and authentic animals to life. Experience realistic bullet paths and environmental factors that enhance the hunting simulation.
Prove your mettle in the wild and prove yourself an elite hunter in Animal Hunter: Wild Shooting. Are you ready to stalk, target, and triumph as the ultimate deer, lion, bear, giraffe, pig, crocodile, jackal, bull, elephant, goat, leopard, rhino, and hippopotamus hunter? Lace up your boots, load your ammo, and embark on the adventure of your life in the world of precision hunting!
Enjoy Animal Hunter: Wild Shooting committed to the action!

Subscription is renewed unless turned off 24 hours before the end of the period, and the account will be automatically charged for renewal as well. How does NU Transit work?
NU transit includes both the Safe Ride service around campus and transit planning with the Shuttle. You can see shuttle stop times and plan your Campus Loop, Evanston Loop, and Intercampus Shuttle trips directly from the app.
What is Safe Ride?
The service works like a rideshare that comes where you want, when you want. Enter your pickup and dropoff addresses and choose the ride option that works best for you! Download the NU Transit app and log in using your net id and password.
How much are trips?
Rides are free if you are an eligible student. Head to https://www.northwestern.edu/saferide/ for more information.
How long will I wait?
- You'll always get an accurate estimate of your pick-up ETA before booking
- You can also track your ride in real time using the app

Loving your experience so far? Give us a 5-star rating.

bluejetty:00160148:ios.description:
تطبيق مواقيت الصلاة 
برنامج يتح لك معرف اوقات الصلاة في كل مكان و اي وقت تحتاجه لا أداء هذا الركن الأساسي و القائمه على الدين والصلاة كما يعرف جميع المسلمين انها هي عماد الدين
كما يخبرك ايضاً البرنامج لاتجاه القبلة عن طريق البوصله المضمنه في البرنامج
وذلك التاريخ الهجري وتقويم لتاريخ الهجري و اختيار التنبيه لوقت الصلاة 
وكذلك معرفت أوقات الصلاة لخمسة ايام على الشاشة الرئيسية
-- طرق حساب اوقات الصلاة
يقوم البرنامج بأستخدام نظام تحديد المواقع العالمي لمعرفة خطوط الطول و داوائر العرض وبعد عملية حسابية لأضهار أوقات الصلاة مثل (( الفجر و شروق الشمس و الظهر و العصر و كذلك وقت غروب الشمس و العشاء )) 
ملاحظة : 
اوقات الصلاة تتم حسابتها عن طريقة معرفة موقعك الجغرافي لذلك من الممكن ان يكون هناك بعض الفروق في الوقت بزيادة دقيقة او دقيقتان او العكس
وكذلك يمكنك استخدام قاعدة البيانات للبحث عن المدينة التي تسكنها يدويا
-- عرض أتجاه القبلة
يمكنك الان معرفة اتجاه القبلة من خلال البرنامج بكل سهوله ماعليك سوى تدوير الجهاز الى أن يتغير لون موشر القبلة 
ملاحظة :
تحديد القبلة يستخدم جهاز البوصلة المضمن بالجهاز لذلك يتاثر معرفة اتجاه بتأثر بوصلة الجهاز و من العوامل الموثره في ذلك بعض المعادن الموجوده في باطن الأرض و التيار الكهربائي و كذلك الأجهزه التي تحتوي على مغناطيس وقبل البدء الرجاء تحريك الجهاز على شكل رقم ثمانية باللغة الأنجليزية
-- حصن المسلم
يمكن من خلال البرنامج البحث في حصن المسلم للمؤلف 
الشيخ الفاضل سعيد بن علي بن وهف القحطاني 
لا أريد ان اطول بالحديث ممكن اقتناء البرنامج و معرف مميزاته بنفسك
أذا فيه اي ملاحظات أو إضافتها بأمكانكم مراسلتنا مداخل التطبيق على البريد الإلكتروني أو اي وسيلة تواصل

bluejetty:00016382:ios.description:
FANTASY MANAGER SOCCER 2025/2026 SEASON – YOUR CLUB. YOUR RULES.
Step into the world of soccer greatness with Fantasy Manager Soccer 2025! Manage, train, and dominate with over 1,000 OFFICIAL PLAYERS from top football leagues worldwide: MLS, LaLiga, Serie A, Premier League, and more. Build your dream team with stars like Messi, CR7, Ronaldo, and Mbappé, and take on soccer fans from across the globe. It’s free, it’s official, and it’s your time to shine!
BUILD YOUR ULTIMATE TEAM
Scout and sign the best talent from MLS and UEFA soccer clubs like Atlanta United, LA Galaxy, Inter Miami, PSG, Juventus and Real Madrid. Train your squad, boost their stats, and create an unbeatable lineup. Whether you’re a tactical genius or a newcomer, Fantasy Manager Soccer 2025 lets you prove your skills.
COMPETE LIKE A PRO
Do you have what it takes to lead in intense competitions? Show off your football expertise in the League, where every match counts. Rise through the divisions, challenge players globally, and claim your spot as the ultimate soccer game manager.
REAL PLAYERS, REAL STRATEGY
Player performance in Fantasy Manager Soccer 2025 is tied to real-life stats, making every match realistic and thrilling. React to player form, make strategic transfers, and dominate your opponents with sharp tactics.
MULTIPLAYER MADNESS
Face off against friends or challenge thousands of football managers worldwide. Prove your dominance in Head-to-Head matches, join thrilling tournaments, and enjoy endless excitement.
EXPERIENCE THE MOST IMMERSIVE FOOTBALL MANAGER GAME
- Actual Players & Teams: Manage real players and compete with iconic football clubs.
- Strategic Gameplay: Train your team, customize your tactics, and climb the football leaderboards.
- Dynamic Challenges: Test your knowledge with ongoing updates and exciting events.
- Ultimate Control: From formations to transfers, you call the shots.
FREE TO PLAY. NO LIMITS.
Download Fantasy Manager Soccer 2025 now and lead your team to glory. The pitch is waiting – are you ready to make history?
To play this mobile football manager game you must accept the "Privacy Policy" and the "Legal Notice" you'll find in a link after the description. Fantasy Manager Soccer 2025 is FREE to download and includes optional in-game purchases. If you wish to disable in-game purchases, please turn off the in-app purchases in your phone or tablet’s Settings.
Support: support@taproomgames.zendesk.com

bluejetty:00083183:ios.description:
Join the LITT social media app for free, fetch rewards, create and share stories, your social media photos, find new friends, earn daily savings, community rewards and find great deals all in augmented reality!
• Post your photos and videos and share stories with friends
• Create social media stories and share stories in augmented reality
• Fetch rewards, local deals, daily savings and cash prizes in AR
• Fetch rewards and earn points for watching video ads and more
• Get community rewards for inviting friends and family
• Chat and message securely inside the social network
• Join groups that share your social interests
• See what’s happening near you with local events
• Get alerted when deals, offers and cash prizes are live
Get exclusive content from celebrities you follow.
Convert your points into LITT Cash to redeem and spend in partner stores (coming soon USA)
Follow your favorite local stores and never miss an opportunity to earn, fetch rewards, save and support local! (coming soon USA)
Download the social media app for free, create a profile and you’ll be on your way to creating your own journey and daily savings.
DISCOVER AND CONNECT WITH YOUR COMMUNITY
Browse the LITT social network Newsfeed to stay up to date with your friends and followers, post, chat and share AR stories, connect with local businesses and events, and discover more about your neighborhood.
GRAB BAGS OF CASH
Stay connected for exclusive cash bag giveaways. Find the rare brown bags of LITT cash on the map and tap on the bag to receive your bonus! You’ll be notified if there’s a bag near you and you have a chance to fetch rewards!
EARN REWARDS
Find the LITT blue bag on the map and earn rewards every day by watching rewardable video ads. Earn at home, on the bus, waiting room or wherever you are at any time & any place with LITT social network.
Daily Jackpots to be claimed!
SAVE ON GREAT DEALS
Big brand savings and special promotions available in AR on LITT social media network.
To find the next big deal near you,
• Open the AR Map in your LITT social network app
• Make sure you’re located in the green geo-fenced area
• Turn on permissions to find deals, zoom in and tap to view the offers
• Find the floating image in your AR camera view
• Tap the image to claim the offer
• Then redeem in store or online before the countdown timer ends
You can even share deals with friends so you can go catching together!
EARN CASHBACK REWARDS WHEN YOU SHOP (coming soon USA)
• Unlock your very own LITT Visa card to pay in-store
• Instantly earn up to 10% cash back every time you shop using LITT Pay
• Redeem your LITT Cash rewards in store next time you shop to start daily savings
• Buy e-gift cards for friends from your favorite stores on the LITT network
SPEND LOCAL WITH LITT PAY (coming soon USA)
Hundreds of stores, venues and outlets will soon accept LITT Pay. Check out the Store Locator in the app to find a LITT partner business near you. (coming soon USA)
Experience and support local like never before, discover and earn as you go while improving daily savings!
It’s a feel good, circular cash-app – growing and supporting local.
DOWNLOAD FREE
Join thousands of active LITT social network members and hundreds of local businesses now!
HAVE QUESTIONS? ASK US!
We're always happy to hear from you. If you have any feedback, or questions, please email us at support@thelittapp.com
ABOUT US
LITT is the trending social media app that lets you fetch rewards, improve daily savings and share stories and content in a safe and trusted environment. LITT social network believes in the power of positivity and AR technology to grow every community. Our mission is to connect friends and support local to help you discover your community through a safe, positive, and fulfilling process.
Find out more at thelittapp.com

bluejetty:00167470:ios.description:
With Heart Rate - Blood Pressure Log App you can effortlessly monitor, analyze, and share your data from your iOS device.
Easily take your heart rate by simply placing your finger on the camera, and keep track of your heart rate trends. Start today to make heart monitoring easier than ever and take charge of your wellbeing!
KEY BENEFITS
 • Heart Rate Measurement & Analysis - Gain detailed insights into your heart rate, allowing you to observe how it varies with different activities and emotions.
 • Blood Pressure Log - Log your systolic and diastolic blood pressure, along with your pulse (BPM).
 • Stress & Energy Tracking - Monitor your stress levels and energy throughout the day to support effective stress management and optimize your activities.
 • RMSSD & SDNN - Get a comprehensive view of your heart rate by analyzing the time between heartbeets.
 • Oxygen Level Log - Log your blood oxygen saturation to assess respiratory function and overall oxygen supply.
 • History - Review detailed history and statistics to keep tabs on your progress.
 • Sharing & Export - Quickly share or export your data as needed.
 • Daily Tracking Reminders - Stay consistent and proactive about your wellbeing with gentle daily reminders.
IMPORTANT NOTE
This app is not intended for medical use, nor to diagnose, cure, treat, or prevent any disease.
It is not classified as a medical device and is designed solely for general wellness and lifestyle insights.
This app does not directly measure blood pressure and requires an external blood pressure monitor.
Always seek professional medical advice for any health-related questions or decisions.
There is a free trial for monthly subscription for the duration of 7 days. You can cancel your free trial at any time before 24 hours prior to converting your account to a auto-renewable subscription. **Payment will be charged to your iTunes account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions will automatically renew unless auto-renew is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account will be charged for renewal, in accordance with your plan, within 24 hours prior to the end of the current period. You can manage or turn off auto-renew in your Apple ID account settings any time after purchase.*
By using the app, you are agreeing to our Privacy Policy and Terms of Use:

bluejetty:00137637:ios.description:
Leaflet helps you learn Swift/SwiftUI and Data Structure/Algorithms better.
Leaflet has four main functions:
【1】Algorithm Animation Visualization
Through exquisite and intuitive animation demos, abstract algorithms and data structures are made visual — every step of execution is clearly visible. This is the core highlight of Leaflet.
- Animation Demos: Carefully selected classic algorithms (sorting, searching, graph algorithms, dynamic programming, recursion, etc.) built with SwiftUI + Combine for smooth animations that make algorithm execution crystal clear.
- Interactive Playback: Support play, pause, step forward / step backward, and adjustable playback speed — control your learning pace freely.
- Data Structure Visualization: Arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, graphs and other data structures are presented graphically; insert, delete, and traverse operations are intuitive at a glance.
- Synchronized Code View: Animation demos are displayed alongside the corresponding Swift source code, letting you learn code while watching the animation — more efficient learning.
- Complexity Analysis: Visually shows the time / space complexity trends of algorithms, helping you build performance-analysis thinking.
Learning algorithms is no longer dry code reading, but a vivid visual experience — every algorithm becomes something you can "see and touch".
【2】Swift Tutorial
- Swift one-hour micro class, quickly master the core knowledge points of Swift grammar
- Swift5 complete tutorial covering all language features from beginner to advanced
- Swift Code Style Guide for writing more standardized code
- Swift design pattern practice
【3】Swift + SwiftUI + Combine
SwiftUI's declarative UI paired with Combine's functional reactive framework — simple to learn, high-performance, and reliable, enabling developers to quickly build elegant applications.
【4】Algorithm Solutions
Curated representative algorithm problems implemented in Swift, covering data structures and algorithm analysis to help you master algorithm complexity and performance analysis.
Part of the application is based on the open source protocol from the following open source libraries, Gratitude:
https://github.com/raywenderlich/swift-algorithm-club , Algorithms and data structures in Swift, with explanations!
https://github.com/andyRon/swift-algorithm-club-cn, swift-algorithm-club's translation. Learn algorithms and data structures using Swift.

bluejetty:00147535:ios.description:
FieldView Cab for iPad and iPhone is a simple and powerful farm management app that enables growers to collect and understand field data through rich maps and reports. It combines the best in real-time cab monitoring with simple field data analysis tools into a mobile app that benefits from the portability and connectivity of the iPad. 
FieldView Cab connects to a FieldView Drive or Precision Planting's 20/20 monitor to display real-time maps of your planter’s performance or high definition Yield maps during harvest. Shapefile maps can be imported into FieldView Cab so that any Planting, Application, Harvest, or Imported map can be viewed side by side. When not in the planter, sprayer, or combine cab field data is stored on the iPad and iPhone to enable informed field scouting. Whether at home, the office, or in the field your maps are in a single easy to browse mobile tool. 
FieldView Plus users can manage their operation remotely and stay aware of what is happening from anywhere. Maps sync between all iPads and iPhones on an account and RemoteView allows a real-time connection to any planter or combine in the field. FieldView on the web provides the grower access to maps, detailed reports, machine location, timely alerts, and the ability to easily share data with trusted advisors. 
Continued use of GPS running in the background can dramatically decrease battery charge.
Terms of Service —
https://climate.com/en-us/legal/terms-of-service.html

bluejetty:00072785:ios.summary:
UNDERSTAND YOUR PRODUCTIVITY WITH DATA-DRIVEN TRACKING
Brainway is a productivity and focus tracking app that reveals how daily habits affect performance. Get personalized insights showing how routines and lifestyle correlate with focus,
bluejetty:00072785:ios.description:
UNDERSTAND YOUR PRODUCTIVITY WITH DATA-DRIVEN TRACKING
Brainway is a productivity and focus tracking app that reveals how daily habits affect performance. Get personalized insights showing how routines and lifestyle correlate with focus, helping you overcome procrastination and optimize mental performance.
1. COMPREHENSIVE TRACKING TAILORED TO YOU
Whether battling procrastination, tracking focus, or understanding productivity drivers, Brainway adapts to your needs with quick daily logging. 
Brainway helps you: 
Discover patterns between habits and productivity 
Identify triggers impacting focus and performance 
See correlations between sleep, diet, exercise, and mental clarity 
Understand emotional roots of procrastination
2. DATA-DRIVEN INSIGHTS THAT EMPOWER
Smart analytics reveal hidden connections: 
Visual reports showing factor interactions 
Correlation tracking between focus, mood, and habits 
Pattern recognition over time 
Actionable insights to improve productivity
Track for a few weeks and know exactly what accelerates productivity and what slows you down.
3. TRACK EVERYTHING THAT MATTERS
Log your productivity data quickly and simply with highly customizable tracking:
Focus levels
Daily productivity rating 
Mood & emotions
Tasks and completion patterns
Sleep quality and patterns
Diet, water intake, and nutrition
Physical activity and exercise
Energy levels throughout the day
Habits – both productive and counterproductive
With unlimited customization, you can track any factor relevant to your productivity journey.
4. DESIGNED TO BEAT PROCRASTINATION
 Brainway addresses the emotional and psychological roots of procrastination: Understanding procrastination triggers and patterns 
Focus improvement strategies 
Time management insights Habit formation for peak performance 
Cognitive reframing techniques 
Emotional awareness building 
Pattern recognition for better decisions
5. SMART FEATURES FOR BETTER PRODUCTIVITY
Beyond tracking, Brainway offers tools to support your performance journey:
Task reminders and progress evaluation
Interactive experiments (caffeine detox, digital detox, mindfulness walks)
Procrastination-focused lessons and strategies
Personal journal for thoughts and ideas
Daily photo diary to track changes
Health notes and diary entries
Mindfulness and relaxation tools
Integration with Google Fit and Apple Health
WHY PEOPLE LOVE BRAINWAY
Reveals what affects productivity 
Simple daily logging 
Data-driven insights and correlations 
Addresses emotional procrastination triggers 
Task and focus tracking with pattern analysis 
Comprehensive customization 
Interactive habit-building experiments 
Identifies productivity pitfalls 
Optional coach support
SUBSCRIPTION PRICING & TERMS
Brainway offers flexible auto-renewing plans. Your personal productivity data is encrypted and protected. You can delete your account and all data anytime directly from within the app.
PAYMENT & RENEWAL
Download and use the app for free. Continued access requires a subscription. Payment is charged to your App Store account at confirmation of purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled 24 hours before the current period ends. You can manage or cancel your subscription anytime in account settings. Prices apply to U.S. customers; international pricing may vary. 
Contact: help@brainway.app
Privacy Policy: https://brainway.app/privacy
Terms of Use: https://brainway.app/terms
 https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
START YOUR PRODUCTIVITY JOURNEY TODAY
Download Brainway and discover how tracking focus, habits, and daily routines can help you beat procrastination, boost productivity, and achieve your goals – all backed by your own data.

bluejetty:00094123:android.summary: 🎨✨ Ever wished you could draw what you see, not just what you imagine? With AR Drawing: Trace Art App, your phone becomes a magical AR lightbox that projects any picture onto paper so you can trace, sketch and learn to draw easily – even if
bluejetty:00094123:android.description:
🎨✨ Ever wished you could draw what you see, not just what you imagine? With AR Drawing: Trace Art App, your phone becomes a magical AR lightbox that projects any picture onto paper so you can trace, sketch and learn to draw easily – even if you’re a complete beginner. Just place your phone above your notebook, look through the screen and follow the lines.
🧑🎨 What you can do with AR Drawing: Trace Art App:
- Trace with your camera by overlaying photos, characters or objects directly onto your paper and following the lines in real time
- Use built-in templates with anime, cartoons, animals, flowers, cars, people, nature and more to spark ideas instantly
- Import your own pictures from the gallery to trace favorite characters, logos, portraits or any image you love
- Practice real sketching skills and learn proportions, shapes and line flow without staring at a blank page
🖌️ Smart tools that make tracing feel natural:
- Adjust opacity so the image is comfortable to trace while still seeing your pencil lines clearly
- Zoom and move the image to focus on details or view the whole composition like a real art projector
- Rotate and flip the picture to match your drawing angle or paper position
- Optionally record your drawing process as a video so you can rewatch your progress or share satisfying sketch videos
- Enjoy a simple, clean interface designed so you can stay in the drawing flow, not get lost in settings
📖🌈 Save, share and enjoy your art:
- Save your finished drawings to your phone and build your own sketch gallery
- Share your sketches or drawing videos with friends, family or on social media
- Look back at your older drawings and see how your lines become cleaner and more confident over time
✏️💡 Perfect for:
- Complete beginners who think they “can’t draw” but want a fun, easy way to start
- Hobby artists practicing line art, poses, faces or objects from reference photos
- Students who need quick sketches for notes, design ideas or creative projects
- Parents and kids looking for a cozy, creative drawing activity to do together at home
🚀🌟 Download AR Drawing: Trace Art App now and start tracing, sketching and bringing your ideas to life on real paper with the magic of AR.

bluejetty:00019222:ios.description:
■ MazM Membership ■
If you are subscribed to MazM Membership, please log in with the same ID.
You can use all of this game's content for free.
Under the chandelier of the Paris Opera House, masked music and tragic love intertwine. In Phantom of Opera, you step into a classic tale retold as one of MazM's atmospheric story games. With expressive art, sound, and text, this visual novel guides you from the stage to the hidden lake beneath the theater as you uncover the phantom's secret.
■ Story & Genre
Phantom of Opera is based on a timeless novel, reimagined as a blend of adventure games and emotional story games. You follow singers, nobles, and the unseen genius haunting the opera through illustrated scenes presented like a visual novel. Each chapter plays like an interactive story, mixing tragic romance with suspense so that every choice feels meaningful without breaking the original mood. From the bright stage to shadowy corridors, you see different sides of the opera house in compact, chapter-based episodes that feel like reading a classic adapted for mobile.
■ Gameplay Features
Progress chapter by chapter like in visual novel games. Tap through dialogue, backgrounds, and portraits while making key decisions that can slightly change how scenes unfold. The game is built for players who prefer mobile story games and adventure games that reward attention to characters rather than fast reflexes. Collect illustrations, notes, and side episodes that expand the world of the opera and reveal more about the phantom's past, and replay chapters to revisit favorite moments or explore different routes.
■ Key Highlights
• Gothic visual novel retelling a classic opera romance and mystery.
• Character-driven storytelling for fans of emotional story games and storyline games.
• Gameplay focused on reading, route exploration, and light but meaningful choices.
• Appeals to fans of otome games, dramatic romance, and mystery adventure games.
• Immersive experience for players who enjoy narrative-driven indie games and interactive stories.
Whether you usually enjoy otome, anime games offline, or atmospheric adventure games, Phantom of Opera is designed to feel like reading a haunting stage script you can carry in your pocket. Add this story game to your collection and step behind the curtain of the opera.
■ About MazM
• MazM is a story and adventure game studio that reimagines classic novels and various works as games.
• Like the lingering emotions you feel after a memorable book, movie, or musical, we aim to deliver deep immersion and lasting impact to our players.
• Experience unique adventures through the visual novel and story game titles created by MazM.
• We will continue to craft story games that deliver unforgettable narratives and emotions.

MazM subscription begins after payment is made, and thereafter, payment is charged monthly.
There is no long-term contract or cancellation fee — you can easily cancel your subscription online at any time, 24 hours a day.
Information collected through MazM games for iOS and iPadOS is governed by the privacy policy of Growing Seeds Corporation.
If you would like to learn more about what information Growing Seeds Corporation collects in other cases (for example, when creating an account), please refer to the Growing Seeds Corporation Privacy Policy (see the link below).
Privacy Policy: https://www.storymazm.com/privacy-policy-en

- Minimalist puzzle design with no distractions
- Smooth animations and responsive controls for perfect flow
Relaxing, Stress-Free Escape
- No timers, no pressure — just your brain
- A calming offline game you can enjoy anytime
- One of the best no wifi games for free for focus and relaxation
Game Features
- Thousands of handcrafted levels with increasing complexity
- Arrow maze escape puzzle mechanics with evolving challenges
- Helpful boosters and hints when puzzles get tricky
- Works fully offline — perfect for travel and daily brain training
- A thoughtful blend of brain games, mind games, and shape escape puzzles

 Download Arrow Go! Tap to Escape now and experience one of the most satisfying arrow out–style logic puzzles available today.

Receive a visual beauty score (1–100 scale) and a 30-day improvement plan focused on skincare, style, and self-care routines.

Upload an outfit photo and get feedback on fit, proportion, and enhancements using AI.

bluejetty:00031152:ios.description:
Save The Dog: Fun Brain Games – Fun Drawing Logic Puzzle Games
Think Fast. Draw Smart. Save The Dog!
Welcome to one of the most entertaining brain games where logic meets creativity. In Save The Dog – Fun Brain Games, your mission is to protect adorable pets by drawing clever lines and shapes that stop bees, spikes, lava, and other dangers.
Can you outsmart every puzzle and keep your furry friend safe?
How to Play:
Just draw to save! Use your finger to sketch barriers and shields. Each level is a brain test — a fun, tricky logic puzzle where your drawing is the only thing between your pet and disaster.
Key Features:
1. Draw to Save:
Think outside the box and draw creative solutions to defend your dog, cat, or even cow from danger!
2. Challenging Brain Test Puzzles:
Hundreds of levels filled with logic-based puzzles and unexpected solutions — perfect for fans of logic games, puzzle games and brain teaser games.
3. Fun Animations & Reactions:
Enjoy hilarious pet animations — succeed and watch them cheer, fail and see their silly reactions!
5. Fun Puzzle Games for All Ages:
Great for kids, teens, and adults. No time limits, no pressure — just pure fun and mental training.
6. Offline & Online Play:
Play anytime, anywhere — whether you’re on the go or relaxing at home.
Why You'll Love It:
- A clever blend of brain games, fun games, and drawing puzzles.
- Builds logic, memory, and problem-solving skills in a creative way.
- Engaging levels that balance challenge and fun — never too easy, never too hard.
- Perfect for fans of Save The Dog, Draw To Save, and Brain Test, Fun Games, Puzzle Games.
Who Is This For?
- Anyone looking for fun puzzle games with a twist.
- Parents wanting safe, educational, and funny games for their kids.
- Players who love brain games and want to sharpen their mind with laughter.
Are You Smart Enough to Save Them All?
Draw the line. Use your brain. Save the dog — and other cute pets — in the most fun logic game of the year!
With Save The Dog, every level is a new adventure in thinking, creativity, and laughs.
Download Save The Dog: Fun Brain Games now and become the hero your pets need!
Your brain will love it. Your heart will thank you. And the dog? He’ll wag his tail for you!

bluejetty:00019218:ios.description:
Get ready for a colorful marble-shooting puzzle adventure packed with exciting challenges!
Aim carefully, shoot colorful marbles, create powerful matches, and clear the path before the moving chain reaches the end. Each level brings a new challenge that tests your aim, timing, and puzzle-solving skills.
Explore mysterious maps in Adventure Mode, take on challenging stages, and try to earn three stars on every level. Create bigger combos, use helpful power-ups, and improve your strategy as the difficulty increases.
Whether you want a relaxing puzzle experience or a more challenging marble-shooting adventure, there is always another level waiting for you.
HOW TO PLAY
• Aim and shoot marbles into the moving chain.
• Match 3 or more marbles of the same color to clear them.
• Tap the shooter to swap between the current and next marble.
• Create consecutive matches to build powerful combos.
• Use special power-ups at the right moment to overcome difficult levels.
• Clear the marbles before they reach the end of the path.
GAME FEATURES
• Simple controls that are easy to learn and satisfying to master.
• Colorful marble-matching puzzle gameplay.
• Multiple secret maps and unique level layouts.
• Adventure Mode and Challenge Mode to explore.
• Plenty of challenging levels with increasing difficulty.
• Aim for three stars and improve your best score.
• Powerful boosters including arrows, bombs, and other useful items.
• Create exciting combos for higher scores.
• Smooth and engaging puzzle gameplay for players of all skill levels.
Aim. Shoot. Match. Clear!
Start your marble puzzle adventure and see how many challenging levels you can complete!

bluejetty:00171672:ios.summary:

bluejetty:00171672:ios.description:
What is VRT OnDemand?
VRT OnDemand is replacing the current ValleyRide fixed route bus system. VRT OnDemand will provide better transit flexibility than a traditional fixed route bus system. You will schedule a ride, when you need it. VRT OnDemand will not run on a set schedule and will expand the current service area. You will be able to book a trip between any two existing Valley Regional Transit bus stops or any of the virtual bus stops.
How do I pay?
You can purchase a pass at any of our outlets. You can pay with cash when on the bus when you board at the fare box. You can purchase a pass through our Valley Connect mobile app. More information on fares and passes can be found online at valleyregionaltransit.org. 
How long will I wait?
The drop off window is an estimate based on your desired travel time. Because this is a ride-sharing service, actual drop-off time may vary due to demand. Please understand that while we make every effort to arrive at your desired travel time, you may have a slight wait for the VRT OnDemand due to demand. If you must arrive at your destination at a specified time, we recommend planning your trip to arrive early.
When does VRT OnDemand operate?
VRT OnDemand runs Monday through Friday. You can request a ride by downloading the mobile app or by calling the Help Desk at 208-345-743. Please visit our website for more information valleyregionaltransit.org.

bluejetty:00077026:ios.name: CHI311
bluejetty:00077026:ios.summary: See a pothole? Notice an open hydrant? Let us know. The official CHI 311 app allows residents and businesses to quickly and easily connect to Chicago city services. CHI 311 will be your first place to submit and track non-emergency service
bluejetty:00077026:ios.description:
See a pothole? Notice an open hydrant? Let us know. The official CHI 311 app allows residents and businesses to quickly and easily connect to Chicago city services. CHI 311 will be your first place to submit and track non-emergency service requests, get real-time updates, and find information on-the-go. You can also explore work being done in your area.
Sign up for your 311 account to access city services and track your requests today.
FEATURES
- Create new service requests
- Check the status of existing requests and the time it will take to resolve
- Snap a photo and submit it with a request to improve accuracy
- Map your request to help pinpoint a location
- Create an account to track your service requests and get local, relevant info
- Search and see helpful knowledge articles
- Discover requests in your neighborhood
CITY SERVICES
- Report a pothole
- Fix my streetlight
- Graffiti removal
- Rodent baiting request
- Garbage cart maintenance
- Tree trim request
- Ice/snow removal request
- No heat complaint
- Abandoned buildings
- Clean and Green program registration
- Clean a vacant lot
- Report stray animals
- Senior well-being request
- Report a building violation
Built with Chicagoans, for Chicagoans!

Welcome to VitaDock+, Medisana's latest activity and health focused mobile application! VitaDock+ app is used to synchronize, store and view general health or wellness data acquired using medisana devices with Bluetooth functionality.
Conn
bluejetty:00023032:ios.description:
Welcome to VitaDock+, Medisana's latest activity and health focused mobile application! VitaDock+ app is used to synchronize, store and view general health or wellness data acquired using medisana devices with Bluetooth functionality.
Connect your smartphone or tablet to our VitaDock® Online platform and synchronize your vital data. Establish a wireless connection to our range of Medisana® Connect-enabled devices via Bluetooth 4.0 Low Energy. VitaDock+ also integrates with the Apple Health app!
When registration of a your new account fails via the VitaDock+ app, please try to register via our website on your browser: Vitadock+ (https://cloud.vitadock.com/signup) 
Online Features:
- VitaDock® Online Synchronization
- Supports synchronization across multiple devices
- View your data also via your browser
- Integrates with Apple Health app
Activity Features:
- Your latest results at one glance
- Clearly arranged charts
- All your past achievements in table form
Weight Features:
- View your latest result in the Dashboard
- Weight Chart
- Annotate individual results
Blood Pressure & Oxygen Saturation Features
- Your blood pressure at a glance
- View your present and past BP results
- Note your mood and activity levels
Blood Glucose-Features
- New Dashboard View
- Improved Graphs
- Edit, delete results
Disclaimer: This app is intended for informational purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice. Always consult a qualified healthcare provider in addition to using this app and before making any medical decisions. The VitaDock+ app is available worldwide. Connected medical devices are intended for use only in countries or regions where they have obtained the required regulatory clearance in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.
##################### 
It is our goal to provide an app which meets your needs. Please support us improving VitaDock+. In case you have questions, ideas or are experiencing technical difficulties please contact us: 
Web: https://medisana.zendesk.com/hc/en-us
Facebook: www.facebook.com/vitadock 
Twitter: @vitadock 
Thank you very much 
#####################
Your VitaDock Team

bluejetty:00123670:ios.name: Akinator
bluejetty:00123670:ios.summary:
Akinator can read your mind just like magic and tell you what character you are thinking of, just by asking a few questions. Think of a real or fictional character and Akinator will try to guess who it is.
Will you dare challenge the genie?
bluejetty:00123670:ios.description:
Akinator can read your mind just like magic and tell you what character you are thinking of, just by asking a few questions. Think of a real or fictional character and Akinator will try to guess who it is.
Will you dare challenge the genie? And what about other themes like movies, animals…?
###NEW###
ENJOY A NEW EXPERIENCE!
Discover a redesigned genie with new emotions and fully animated.
3 ADDITIONAL THEMES BESIDES THE CHARACTERS
Akinator is getting stronger and stronger... The genie has increased his knowledge, and now you have the opportunity to also challenge him on movies, animals and objects!
Will you manage to defeat Akinator?
GO IN SEARCH FOR AKI AWARDS
The blue Genie invites you to think outside the box. As you know, he likes to guess characters and to take on difficult challenges. To do that, make him guess forgotten characters who have not been played for a very long time and you may win the best Aki Awards.
BE THE BEST PLAYER
Challenge the other players on the leaderboards to prove who the best is. You may write your name on the Last Super Awards board or on the Hall of Fame.
KEEP ON GUESSING
Each day, try to find the 5 mysterious characters and win some additional and specific Aki Awards. Complete the full Daily Challenge and earn the Gold Daily Challenge Aki Award, one of the most prestigious Aki Awards.
KEEP TRACK OF YOUR ACHIEVEMENTS
Akinator lets you create your own user account. It will record the Aki Awards you've won and your Genizs' balance. They will follow you everywhere now, even if you change your mobile device. 
PLAY MORE, WITHOUT ANY LIMITS!
THE PREMIUM POTION unlocks all characters and removes all ads from the app, to ensure you get the best gaming experience.
Main features:
-17 languages (French, English, Spanish, Portuguese, German, Japanese, Arabic, Russian, Italian, Chinese, Turkish, Korean, Hebrew, Polish, Indonesian, Vietnamese and Dutch)
-Get 3 additional themes: Movies, Animals and Objects
-Aki Awards Board to get an overview of your collection
-Hall of Fame with both current and previous ranking
-Last super awards for Black, Platinum and Gold Aki Awards
-Daily Challenges Board
-Add magic by proposing a photo or some questions
-The sensitive content filter 
---------------------------
Follow Akinator on:
Facebook @officialakinator
Twitter @akinator_team
Instagram @akinatorgenieapp
---------------------------
Genie’s tips:
-Akinator requires an Internet connection to use his magic lamp. Turn on Wifi or be sure to have a data plan.
-Don’t forget to scroll down the list to find and select your language

always save 10% on your booking, discover the latest beOne deals, find the last available rooms, manage reservations even faster, cancel free of charge until 6 pm* and carry out the Quick Check-in process directly in the app and save time at check-in. With the Mobile Key functionality, you can also use the app as a room key for many of our hotels.
Moreover, the beOne app provides information about individual hotels as well as news and travel inspiration from the Motel One universe. Thanks to the personalized "My Home" view, you have all relevant information about your next booked trip ready at a glance. Here's what awaits you:
1. Always save 10% as a beOne member when booking via the beOne app or the Motel One website
2. Receive beOne Deals: Save up to 30%, with new offers all the time

6. Verified hotel reviews
7. All information about our hotels and rooms
8. Hotel search and route planner
9. Travel tips for your trip with our Travel Compass
10. Personalized “My Home” area with all info about your trip
11. All reservations at a glance
12. Easily manage reservations
13. Book even faster with "One-Click Booking"
14. Save your reservations in Wallet
15. Check in even faster with our “Quick Check-in” process
16. Open your room door with our “Mobile Key” functionality
17. Receive push notifications for trip planning
*Does not apply during trade fairs and events.

bluejetty:00187468:ios.summary:
Every great idea starts with a single thought. And another. And then a million more. MindNode is the most delightful brainstorming app for Mac and iOS. It helps you capture your thoughts and create a clear picture of your idea.
Featured as
bluejetty:00187468:ios.description:
Every great idea starts with a single thought. And another. And then a million more. MindNode is the most delightful brainstorming app for Mac and iOS. It helps you capture your thoughts and create a clear picture of your idea.
Featured as Apple’s “App of the Day” & “Editors’ Choice”
WHAT’S ON YOUR MIND?
• Capture Your Thoughts
Whether as words, images, links, tasks, or notes, capture your thoughts in any form. Create an outline for an organized, hierarchical view, and observe how it grows as a mind map. Use the mind map to visually rearrange nodes and add new thoughts. MindNode is the right tool to get your ideas out of your head the way you want to.
• Organize Your Idea
Your document reflects your ever-changing understanding of an idea as you add and adjust thoughts. Move, tag, connect, detach, and reconnect as often as you like. Mind map and outline side-by-side. Concentrate on one thought at a time with Focus Mode, Visual Tags, and foldable branches.
• Style Your Mind Map
Personalize your document with beautiful out-of-the-box themes and custom stickers. Make your mind map look just right by styling every detail. With Smart Layout your idea will always look fantastic.
• Share Your Vision
Easily share your documents with others or move them one step further in your creative process. Send tasks to Apple Reminders, Things, or OmniFocus. Export your idea as text, image, and to many other file formats.
STAY PRODUCTIVE WHEREVER YOU GO
Whether it’s on your iPhone, iPad, or Mac, with MindNode, you stay productive wherever you are. Store your files on iCloud Drive and access them on all your devices.
FREE EDITOR
Use MindNode for free to capture your ideas with actions like editing, rearranging, and folding nodes, as well as importing and exporting files.
• Capture: grow your thoughts into fully-fledged ideas
• Fold branches: keep your documents organized
• Import: FreeMind, MindManager, iThoughts, plain text, RTF, CSV, OPML, Markdown, TextBundle
• Export: plain text, RTF, CSV, OPML, PDF, PNG image, Markdown, TextBundle, TaskPaper, FreeMind
MINDNODE PLUS
MindNode Plus is a cross-platform subscription for your iPhone, iPad, and Mac. It unlocks all of MindNode’s features like Outlining, Visual Tags, Focus Mode, Notes, Themes, Stickers, Connections, and much more. MindNode Plus is available as a monthly and a yearly subscription. Try out all of MindNode’s features with a free 14-day trial.
• Collect everything: add text, images, and links to nodes
• Outlining: create your document using a hierarchical, organized approach
• Visual Tags: tag your thoughts for more context, highlight tags to see new relationships
• Notes: keep your mind map easy to read without losing a single detail
• Connections: connect nodes on different branches
• Tasks: turn your thoughts into actions
• Quick Entry: just start typing to collect thoughts
• Themes: beautiful out-of-the-box themes and unlimited personal themes
• Images: insert your own images and annotate them
• Stickers: 260+ hand-crafted stickers with adjustable colors
• Styling: rich styling options for every single part of your mind map
• Layouts: top-down and horizontal
• Focus Mode: put a spotlight on a single branch
• Dark Mode: for when your thoughts come at night
• Share Tasks: to Apple Reminders, Things, and OmniFocus
WHAT OTHERS SAY ABOUT MINDNODE
“The app keeps out of your way, so it doesn’t interrupt your thought processes.”
– New York Times
“An app on the cutting edge of iOS design and technologies.”
– MacStories
“Slowly grow and track your ideas, connecting nodes to help you better conceptualize your idea or thoughts.”
– BusinessInsider
QUESTIONS?
Reach out to us at support@mindnode.com and on Twitter (@mindnode). Let us know if you have any questions or issues. We’re always glad to help.
Terms of Service: https://mindnode.com/terms

Convenient. Effective. Simple. Fun.

bluejetty:00169048:ios.description:
Convenient. Effective. Simple. Fun. 
Workouts you can do anywhere, anytime—no matter your fitness level. New daily workouts and 60+ extra programs that are customizable for your equipment, time, and fitness level. Got 20 minutes and a pair of dumbbells? You’re set. More time or gear? We’ve got options for that too. Build consistency and confidence with support from expert coaches and a worldwide community. 
WHAT’S INCLUDED:
DAILY WORKOUTS - Options vary based on the equipment found in each workout: Program A (bodyweight/dumbbell), Program B (barbell), Program C (access to more - such as sandbag, bike, rower) and SHIFT - the simplified version and a great place to start for those new to this style of training, those returning from illness/injury, for pregnant/postpartum mamas, seniors, and even kids.
60 + EXTRA PROGRAMS - Available if you want to focus on developing a specific skill, type of training, or simply for additional variety on a weekly basis. Options include Strength programs, Sandbag workouts, Olympic lifting sessions, Bodybuilding sessions, Military Test Prep training, Endurance, Rowing, 5k and Half Marathon training, No Equipment workouts, and skill development such as Pull Up programs, Push Up programs and so much more.
COACHING GUIDANCE - Each daily workout and program has their own demo video, coaches’ notes and movement customizations to help you make the program work for your time, equipment or ability.
TOOLS TO TRACK YOUR PROGRESS - Use your personal logbook to track your progress and start collecting badges in your Trophy Case because who says building consistency can’t also be FUN?
NUTRITION RESOURCES - Get the tools and support you need to build simple, sustainable nutrition habits. You'll have ongoing access to our Nutrition Coaches and team, plus:
The option to purchase a 30-day self-guided nutrition program (available at an additional cost)
A comprehensive nutrition blog packed with education, tips, and video resources
A growing collection of weekly recipes
Opportunities to join nutrition challenges and focus groups throughout the year, supported by the SP Community
MAINTENANCE & RECOVERY - Easy to follow yoga flow videos that target specific needs and areas of the body, ranging from 5-25 minutes in length that you can do anytime you want to mobilize, stretch or refresh mentally and physically.
SUPPORTIVE COMMUNITY - Access to the Street Parking Coaches and staff and a member community like none other. Whether it’s about the motivation of seeing someone just like yourself building habits and overcoming obstacles or finding connection that feels like family, the Street Parking community will help fuel your consistency.
Privacy Policy: https://streetparking.com/pages/general-terms-conditions
Terms and Conditions : https://streetparking.com/pages/general-terms-conditions
Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

bluejetty:00070584:ios.description: Welcome to Universe Gravity Simulator 3D, where the cosmos is your playground! This universe sandbox is the ultimate outer space game, combining elements of arcade games, alien shooter missions, and gravity-defying fun. Whether you're a casual gamer or a dedicated space enthusiast, this game will pull you in with its realistic simulation of outer planets, star realms, and intergalactic battles. If you've ever wondered what it feels like to be a planet creator or a planet destroyer, this solar system game puts the power of the universe in your hands!Imagine the thrill of building and shaping entire galaxies, adjusting orbits, growing stars, and watching your solar system evolve. But it's not just about creation—Universe Gravity Simulator 3D lets you engage in galaxy attacks, destroy planets, and even wipe out stars. You’ll command your own space force as you fight to protect your Earth, while also facing off against alien invaders in intense battles inspired by arcade classics like space invaders and galaxy attack. As you play, you’ll discover stars, tweak gravitational forces, and even set up interplanetary collisions, all in the name of fun.Have you ever stargazed and wondered what it would be like to explore Venus, Mars, or the outer reaches of the solar system? Or maybe you've daydreamed of being an astronaut, hurtling through the galaxy in a powerful spaceship, fighting off space invaders in a heroic space battle? Universe Gravity Simulator 3D allows you to explore all of these possibilities and more. The stunning visuals will transport you to far-off star realms where your spaceship sim becomes more than just a game—it's a journey through space and time, a space odyssey that blurs the lines between play and exploration. Game Features: • Realistic physics engine and mechanics. • Dynamic universe creation and amazing phenomenon. • Immersive 3D environments and stunning graphics. • Gravity simulator with solar systems to discover. • Interactive journal to track your universe simulator 3D. • Embark on a journey through space, where you can craft your own universe within a universe sandbox, explore the solar system simulator, and experiment with the laws of physics in a space sandbox. • With Universe Space Simulator, the cosmos is at your fingertips—ready to be shaped, explored, and understood How to Play:• Discover Sandbox Planets, design and create your own solar system, galaxy, universe, and space, and enjoy watching them orbit,• collide, and interact in a cosmic dance in your space sandbox.• Start with a small asteroid absorbing other asteroids to form a solar system.• Adjust the galaxy speed as you like it most. Explore how life develops in your solar system through the planet journal.• Screenshot your complete galaxy with stars and share it with family/friends.Universe Gravity Simulator 3D offers endless possibilities for fans of outer space games, whether you're into astronomy games, arcade action, or stargazing in a planetarium 3D environment. Dive into this expansive solar system game, harness gravity, and become the ultimate master of the universe!

The Battle of Polytopia is an award winning and unique turn based strategy game about controlling the map, fighting enemy tribes, discovering new lands and mastering new technologies.  
You take on the role as the ruler of a tribe and attempt to build a civilization in a turn based competition with the other tribes. It can be played offline. Perfect for traveling.

* Auto generated maps make each game a new experience.
* Allow offline game play.
* Gameplay in portrait and landscape mode.
* Online multiplayer and Pass & Play.
* Leader board with top scores for the best civilization builders.
* Really cute low poly graphics.

bluejetty:00070476:ios.summary:
Can you see what’s hiding? 
Think you’re smart? Then delete one part.

bluejetty:00070476:ios.description:
Can you see what’s hiding? 
Think you’re smart? Then delete one part.
Playing is easy! Just touch the screen and drag your finger to erase part of the drawing and see what lies behind it. The game may seem simple, but looks can be deceiving...
Like a detective’s magnifying glass, your eraser is the key to unraveling the hidden mysteries of this thinking game. You will have to become a shrewd sleuth and investigate the pictures carefully to locate clues. But you can never be sure what kind of surprises you’re going to find under the surface
Engage your brain, your imagination and your artistic talents to identify the missing element and add it to the drawing in this delightful puzzle game that will get you thinking and make you smile.
Let your imagination run wild! Will the criminal succeed in robbing a bank, or will the police catch him first? What is the wife hiding from her husband
And that’s just the tip of the iceberg! Free a genie from an ancient forgotten lamp, sculpt pottery, and catch a villainous murderer — and that’s all just in the first 30 levels!
Make the most of your free time by playing an engaging brain game that will sharpen your wit. With DOP 5, you can chill out and get smarter at the same time! Level up your brain while you level up in the game!
*** HOW TO PLAY ***
Jump right into the simple and straightforward gameplay of this thinking game: just swipe your finger across your phone screen to erase parts of the drawing and reveal what’s underneath. The mechanics may be easy, but the puzzles will keep your brain guessing!
- Investigate hundreds of entertaining levels chock-full of tricky brain teasers. No two puzzles are the same! Each level stimulates your brain to approach a problem in a new way.
- Discover the unexpected twists hiding behind every image! Each stroke of your eraser will uncover a new, deeper layer to the story depicted in the drawing. Only you can make the invisible visible!
- Enjoy the delightful graphics with their unique cartoon style and cute animations.
- Provides hours of fun for teens, seniors, and anyone in between who wants to keep their brain sharp!
- The optional music, sound effects, and vibration settings give you more control over your gameplay experience.
You can play it anytime, anywhere. Don't need internet connection, you can play it all time.

CREATE STORIES AND EXPLORE A BIG DOLLHOUSE!

MY TOWN – START NEW ADVENTURE

The My Town Games studio designs digital dollhouse-like games that promote creativity and open-ended play for your children worldwide. bluejetty:00159094:ios.description:
Cleaner Booster is a mobile phone cleaner specifically for iPhone users. It currently supports similar photo cleaning, video cleaning, address book contact cleaning, calendar schedule cleaning, and screenshot cleaning. In addition, we also support user speed measurement, query current IP address, check battery health, etc. It is rich in functions and is a good helper for your iPhone.
Cleaner Booster functions and features:
1. Statistics of remaining storage space of the mobile phone
2. Image cleaning, similar pictures, screenshots, ID photos, and all photos can be cleaned
3. Video cleaning: support cleaning all videos in the mobile phone
4. Address book contact cleaning: support batch deletion of contacts
5. Schedule cleaning: support batch deletion of schedule information
6. Speed measurement: measure the user's current upload and download speed
7. Map and IP address: detect the user's current IP address and map 
8. Battery health: obtain the user's current battery status and provide scientific knowledge on battery use
9. Zero log: We will strictly implement the zero log policy to absolutely protect the privacy of users
Purchases & Subscriptions
Cleaner Booster offers in-app purchases, including weekly and monthly subscriptions. You can unlock premium features by subscribing to in-app purchases: $0.99 per week or $2.99 per month. Subscriptions automatically renew weekly/monthly. Cleaner Booster's in-app payments are processed by Apple through the App Store system; we do not have access to your complete payment card information. We may obtain necessary transaction-related information from Apple (such as subscription type, subscription status, expiration date, transaction identifier, etc.), but only for subscription verification, enabling and maintaining related features, and for compliance statistics and service optimization. You can manage or cancel your subscription in your device's Settings > Account > Subscriptions. Refunds and billing disputes will be handled according to App Store policies.
Privacy Policy: https://yhsm.cleanboosteryk.com/privacyPolicy.html
Terms of Service: https://yhsm.cleanboosteryk.com/termsOfService.html

bluejetty:00192690:android.description:
"Leveraging their deep experience and talented developers, Highbrow Interactive 
 delivers an in-depth and feature-rich sim game that you’ll enjoy again and again." – AndroidAppsReview.com
The long-awaited Indian Bus Simulator is another rich and detailed offering from the stable of Highbrow Interactive. After dominating the world of mobile train simulation for years, Highbrow has set its eyes on the genre of bus driving games - bringing to the table all the little quirks that helped amass millions of fans for Indian Train Simulator. 
Indian Bus Simulator, or IBS, is an open-world, driver-based game that is released with a route connecting the South Indian cities of Chennai and Bangalore. The game features buses from State-run transport organizations of Tamil Nadu and Karnataka, plus a fleet of buses from Private Operators built in their likeness. The design of the bus is inspired by the authentic vehicles that are currently on the market.

bluejetty:00173612:ios.summary: Trusted by millions of iOS users around the world and hailed by meteorology fans, Weather 14 Days is the official free App from Meteored. Fully optimized for iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and watchOS 26, the app is available for iPhone, iPad and Apple
bluejetty:00173612:ios.description:
Trusted by millions of iOS users around the world and hailed by meteorology fans, Weather 14 Days is the official free App from Meteored. Fully optimized for iOS 26, iPadOS 26 and watchOS 26, the app is available for iPhone, iPad and Apple Watch. Featuring its own forecasts produced and weather alerts, using the best prediction model in the world. You will have an accurate weather forecast and you can enjoy a modern and original layout based around Material Design to access detailed and highly accurate local weather data quicker and easier than ever before. With over 20 years of forecasting experience, we won't let the weather surprise you.
- ALERTS AND NOTIFICATIONS -
Receive Official Weather Warnings from NOAA (National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration) for your location live thanks to our notifications and daily alerts. We send alerts about any weather phenomenon: rain, storms, temperatures, wind, hurricanes, and tropical storms, as well as severe weather forecasts.
- REALTIME RADAR, FORECAST MAPS AND SATELLITES -
Now available! A new animated world forecast map based on the ECMWF showing the weather forecast for the coming days. Enjoy our live radar service and also our hurricane tracker and storm, access animated weather radar of the last few hours provided by the NWS along with visible, infrared and water vapor satellite images provided by NOAA.
- WEATHER NEWS -
Check the new section of our news to be up to date of the latest weather events. Be informed about trending topics and the most recent forecast. You will learn about the weather phenomena thanks to our science articles, made by our experts in meteorology.
- WEATHER VIDEOS -
Discover videos of impactful weather phenomena, along with exclusive scientific content to help you understand the atmosphere and the weather.
- WEATHER FORECAST -
Check the current conditions along with the forecast for the next 14 days with a simple slide of your finger. Select a day to view detailed hourly information including heat index or temperature, precipitation, wind speed and direction, wind chill, pressure, cloudiness, humidity, UV index, sunset and sunrise times and even the phase of the moon. Turn your device sideways to see how the weather local will evolve throughout the day with our amazing graphics.
- WIDGETS -
Use our widget to see at a glance the current time and detailed summary of the week in your favorite city.
- SHARE -
Share weather forecasts with your friends and family anytime you want with whatever device or social network you like to use such as: WhatsApp, Twitter or Facebook.
- AVAILABILITY -
Find the forecast most relevant to your exact current position or search for your favorite locations from over 6,000,000 all around the world. Available in over 110 countries and 50 languages.

https://testflight.apple.com/join/ZlUMBitu
To use this app you must agree to the privacy policy, as well as the terms and conditions of Meteored.
- Privacy Policy:
https://www.theweather.com/privacy.html
- Legal notice:
https://www.theweather.com/legal_notice.html

Getting started in weight training can be intimidating, but it shouldn't and it won't be with Zen Labs Fitness. There are many flavors of 3x5, 5x5, and other variations. 
At the very core of the these lifting programs, they share the same proven elements. Results have been proven time and time again for the past decades since the original 5x5 by Mark Berry in the 1930s, Reg Park in the 1950s, Bill Starr in the 1970s, and the many versions you see today.

◉ Accessory workouts to add more volume for advanced users
◉ HealthKit integration

◉ Award winning music curated from top DJ's!

◉ Unlimited access to all pro features across ALL Zen Labs Fitness apps

bluejetty:00174848:ios.description:
Check UV before you head out.
UV Index provides real-time UV index data for your current location. 
Powered by ozone data from NASA/OMI satellites and research institutes KNMI and NIWA, it tells you exactly how much UV radiation is hitting your skin right now.
UVA and UVB rays are a leading cause of skin aging and dark spots — even on cloudy days and in the shade.
[Features]
• Intuitive meter-style UV index display
• Hourly UV forecast graph to track UV levels throughout the day
• Peak UV index and timing alerts
• Level-based recommendations (protection gear, SPF/PA, sunburn time)
• Apple Health integration — automatically saves UV data to your health records
• Retro pixel theme
• Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets, including StandBy and Smart Stack
[PRO]
Enjoy an ad-free experience and the retro theme with an in-app purchase. 
If you purchased UVmeter before August 28, 2024, tap "Restore Purchases" to reclaim PRO for free.

 - Your personal rate of return

 - Future contribution allocations
 - View outstanding loans and recent withdrawals
Make changes to your account, as allowed by your plan: 
 - Exchange between funds
 - Rebalance your account
 - Adjust future contribution allocations
 - Update your address, phone and e-mail address
Since 1931, Capital Group, home of American Funds, has helped investors pursue long-term investment success.

bluejetty:00136857:ios.description:
OFFICIAL VLAD AND NIKI APP: GAMES, VIDEOS, SELFIE VIDEOS AND AI CALLS
Step into the world of Vlad and Niki, the YouTube stars loved by millions of families. All official episodes, exclusive videos, learning games, personal selfie videos and real AI conversations with the boys live in one safe kids app for children ages 2 to 6.
SAY CHEESE WITH VLAD AND NIKI: MAKE YOUR OWN SELFIE VIDEO
Create your own selfie video with Vlad and Niki! Upload a photo, pick a fun story, and your child stars in an exclusive video right next to the boys. Friends will want one too.
- Pick from a growing set of funny stories and adventures
- Your child becomes part of the show, not just a viewer
- Save the finished video and share it with family
CALL VLAD OR NIKI: THE LIVE AI CALL KIDS DREAM ABOUT
Your child can call Vlad or Niki and chat with them like real friends. The boys answer questions, tell stories and keep the conversation going on any topic. Every AI call is private, age appropriate and built to grow vocabulary, speech development and communication skills, all through play.
WATCH A HUGE VIDEO LIBRARY
- The most complete collection of Vlad and Niki episodes from YouTube
- Exclusive videos for kids you will not find anywhere else
- Funny adventures about cars, superheroes, ice cream, cooking, shopping and the supermarket
- Kids TV mode: run episodes back to back and use the device as a portable TV
- Offline mode: download videos and watch without Wi-Fi, perfect for flights and road trips
PLAY MINI GAMES WITH THE BOYS
- Car games and toddler racing: drive, park and win with Vlad and Niki
- Cooking games: make pizza and ice cream just like in the show
- Supermarket and shopping games: an educational grocery shopping adventure
- Superhero games: help the brothers save the day
- Coloring, puzzles, matching games and match shapes activities made for little hands
- New interactive games added regularly
LEARN WHILE PLAYING
Vlad and Niki speak easy English that children of any age understand. Watching and playing together supports learning English, first vocabulary, colors and shapes, cognitive skills, creative skills and social skills for kids. It is a joyful educational app experience for toddlers and preschool kids, with no pressure, just play.
MADE FOR PARENTS' PEACE OF MIND
- A safe kids app: curated, age appropriate content only, no external links
- Simple controls that toddlers can manage on their own
- Photos uploaded for selfie videos are used only to create your video
- Ad-free experience with Fun Pass
FUN PASS SUBSCRIPTION
Try the app for free with a selection of videos and mini games. Fun Pass unlocks everything: the full video library, all games, selfie videos, offline downloads, coins for AI calls with Vlad and Niki, weekly new content and an ad-free environment. Weekly, monthly, annual and forever plans are available.
BEST ON iPAD
All games and videos are fully adapted for tablets and look great on iPad.
Download the official Vlad and Niki app and turn screen time into a safe, interactive playground where your child can watch, play, talk, star in their own video and grow with their favorite YouTube heroes!
