bluejetty:00065872:ios.description:
***Over 1+ Million Downloads!*** Merry Christmas!! Come play at the Christmas makeover party! Decorate with the Santa and the Ice Princess, put on makeup with the beautiful ice princess, go face-painting, listen to Christmas music and much more!! Have fun!
Level 1: Princess makeover room. Help do hair-coloring, make-up, icy designs and much more!
Level 2: Ho-Ho-Ho!! Decorate the Christmas tree and give Santa milk & chocolate chip cookies! Yum!
Level 3: Build a Snowman! Add carrot for the nose, top hat, wooden sticks for arms and more!
Level 4: Get Santa ready for Christmas! Clean-up, sewing the ripped Santa outfit, comb Santa's hair and much more!
Level 5: Face-painting room! Choose from your favorite holiday designs!
Level 6: Help the green elf get ready in time for Christmas and look their best!
Level 7: Care for the baby. Give milk, play with the mobile, toy doll and much more!
Level 8: Choose your style! Christmas tree, reindeer, gingerbread and more!
Level 9: Wedding Salon! A Frosty celebration!
Level 10: Play at the Christmas party room! Eat candy canes, clean-up from the snow, decorate the room and much more!
*Level 11: Play at the Christmas Salon! Eat holiday snacks and take a group photo for Christmas!
*Level 12: Help Santa's helper with a new makeover!
*Level 13: Santa needs you to help at the spa. Comb hair, clean-up and much more!
*Level 14: Put make-up on another snow friend!!
*Level 15: The winter ice princess needs your help at the frosty spa. Get ready for a makeover!
*Level 16: Ice Princess Makeover! Create the best ice princess with face-paint, make-up and cool earrings.
*Level 17: Let's play with the elf. Clean-up and dry off using the towel.
*Level 18: Red nose reindeer makeover! Decorate with antlers, Santa hat, sparkles and more!
*Level 19: Santa is ready for Christmas!! Prepare the holiday gifts and don't forget Santa's glasses!
*Please note that levels 11-19 must be purchased separately.
*Please note that Christmas Party Salon is free to play, but you are able to purchase game items with real money. If you don’t want to use this feature, please disable in-app purchases.*

bluejetty:00094930:ios.name: Mind Echoes: Remnants of Past
bluejetty:00094930:ios.summary: The reenactment just got too real. In "Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past", the boundary between the present and a forgotten kingdom begins to fracture. Join a story-driven hidden object games journey where you’ll solve mystery games, battle
bluejetty:00094930:ios.description:
The reenactment just got too real. In "Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past", the boundary between the present and a forgotten kingdom begins to fracture. Join a story-driven hidden object games journey where you’ll solve mystery games, battle time itself, and unravel a lost mystery tied to a vengeful ghost knight. With danger lurking in both past and present, your only tools are your mind, your instincts, and your ability to find hidden objects in even the most treacherous corners. This is detective games storytelling at its finest—where your choices decide whether history will rest in peace or rise in anger!
Majestic castles, noble knights, and bustling markets - the medieval park promises an immersive experience. But when tourists start disappearing under unexplained circumstances, it becomes clear: this is more than just a reenactment. A dying man’s final words speak of a ghostly knight, and a chilling video recording captures something that shouldn't exist. As you investigate, a forgotten kingdom begins to emerge, frozen in time, its spectral inhabitants unaware that their era has long passed. But the moment you step too far, they see you not as a visitor, but as a threat. The knight is already hunting, sworn to protect his king from the enemy. You are their only hope for peace… or their next victim.
· Investigate a Fractured Reality!
Explore immersive environments across two timelines and take part in the atmospheric detective games. Engage with hidden object games involving a lost mystery, and step into the shoes of a true investigator as you find hidden objects, question ghostly witnesses, and connect eerie clues!
· Solve Puzzles & Mini-Games!
Get ready to challenge your mind with intricate puzzles and logic-based tasks crafted for those who love to solve mystery games and find hidden objects. From cryptic rune-based locks to unsolved mysteries games, every step forward is a test of wit and observation!
· Breathtaking, Haunted Locations!
Roam through eerily realistic environments and find hidden objects buried in shadow and deception. Each scene is crafted with obsessive detail, making it a dream for fans of hidden object games. Piece together fragments of the past, inching closer to solving the lost mystery at the heart of it all!
· Collect artifacts & unlock achievements!
Earn trophies, complete collections, and discover hidden lore that expands the chilling backstory. Designed for fans of detective games and hidden object games alike, every collectible brings you closer to solving the lost mystery and finding peace for the restless souls trapped in time!
Master the art of observation in the free trial of "Mind Echoes: Remnants of the Past"!
-----
Questions? Email us at support@dominigames.com
Find other games on our official website: https://dominigames.com/
Become our fan on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/dominigames
Check out our Instagram and stay tuned: https://www.instagram.com/dominigames

bluejetty:00023712:ios.description:
Design luxury outfits and amazing looks for a superstar family of 4 gorgeous virtual models on the same screen! Each character have their own wardrobe with 200+ items of apparel, makeup and accessories. Add cute pets, fireworks and various cool stickers to get the final picture ready for a photo album. Grab a screenshot by pressing the "Camera" button inside the game and share the picture with your friends and family online to show off your fashionista talents.
Pick one of 8 backgrounds which set the context: a shopping run across a boutique street in downtown, a red carpet walk, a photo session in a studio, a mansion (interior and exterior), a living room of a castle, a picnic in the park, and an oriental palace.

You can customize literally everything: from eyes shape and iris color to dresses to glam accessories like Swiss hand watches or golden necklaces. Who are these dolls: movie stars, famous supermodels from a glam magazine cover, Internet celebrities, prince and princess, theater actors and actresses, rich business people or something else? You decide by designing an appropriate outfit, picking a hairstyle and rounding up the image with stylish accessories. E.g. the mom could be a top model, the dad an actor, and the kids each go to an elite private school with their personal driver and a bodyguard.
For Muslim players, there is a selection of hijabs, female Muslim dresses and male costumes.

bluejetty:00124166:ios.description:
Turn your city into a game.
Questo is an outdoor escape game, scavenger hunt, and self-guided walking tour in one app. Over 1 million players. Rated 4.7 stars. Playable in 1,000+ cities worldwide.
Need a date-night idea, a weekend activity with the kids, or a fresh way to see a city you love? Put the phone between you and the streets, and the real world becomes your playground.
TWO WAYS TO PLAY
1. Outdoor escape games (for locals)
Spontaneous adventures in your own city. Like an escape room, but outdoors.
• For couples: "Murder Mystery: Crime on Date Night." Skip dinner and a movie and team up to catch a killer.
• For families: "Kid Quest," made for ages 4 to 8. Walk the park, solve easy riddles, take photos together.
• For friends: race to crack the case before time runs out.
2. Story-driven tours (for travelers)
Don't just look at landmarks. Step into the story behind them. Local writers turn history and legend into walking games.
• New York: "Hamilton." London: "Jack the Ripper." Zurich: "Einstein." Paris: "Lost Lovers in Montmartre."
• And new adventures: "Murder Mystery Zodiac," "The 9 Lives Heist," and "The Lost Gold."
MORE THAN READING, IT'S PLAYING
Questo isn't a text walk. It's interactive.
• Puzzles that use your phone and your senses, like blowing on the screen to clear the dust and reveal the next clue.
• Video woven into the story, so you watch history come alive instead of just reading about it.
• Time Rifts: see how the place you're standing looked centuries ago.
• Every quest reshapes the app to match its world.
PLAY TOGETHER
• Co-op: share one phone and solve as a team.
• Versus: split into teams and race. The leaderboard shows who's fastest.
• Crews: join or start a group, play together, and compete for the top spot.
KEEP THE MEMORIES
• Memories: after you finish, re-read every story and relive the quest.
• Explorer Photos: see real photos from other players, and share your own.
PLAY IN YOUR LANGUAGE
Quests in multiple languages, many with an audio version so you can listen as you walk.
HOW IT WORKS
Download and browse the map to find a game near you.
Head to the starting point. No schedule, start whenever your group is ready.
Use the statues, buildings, and street art around you to solve riddles and unlock the next part of the story.
WHY QUESTO
• Real connection: put the screens down and be with the people around you.
• Budget friendly: far less than an escape room or a guided tour.
• Flexible: pause for lunch or a coffee anytime.
• Gift it: buy a quest for someone you love.
Ready to play? Download Questo and turn your next walk into an adventure.

bluejetty:00162568:ios.description:
myCWT the mobile travel app for travelers and travel arrangers. 
Plan, book and manage your flight, hotel, car rental and train bookings all in one place. Get real-time alerts on updated flight changes, weather conditions, safety alerts and more. Automatically sync your travel itinerary into your calendar and your meetings into the app. Quickly and conveniently chat with a CWT travel counselor for all your travel-related needs.
Use the myCWT app to:
• Book, modify and cancel company-preferred hotels, flights, car rentals or train reservations
• Quickly rebook past trips
• View an estimate of your carbon emissions when booking to make the most sustainable choices
• Check in directly from the app on over 250 airlines
• Add loyalty program information to your travel profile to auto-populate into all reservations
• Sync all elements of your travel itinerary into your calendar
• Share your itinerary with colleagues or join a trip they’ve already booked
• Obtain real-time trip notifications including cancellations, delays, gate assignment, baggage claim
• Itinerary specific safety alerts, find destination-related health and well-being information and check-in during a major incident
• 24/7 chat support with CWT’s messaging service

bluejetty:00021704:ios.description:
The ultimate restaurant booking app for foodies. Download Quandoo for fast, easy, online restaurant reservations. Ready to find and book your next dinner in seconds?
Millions of reservations. Thousands of restaurants. Zero time wasted in long queues. 
How does Quandoo work?
- Find restaurants nearby or set filters to match your budget, craving, or foodie review score
- Book a table with a few taps (you can even take a peek at the menu, photos, and reviews before you book)
Michelin-star restaurants, casual pizza spots, cosy cafes, cool cocktail bars - you name it, Quandoo's got it. Save time by booking a table in seconds with the free Quandoo app. 
Perfect as a restaurant finder for city trips, business travel, and making the best dinner reservations in town. It's really that easy! And don't worry, if something comes up, you can edit or change your reservation in the app too. 
Tired of wasting time on hold and struggling to find a table at your favourite restaurants? Make a restaurant reservation at the top spots in your city, in seconds, with Quandoo. Easily filter by price, review score, and location to find and book a table at the perfect restaurant for every occasion, from a romantic candlelit dinner to a fun-packed meal out with friends.
What do foodies have to say about Quandoo?
"Super practical and fast to reserve a table. Also great for keeping track of where you ate in what city!" 
-LauraSennica
"I've had this app for years and it keeps getting better. I've never once had a problem getting a table." 
-HoTTo
Focus on the flavours and not the logistics of getting a table, especially in a new city. Save time, skip the phone calls, and dine out like a local with Quandoo's easy-to-use app. 
Want to take a peek at the menu, real photos, and foodie reviews before you book? It's all possible without leaving Quandoo, making it quick and easy to book your next dinner with confidence. Whether you want a 5-star dinner booking in Helsinki or a fast online reservation for burgers and brews with friends in London, Quandoo's got you covered. 
What do foodies love most about booking a table with Quandoo?
- Price, location, and review score filters that are easy to use
- View the menu before you book, so you can satisfy the pickiest eaters
- No phone calls! Just one app and a few seconds
Don't stress about finding the perfect dinner, just use Quandoo's filters and watch your ideal dinner restaurants pop up so you can easily book a table. 
Quandoo is currently available in 11 countries around the world:
Australia
Singapore
The United Kingdom
Germany
Austria
Italy
Finland
Turkey
Switzerland
The Netherlands
New Zealand
Quandoo makes it easy to find, book, eat, and repeat.

We are happy to release our free **Nithra Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027 Offline App**. Now, the **Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027** app has been entirely updated with all the information like 2026 & 2027 Calendar, Rasipalan, Holidays, Festivals, Subha Muhurtham and much more.
**Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027** is a completely free app that is available in offline mode. Users can view complete details of the Daily Calendar as well as Monthly Calendar in Tamil.
In the offline day view, you can view and share information like auspicious days, Tamil Panchangam 2026 & 2027, Nalla Neram, Raagukaalam, Yamagandam, Kuligai, Tamil Raasipalan, Thithi, Yogam, Natchathiram, Chandrashtamam, Special Events, Quotes and Birthdays for the day. You can also view Mel Nokku Naal, Keel Nokku Naal and Sama Nokku Naal in the offline day view.
The offline monthly view displays all the important information for the particular month, including Viratha Dhinankal such as Subha Muhurtham, Amavasai, Pournami, Pradosham, Karthigai, Ekadasi, Chaturthi, Sasti, Thiruvonam, Sangadahara Chaturthi and Sivarathiri. It also provides Festival days including Hindu, Muslim and Christian festivals, Government holidays and other important events.
The **Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027** app works on all types of iOS devices.
### Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027 Features:
1. Nithra **Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027 Offline** app consists of details for the entire years 2026 and 2027, with Daily and Monthly views.
2. **Jothidar Pathilkal:** Get answers and solutions for astrology-related questions and problems from Nithra Jothidar.
3. **Holiday List:** Hindu festival days, Christian festival days, Muslim festival days and Government holidays are available in this free Nithra Tamil Calendar app.
4. **Tamil Panchangam:** Tamil Panchangam, Subha Muhurtham days and fasting days for 2026 and 2027 are shown month-wise in this offline app.
5. **Daily Information:** View and share auspicious days, Rahukaalam, Yamagandam, Kuligai and Rasipalan details of the day.
6. **Rasipalan:** Get Daily, Weekly, Monthly and Yearly Rasipalan details.
7. **Gowri Panchagam & Vasthu:** Gowri Panchagam, Gowri Nalla Neram and Vasthu Natkal are available in the Tamil Calendar app.
8. **To-Do List & Reminders:** Add your day-to-day tasks to Notes and set reminders to help you remember important activities.
9. **Previous Notifications:** View old notification posts easily with a single-click option.
10. **Daily Alerts:** Get daily alerts with complete details about the next day and plan your activities accordingly.
11. **User-Friendly Design:** Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027 comes with a simple, user-friendly interface and well-designed UI for easy navigation.
12. **Offline Access:** Access important calendar and astrology information anytime without an internet connection.
13. **2026 & 2027 Calendar:** View complete Tamil calendar information for both 2026 and 2027 in one app.
Download the free **Nithra Tamil Calendar 2026 & 2027 Offline App** and stay updated with Tamil calendar dates, festivals, holidays, astrology information, Panchangam, auspicious days and other important details throughout the year.

Enjoy the best from your neighborhood: meals, groceries, and fresh essentials delivered to your door. From a freshly baked pizza to a freshly picked lettuce, we have something for every need.

"Simply put: there is no better way to manage your personal finances than what Crew has built." -Spencer (Crew user since 2025)
Crew lets you experience the difference between following a budget and leading a budget. Instead of an app telling you what to do with your money, you tell the app what to do — and it keeps doing what it’s supposed to even on nights, weekends, holidays, or when your blood sugar is low. 
With Crew you can:
- organize your money into pockets
- link pockets to your cards for mindful, intentional spending
- use Autopilot to program your budget
- add your partner and children to your financial plans
Most budgeting apps stand on the sidelines and tell you what you already spent. Crew is a high-yield checking account with budgeting features built in — It can tell you what you're spending and saving in real time, and even decline purchases when you're going over budget. Crew is strong enough to save real money but easy enough to use day-after-day.
Crew is perfect for:
- knowing what amount is safe to spend
- helping you aggressively pay down debt or save for goals
- having a digital envelope budget
- paying yourself first automatically
- giving every dollar a job
It takes most people less than 5 minutes to open an account and — unlike some personal finance and envelope budgeting apps — Crew has no required set-up fees, subscriptions, or minimums.
Still thinking? Here's what others have to say about using Crew to manage their banking and personal finances:
"They have the best and coolest features of any banking app that I've seen so far, and I've tried a few. Everything works super well and you can do SO MANY cool and useful things." - Jackson

"After hiding monthly bills money from our view, our income-to-outgoing last month was over $1,500, which is honestly unheard of for us. We're having amazing results!" -Jesika
Still reading? Aren't you precocious! If you're this into the details of a banking app, you're definitely Crew material. Give it a try!
